conversation.properties|m.rc_greet2_3a:
Our scans have located an ancient generator below this camp.  It should be sending power to the surface, but something seems to be diverting it.

Rhendon said he wanted to meet up with you before you take on this mission.  Why don't you see him first?

mission.properties|b.shadow_beast:
Spiral HQ has detected a recon module left by the Alpha Squad somewhere within the Gloaming Wildwoods.  It is your mission to locate and retrieve the module. 

The Gloaming Wildwoods is home to packs of wild beasts that have proven deadly for squads in the past. Because of this, Tech Knights have placed Beast Bells throughout the area. Striking them should stun any beasts caught within the sound wave they produce. 

Be advised that Recon Knights have reported the presence of a terrible beast the likes which we have not seen before stalking this forest.  Known as 'the Snarbolax,' it appears as a shadowy mass of fangs and claws and seems completely immune to our weaponry.  Should you encounter it, try and find a means of escape as fast as possible.

mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_danger:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

On behalf of Impostoclaus, Spiral HQ has located the base of operations of the nefarious Grinchlins. It's time to take the fight to them and end their Winterfest terrorism once and for all. But it won't be an easy task. 

Those who accept this mission must climb Mount Krampus, a perilous trek filled with Grinchlin ambushes and icy deathtraps. Along the way you will find shelters that allow you to collect Grinchlin treasures and escape the mountain, or press on toward the summit for even greater rewards\! Just be warned\: Grinchlins and their allies are a stingy lot and will not drop ANY loot. All the treasures to be found on Mount Krampus are at the shelters. And should you pass on them for greater rewards ahead, you risk losing everything if you fail\! 

Some say that on the very summit of Mount Krampus lies a stash of Grinchlin loot that may contain treasures none have ever seen before...

conversation.properties|m.npc_veteran_h: Stick with your squad - remember it's dangerous to go alone\!
item.properties|f.blackhawk: A shadow-aligned handgun of incredible power, it's said to contain the soul of a knight who was only two days from retirement.
item.properties|f.rocket_hammer_3: Designed by Warmaster Seerus himself, this nefarious gremlin weapon is equipped with a rocket engine that can launch the wielder forward with a powerful hammer smash.  This final, perfected design is truly befitting the Grand Arsenal of the great Warmaster Seerus.
social.properties|m.friend_party_booted: You have been banned from {0}'s party.
sprites.properties|d.vengeful_shadow_clo: Creates an explosive disruption field around you when shadow cloak is interrupted that has a chance to stun targets.
helptips.properties|m.lock_guard: Protect and heal yourself and teammates from damage with the Guardian Shield\! \n\nKeep enemies at bay with increased resistances to damage and attack with faster swords and bombs\!
craft.properties|m.confirm_unbind_heat: Unbinding will remove all heat from the item. Are you sure?
conversation.properties|m.arc_mintut_2: During your travels in the Clockworks you will encounter five special minerals\: crimsonite, moonstone, valestone, luminite and dark matter.
conversation.properties|m.winterfest_bra: The path to Haven allows you to escape this perilous mountain and collect a haul of Grinchlin treasures along the way\! \n\nHowever, should you decide to pass on it now and continue up the mountain, even greater treasures await...
item.properties|f.ultra_freeze_barrier: Surrounds you with deadly icy orbs that can freeze hostiles in their tracks
item.properties|f.striker: A fast sword favored by members of the stealthier branches of the Spiral Order.
mission.properties|m.first_contact_2a:
You're eager, that's good.  Your current mission is to reach the town of Haven where Spiral HQ has set up base.  Spend the time you need within the Rescue Camp to prepare yourself for your journey to come. 

Make use of any traveling merchants as well as the knowledge of other knights in the camp to learn how to survive in this new world.  I will contact you again once you reach Haven. 

Good luck to you.
helptips.properties|m.unlock: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to use a Silver Key.
mission.properties|r.pioneers_6a: Tell me about Squad Guardian Grantz.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_10a: Rulen was very... logical.  I think he was very aware of the odds we have of reaching the Core and then doing something with it in order to restore the Skylark.  I think Rulen knew exactly what kind of mission he was undertaking when they made their first descent into the darkness of the Clockworks.
mission.properties|b.mission_sprite_1: Rhendon is waiting for you in an area of the Clockworks known as the Sunset Steppes where reconnaissance has located a cache of missing battle sprites.  Secure the sprites and clear the area of hostiles.  You are authorized to utilize any sprites you secure in order to complete the mission.
item.properties|f.chess_room: An empty room with an 8x8 chess board in the corner and a row for spectators.
item.properties|f.rock_salt_bomb: A shard bomb formed from a small explosive encased in rock salt. Not recommended for use in the kitchen.
mission.properties|o.mission_sprite_2: Secure a cache of battle sprites and return them to the Lab
helptips.properties|m.scenario_fiendbook: What to Do if You Summon the Wrong Infernal Overlord
mission.properties|m.explosive_plot_2a: Oh {0}, I'm just doing my job.  And speaking of which, I have a job for you\!
auction.properties|e.search_text_short: Your search text is too short.
conversation.properties|m.mission_crimso: That's just it {0}, nothing. We've been monitoring the base below for weeks then it went silent. Quite suddenly. We're not sure what you're going to find down there. Our sensors show no active life forms.
helptips.properties|m.atg_traps: Watch your step\!  Wait until TRAPS are down before walking over them.
projectx.properties|m.downloading: Please wait while we install the rest of the game.
mission.properties|b.rotting_metropolis: It would seem as though those slime generators have been around much longer than we thought, seeping their vile toxins into any levels that should be near them. \n\nA modern city, much like those that the devilites inhabit seems to be overrun with these toxins, and was probably left behind by both the devilites and gremlins as a result.  Now a legion of slime and undead creatures haunt the place, festering in the poisons that linger in the air.  A squad that was attempting to pass through the city has gone missing.  Given that the very air is toxic, it is urgent that an experienced team enter this city and rescue the squad.  There is little hope left for them otherwise.
mission.properties|b.frostifur_fandango: Spiral HQ is receiving numerous reports of squads being wiped out by a pack of wolvers known as 'the Snowclaw Pack' near depth 10.  These ferocious frostifurs have an icy bite and are very territorial. Due to their relentless attacks, Spiral HQ is requesting an experienced squad infiltrate their den and destroy them to prevent any further casualties. \n\nIt is advised that you prepare yourself with piercing damage and freeze resistant gear before deploying.
item.properties|f.vog_cub_cap: A thick hat that smells heavily of barbecue. Barbecued what? Don't ask.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_b45a8d: Travel the entire Clockworks from depth 0 to depth 29 in a single expedition.
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest2_r6: Help Impostoclaus deliver presents to the orphans of Emberlight.
item.properties|f.spiral_soaker: A deadly squirt gun sure to soak even the driest of foes.
guild.properties|m.rename_gms_only: Sorry, only Guild Masters may rename a guild.
item.properties|f.token_cake: A slice of cake that serves as a trophy from victory over a horde of Creep Cakes.  Head Chef Biscotti affirms that both these trophies and the incident that created them never officially occurred.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: The maskeraith is a battle sprite that embodies deception and debilitation. Its skills focus on subterfuge\: caustic quills fire poisonous quills that explode when followed with an attack, shadow cloak allows a knight to become invisible to monsters, and hexing haze allows the knight to inflict monsters with a timed damage blast. \n\nThe maskeraith is best suited for knights who wish to lurk in the shadows and strike the enemy with sneak attacks.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_gate_fiend: A fiendish city is a strange place that Spiral HQ still does not fully understand.  Devilites are everywhere, and if they see one of their Pit Bosses nearby, they will do anything to look like they're being productive.  Unfortunately, productivity is often defined by attacking or imprisoning intruders, like a squad of knights passing through. \n\nIt is unclear what purpose imprisoned knights would ultimately serve in a devilite agenda. Those that have survived captivity have reported that conditions were poor, but the worst of it was the copious amounts of paperwork they had to fill out daily.  This is a fate no knight deserves\!
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Herex slipped away\! I lost sight of him as things went black. It felt like a thousand hands were pulling us away. As if something didn't want us to follow.
item.properties|f.punkin_pie_pan: A hot steamy pie made from real gourdlings\! Not suitable for Knight consumption, please discard at nearest friend.
conversation.properties|m.almire_histori: From the tomes we have recovered, we've learned that Firestorm Citadel was once part of a much larger kingdom known as Almire thousands of years ago. Although it was bordered by other aggressive nations, Almire was renowned for the martial prowess of its many legions. These legions kept the kingdom safe for many years. Alas, they weren't enough.
item.properties|f.azure_guardian_armor: A grand set of armor commonly donned by the leaders of the Spiral Order. It's extraordinarily thick and protective, but as comfortable to wear as flowing miracloth.
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_1a: Sure, show me the shops. (Follow Tylen)
chat.properties|m.usage_ready: Usage\: /{0}\nTell your comrades that you're ready.
mission.properties|r.mission_sprite_1_6a: They look like dragons from fairy tales.
mission.properties|r.target_acquired_3a: I'll be sure to get my hands on the appropriate gear for the job.
conversation.properties|r.sprite_tut_1a: How do sprites level up and evolve?
exchange.properties|m.billing_declined: Your card has been declined. Please check that the information you have entered is correct.
uplink.properties|m.bid_outbid: Visit the Auction House for another chance at this item\!
mission.properties|b.target_acquired: After analyzing the schematics you recovered from the gremlin test lab, Spiral HQ now knows the nature of Project R as well as its location within a gremlin munitions facility.  Spiral HQ is requesting that you enter this facility and destroy Project R before it can be used on Haven.  Speak with Intel Agent Kora for full details.
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: I would like to hear about the battle sprites again.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_11a: Right, down to business.  We've located an Alpha Squad recon module in an area of the Clockworks known as the 'Gloaming Wildwoods.'  However, this particular zone is home to a horrible creature known as 'the Snarbolax.' \n\nThe Snarbolax has made fast work of Squires like yourself, but I know you can handle it, {0}. But you're going to need to prepare.  I've issued you a series of missions that will allow you to assemble a loadout fit for taking on this terrible beast and reclaiming that recon module\!
item.properties|m.pvp_token_upgrade.1: Gives {0} extra Krogmo Coin in PvP.
item.properties|f.punkin_sprout: A small sprig capable of growing into a grand gourd.
item.properties|f.prize_box_budding: Contains various unique costumes and accesories to celebrate the budding nature of spring.  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
projectx.properties|e.not_enough_appetit: Not enough appetite to consume this item.
item.properties|f.flawed_snowball: A hard-packed snowball that is unfortunately too flawed for use in alchemy. It would be best to simply throw it away... at someone's head.
conversation.properties|m.hunter_2a: Smashing\! Then perhaps you and your mates will be of service to this lodge. You see, the alchemy machine you see before you can craft magnificent monster trophies for your Guild Hall. \n\nThe alchemy machines uses materials and crowns from your Guild Treasury and deposits the results into the Guild Treasury as well.
conversation.properties|r.arc_mintut_1: I'm here to learn about the minerals found within the Clockworks.
mission.properties|r.becoming_champion_4: I think you're on to something, Lieutenant.
item.properties|f.prize_box_colossal: Contains various unique costumes and accessories to celebrate the Year of the Horse\!  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
mission.properties|m.anniversary_end_1:
{0}\! You did it\!  I've got my kitchen back\! 

Remember, you can exchange the Cake Slices you receive for awesome cake helms from Maskwell in the Haven Town Square. It's just like that old baker's saying, 'Wear the hide of your fallen foes to prove your might as a warrior\!' 

Ok, maybe I just say that.
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_1a: Well, looks like we're in quite a bind here, {0}. There's plenty of work to be done to get this camp up and running, so you've now been authorized to receive missions\! You can find any available missions in the Activities bar.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_gate_slime: The best way to keep slimes at bay is with copious amounts of rock salt. Slimes just hate the stuff as touching it makes them dissolve.  It's not pretty. \n\nResearch teams stationed in lichenous lairs will often surround their entire camp with rock salt so that they don't end up some slime's dinner.  As you can imagine, they go through the stuff fast.  When they run low, a squad is called in to battle their way to the camp and deliver the life saving seasoning.
item.properties|f.iron_buckler: A beaten little buckler made of iron that can withstand a bit more abuse than a Proto Shield.
item.properties|f.fiery_pepperbox: When you've been attacked by a swarm of Ice Cubes, all Knights agree\: happiness is a Fiery Pepperbox.
dungeon.properties|i.difficulty_easy: Normal difficulty features challenges suitable for any player.
mission.properties|m.ghost_machine_1a:
Listen up, Rangers\! Spiral HQ has received a very cryptic distress signal from some completely unknown facility deep within the Clockworks. 

The way I figure, we're about to dive head first into either a perilous rescue mission or a death trap. Either way, your means of resolving the situation resides in your arsenal right now. So get geared up, and get ready for combat. 

Let's ride, Rangers\!
mission.properties|m.built_to_destroy_2a:
Crimson Order Directives\: 

- It is the DUTY of every Gremlin to repel the metal intruders\! 

- Every Gremlin must work to destroy Haven. Cradle belongs us\! 

- Every Gremlin must remain LOYAL to King Tinkinzar and the Crimson Order. The Iron Law must be obeyed\!
mission.properties|o.silent_legion: Pursue Guardian Knight Arkus and bring him back to Haven
mission.properties|b.p_r4_kit_2: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
item.properties|f.tailed_helm: An expressive helm proving that two plumes are always better than one.
conversation.properties|m.npc_recruit_c: I think I need to craft a better shield when I get back to Haven.
mission.properties|m.another_trace_3a: The energy signature is coming from somewhere in the Royal Jelly Palace and we need you to investigate.  Royal Jellies are very territorial so you might have to get past its lair in order to reach your objective. Be wary though, a Royal Jelly surrounds itself with plenty of protection.  You will likely face significant resistance as you investigate the palace.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_12: Just one last shop to visit and then we're done. I've saved the best for last.
item.properties|f.red_saber: A saber the color of the burning sun that is given to knights who have shown exemplary bravery in past actions.
item.properties|f.bechamel_room: A trendy room where Bechamel can add or remove Accessories from your favorite equipment.
conversation.properties|m.fc_court_3: Without the power of the rest of the sprites, water will never flow through this realm. It requires a focus link with the Spirit Mother to bring even the smallest of drops of water into such an oppressive world. The master of this realm has seen to it that the flames surrounding him will always burn.
item.properties|f.prize_box_dazed: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Dazed style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|o.p_fast_advancement: Quickly power up your Knight's gear\!
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Euclid volunteered to help The Sleeper. I'm sure he's in here somewhere battling The Swarm even as we speak. As for Rulen...Vaelyn I'm sorry. He disappeared shortly after Euclid made his decision. I haven't been able to find him ever since.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_gate_construct: Destroy the operational war machines within the ruined factory\!
item.properties|f.gremlin_gizmo: A strange device used in gremlin machinery. It is inscribed with a warning against exposing it to direct sunlight or submerging it in water.
mission.properties|r.go_shopping_6a: I'd like you to give me the tour once more.
mission.properties|m.arc_mintut_4: Once you safely reach the elevator, the mineral you are carrying gets deposited in your arsenal for use later. Everyone in your party gets everyone else's minerals, so no need to fight over who gets the best one\!
conversation.properties|m.npc_minerknigh: Spiral HQ wants us to haul these minerals back up to Haven.
mission.properties|m.crossing_chasm_b_6a: Bombs are special in that they have no standard attack.  A bomb can ONLY be used as a CHARGE ATTACK, so make sure to evade monsters while charging\! \n\nFeel free to give it a try.  Just remember to equip it at that arsenal station up ahead.
sprites.properties|d.frenzied_firestorm: For every monster caught in the blaze, you and your party have a chance of receiving an attack power and speed bonus.
mission.properties|b.p_heart_of_ice_r9:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has detected a sudden climate shift emanating from deep within the Clockworks. Freak snowstorms and blizzards have begun surging through the depths seeming to originate from an inhospitable, fiendish city known as 'Amu-Sol.'  The Recon Rangers have been dispatched to infiltrate Amu-Sol and discover the source of these freezing storms.
item.properties|f.rocket_sprocket: A sturdy sprocket used by machines that fire projectiles.
projectx.properties|m.pvp_costume: Costumes blocked due to Coliseum game.
item.properties|m.sprite_food_only: Can be fed to Battle Sprites.
mission.properties|r.heart_of_matter_1a: Hello, Lieutenant.  How can I help you?
mission.properties|b.shopping_again_b: Now it's time to learn about some of the more advanced services the Bazaar offers.  Follow knight Bechamel and pay a visit to Punch and Vise, Brinks and even visit Bechamel's own shop\!
item.properties|f.ash_agni: When this bomb has left the battlefield in ashes, then, and only then, will your enemies have permission to die.
mission.properties|o.built_to_destroy: Dismantle the Roarmulus Twins in the heart of the Ironclaw Munitions Factory
item.properties|f.power_orb: A lustrous sphere of special food favored by battle sprites who align themselves with forces that grant them brute strength on the battlefield.
item.properties|f.lite_infantry: Tread lightly or lavish in the limelight, those that follow will benefit from hindsight.
mission.properties|m.delved_too_deep_4a: If what Parma said is true then we're the last line of defense against The Swarm. {0}, I won't lie but this might change everything. We'll need to pass this on to Spiral HQ immediately. I'll round everyone up and send you a mission to accept when you're ready.
item.properties|f.spiral_pith_helm: A light helmet issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
pvp.properties|m.blast_network-info: A bombastic game of explosive action where players attempt to blow away their competition\!  Blast Network provides all participants with the gear to play, so no preparation is required to get in on the action.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_4_3a: Congratulations {0}, you meet the necessary requirements and have received your 5 Star Certification.  Take the elevator behind me in order to complete your mission.
mission.properties|b.elemental_my_dear: Biotech Hahn has agreed to inform you about the monsters in the Clockworks that inflict elemental damage.  Contact him via comlink and hear what he has to say.
conversation.properties|m.arc_leader_3: That's exactly right\! The Core of the Clockworks could very well contain the energy source we need to create a new power source for the Skylark and restore it to operational condition. There's only one problem- the Clockworks themselves seem to be built like some kind of crazy death trap.\n\nReaching the Core is not going to be easy...
helptips.properties|m.graveyard: Graveyards are an unnatural place, a world between worlds where dark spirits gather, hungry for the life of any live soul that must pass through.  You must hurry and find the exit as fast as possible before these phantoms awaken and stalk you\!
projectx.properties|m.deposit_minerals: Gather minerals and deposit them in any gate in the Arcade.
item.properties|f.lockbox: A special lockbox that contains one of hundreds of unique items\!  It can only be opened with a Silver Key.  Silver Keys can be purchased from the Supply Depot.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_roar: A liberated set of schematics showing off the complete spec and scale of Project Roarmulus.
item.properties|f.shadow_stone: A concentrated lump of special food favored by battle sprites who gain their powers using forbidden, dark arts.
item.properties|f.divine_dust: A portion of special food favored by battle sprites who forever bask in the light of the heavens.
projectx.properties|x.rename_desc3: The renaming item will be consumed.
item.properties|f.ticket_unbind_5: Use this ticket at the Unbinding Forge to unbind a 5 star item.
mission.properties|o.p_r6_gate_slime: Deliver a shipment of rock salt to the research team stationed in the lichenous lair\!
logon.properties|m.deadbeat: Please go to https\://billing.spiralknights.com/billing to resolve a reversed payment.
projectx.properties|m.display_failure:
We were unable to initialize the game's graphical display. Please take the following steps to ensure compatibility\:
  • Visit the technical support forum for up-to-date information and suggestions.
  • Make sure your system satisfies the game's minimum requirements.
  • Update your video drivers.
  • Ensure that hardware video acceleration is fully enabled.
sprites.properties|d.seraphic_aura: Party members within the protective aura gain increased shield regen.
item.properties|f.fire_raider_tunic: Treasure is at your fingertips and ash in your wake with this soot laden coat.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_partypad_1: Head into the room ahead with the party pad. You're almost done.
sprites.properties|d.disintegration_ray: The ray of light also reduces the defense of its targets.
chat.properties|m.usage_force_bug_report: Usage\: /{0} <knight name> [description]\nForces a bug report to be submitted from the player's client.
conversation.properties|r.tut_intro2_2a: Roger that, Rhendon.  I'm heading your way\!
item.properties|f.feral_shell: A shield alchemized from a hardened tortodrone shell. Even the sharpest wolver claws merely glance off this compact carapace.
conversation.properties|m.arc_mintut_4: Once you safely reach the elevator, the mineral you are carrying gets deposited in your arsenal for use later. Everyone in your party gets everyone else's minerals, so no need to fight over who gets the best one\!
item.properties|f.waste_module: A small receptacle that once collected refuse from a device built to wreak havoc. Now, it just plain reeks.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_kit: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.
mission.properties|m.anniversary_gremlin: Out, out, oooout\! Too many cooks in the kitchen\! Too many cooks in the kitchen\!
item.properties|f.wild_dust: A portion of special food favored by battle sprites who are deeply connected to the natural order of the great wilderness.
item.properties|f.sallet: A streamlined helm favored by front line fighters.
item.properties|f.beach_hat: A head-mounted personal portable lightweight shade structure.
item.properties|f.confetti_winter: When thrown, this winter confetti gives you quite a chill.
item.properties|f.super_fire_barrier: Surrounds you with potent fiery orbs that can set hostiles ablaze
pvp.properties|m.bribe_reward_subject: King Krogmo reward earned in the Coliseum.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: I don't know if I feel better or worse after finding out what happened to everyone in the Core. Poor Grantz...Parma...Euclid...Rulen...
conversation.properties|m.mission_resear: We're cut off\!  Please help us defeat those lichens\!
item.properties|f.mecha_knight_kit: Instantly creates a mecha knight for your protection
item.properties|f.token_krogmo: A coin issued by the great King Krogmo to participants in his Coliseum.  It can be exchanged for prizes from the Coliseum Rewards Supervisor.
item.properties|f.kat_claw_raiment: A reclaimed raiment said to resemble the Kat Tribe hero, Scraith, first to scale the walls of the Owlite High Academy of Magicks.
social.properties|m.autofriend_multiple_: You have {0} friends that play Spiral Knights\! {1}
item.properties|f.deadly_splinter_bomb: A large chunk of synthetic mineral primed with a potent explosive. Fact\: the easiest way to find the splinter in the haystack is to blow up the haystack.
helptips.properties|m.mission_trap_chamb: Drones can also deal status damage.
logon.properties|m.no_new_free_account: You cannot create any more free accounts from this computer.
item.properties|f.volcanic_plate_shield: A superior shield imbued with the elemental essence of flame. It is so resistant to high temperatures that it's a mystery how exactly it was forged in the first place.
item.properties|f.scary_skelly_suit: An upgraded Skelly Suit infused with the elemental essence of fear. It comes standard with matching pants that cannot be scared off.
item.properties|f.token_roarmulus: A special circuit board developed by gremlin engineers designed to enhance both the bark and bite of the Roarmulus Twins.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_kit_2: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
item.properties|f.iron_gear: A metal gear that was once a component of a complicated contraption.
item.properties|f.moonstone_deposit_1: A small mineral deposit that will generate a single unit of moonstone.
item.properties|f.night_cap_sallet: A comfortable cap for knights to wear at night. Sure to give the wearer lucid dreams to face their nightmares.
item.properties|f.jelly_glue: A viscous compound developed by Biotechs to allow for the study of slime creatures. When mixed with slime and jelly matter, it allows for reshaping without losing its form. Though reserved for scientific purposes, the process is generally regarded as 'super fun.'
item.properties|f.arctic_rogue_mail: A plated mail said to be crafted by an arctic rogue. It comes augmented with ice plating to conceal your location during arctic expeditions.
mission.properties|o.p_anniversary_shock: Check on Groat the Gremlin Chef.
mission.properties|r.creators_and_create: That and a solid arsenal, yeah.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: So far, we haven't recovered Seerus's body, but there's no way anyone could have survived that explosion.
helptips.properties|m.tut_treasure: Treasure blocks are always a lucky find\! They contain coins and useful items.
mission.properties|b.p_legion_almire_r7:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ believes that an ancient codex originating from the cursed kingdom of Almire is located somewhere in a dark and terrifying necropolis.  This necropolis is believed to be teeming with all manners of undead monstrosities and only the Recon Rangers have what it takes to get in, acquire the intel and get out alive\!
item.properties|f.force_buckler: A Proto Shield modified to resist stunning impacts.
chat.properties|m.usage_auction: Go to the Auction House in Haven.
helptips.properties|m.plan_o_attack: The monitor shows readouts coming from a prototype of a massive war machine labeled "Project R".
guild.properties|m.environment_change_wa: You are paying to install this environment. If for any reason it is removed you will have to pay to install it again.
support.properties|m.subheader_step206:
Revealing personal information is not acceptable, whether it is their own or another player's. Asking for personal information is not acceptable either.

Asking people how old they are or what grade they're in or what sorts of sports they do etc. is not considered personal.

But things like phone numbers or address or real name are personal information and should never be revealed.
helptips.properties|m.atg_teblocks: TIMED EXPLOSIVE BLOCKS will count down to 0 before exploding and causing damage.
helptips.properties|m.tg3_charge_2: To perform a charge attack with a sword or handgun, press and hold ATTACK. After attacking you will begin to charge your weapon. Once it reaches maximum charge release ATTACK to unleash your charge attack.
item.properties|f.armor_arms: An accessory that can be attached to the arms of select armors.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
social.properties|m.party_dissolved: Oops\! That party no longer exists.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: There isn't much time. I can't reach you from here and you need to make it out. Warn headquarters. Warn Haven\! If the Core isn't kept sealed The Swarm will escape and it will continue to consume everything and everyone.
item.properties|f.sacred_guerrilla_armor: A sturdy suit of armor for those who want to bring down some beasts.
projectx.properties|m.remove_loadout_pro: Are you sure you want to remove {0}?
projectx.properties|m.instance_shutdown: There has been a server error. You will be transferred to another instance.
item.properties|f.exp_west_2f: An expansion that adds two rooms and a small overlook to the western side of the Guild Hall.
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_b_2a: Great\!  Now a quick lesson on charge attacks. \n\nCharge attacks can be performed with any weapon by holding down the ATTACK button and waiting for the charge aura to reach maximum charge.  You can still move around while charging\!
helptips.properties|m.zone: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to exit current zone.
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft1_r4: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
mission.properties|o.p_anniversary_shock: Check on Groat the Gremlin Chef.
mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_r7: It is during each and every Winterfest, that a faction of green-furred gremlins make quite a mess, in the town of Emberlight. These 'grinchlins' as they are called, stop at nothing until they've hauled, each and every present from the town of Emberlight. \n\nAnd so Impostoclaus has asked the Spiral Knights, to take up their arms and fight, the monsters that threaten the town of Emberlight. So grab a present and answer his call\! Ensure that a merry Winterfest is had by all, in the town of Emberlight.
item.properties|f.shockburst_brandish: An upgraded Brandish infused with the elemental essence of lightning.
item.properties|f.volcanic_iron: An extraordinary metal imbued with the blazing energy of magma.
conversation.properties|m.rc_greet3_1a: You've restored the power and saved us all, {0}\!  I can't thank you enough, all these recruits owe you their lives. \n\nYou should now try to contact Spiral HQ via your comlink.
mission.properties|m.rc_buddyknight_3a: Let's put it to good use right away. \n\nYou can accept Missions by clicking the 'Mission' button at the top of the screen and accept the mission I've given you.
guild.properties|m.published: The Guild Hall has been updated\!
design.properties|i.place_door: Install a door at this location.
item.properties|f.ignition_helm: A lightweight helmet augmented to keep a knight's head cool under pressure.
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: I am ready to choose my battle sprite.
item.properties|f.scalding_hot_cocoa: A singeing splash of sweet destruction awaits any foe that goes for this mug before it's had a chance to cool.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_11a: Oh my\!  What is the connection between these gremlins and that Artifact anyway?
item.properties|f.vial_curse_super: A glass vial containing concentrated fiend essence. It can be used to inflict enemies with Curse.\n\nThis particular vial looks much more dangerous than the standard. Throw it like a grenade and give your foes 10 years of bad luck\!
mission.properties|r.pumping_up_8a: Let's go over that again. [Restart tour]
mission.properties|b.plan_of_attack: Deep within a toxic cavern lies a hidden test lab that gremlins have been using as a testing ground for components of Project R.  One of these components still in development is reported to have schematics for the project close by. \n\nIf this is true there will likely be a terminal of some kind close to one of Project R's components.  Locate the terminal and recover the schematics for analysis.  It should shed light on the exact nature of Project R.
item.properties|f.storm_rider_mantle: A legendary suit of armor thought to be worn by a god who used lightning to carve whole worlds from stone.
item.properties|f.spiral_demo_suit: Sturdy armor designed for use by explosively-inclined knights.
mission.properties|b.occurance_at_owlite:
An unlikely source of intel has surfaced from the residents of Moorcroft Manor.  A few of the spookats that call it home contacted one of our visiting Recon Knights and provided details of the negative energy mass that has appeared above the Core. 

Calling it 'a place of burning hatred' and 'a prison for dark souls' they say that you can read all about it in 'one of those weird Owlite books' in an Owlite keep they pinpointed. 

If what they claim is true Spiral HQ could gain valuable intel from investigating the Owlite keep.  Just remember that these Owlite structures have all proven to be swarming with the lost souls of countless undead monsters.  Prepare accordingly.
item.properties|f.blazebreak_helm: A reliable helmet that'll come in handy when the heat is on.
item.properties|f.argent_peacemaker: An ancient handgun forged from sun silver. Its bullets serve as ushers for those that refuse to leave this world.
item.properties|f.volcanic_pepperbox: When encamped in dangerous territory, the Volcanic Pepperbox is perfect for roasting both marshmallows and enemies.
item.properties|f.prize_box_surprise_3: Contains three randomly chosen Prize Boxes in celebration of the Spiral Order's anniversary on Cradle.  No key required to open.
conversation.properties|r.rc_greet2_2a: How can I help channel power to the camp?
conversation.properties|r.moorcroft_arch: I'll help any way I can, Pembrooke.
conversation.properties|m.emberlight_vis: But I come to warn you\!  Crimson Order not stop with Roarmulus Project.  Crimson Order desperate to destroy all enemies. Tall ones, little ones, and outcasts.  All enemies to Crimson Order\!
mission.properties|o.p_halloween_r4: Seek an audience with the Punkin King.
item.properties|f.deconstructor: A bomb specially designed for dismantling machinery, sentient or otherwise.
helptips.properties|m.battle_arena_1: Welcome to the battle arena\! The only rule is that you must fight at least once to move on. Should you claim victory, it will be up to you to decide to fight for even more glory\!
item.properties|f.wyvern_scale_mail: It requires extreme temperatures to forge this fine armor made from the scales of rare Clockworks beasts.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_min: Chief Geo Knight Wegner is always seeking to further his research on the mysterious minerals that are found in the Clockworks.  The experiments he conducts on his available samples tend to result in their disintegration.  Because of this he's always in need of brave knights to delve into the Clockworks to procure more for samples for him.
item.properties|f.winter_onesie: The perfect pajamas for passing out presents or patiently waiting for Impostoclaus' presence.
item.properties|f.shock_raider_tunic: Anti-static fur lines this raiders coat.
mission.properties|m.laboratory_visit_2a: Ah, that's right, you're a new recruit.  Most knights encounter their first sprite on the battlefield.  Chances are you've not had the opportunity to see one yet. \n\nAllow me to explain...
item.properties|f.rogue_lite: Be a guiding light or a glowing spark, charging forward to leave your mark. Universally venerated, procedurally re-generated, you'll never be lost in the dark.
mission.properties|b.p_halloween_r9: Every year the Strangers of Haven pay tribute to a peculiar spirit known as the 'Punkin King' in order to ensure a healthy fall harvest.  This mischievous phantom delights in playing tricks on his audience but is quick to reward them with delicious candies for their troubles. \n\nCelebrate the Dark Harvest Festival and help the Strangers by seeking out the Punkin King and paying tribute.  You're sure to collect some candy along the way, so visit the Haven Town Square and turn it in for prizes\!
mission.properties|m.heart_of_matter_2a: As you know I am attempting to assemble a research team to work on-site in the Core terminal.  In order to successfully utilize it to restore the Skylark, it is imperative that we reach it and set up this research station. \n\nAll evidence seems to point towards you having the potential to finally reach the Core.  By breaking through the Firestorm Citadel and establishing a link to the Core, my team could set up the necessary supply lines and get to work immediately.  But we can't do that while that infernal citadel and its horrible ruler stand in our way.
item.properties|f.razor_ribbon: Remember\: when handling Grinchlin giftboxes, always wear your plate mail gauntlets.
item.properties|f.deadly_shard_bomb: A large chunk of Crimsonite primed with a potent explosive. No more depleted Crimsonite here\: this bomb's made with the good stuff\! Or the bad stuff, if you happen to be the target.
conversation.properties|m.winterfest_cam: It's a hazardous climb, {0}. Watch your footing and beware those Grinchlin traps\!
item.properties|f.vile_seal: A small scrap of ancient parchment imbued with dark magicks. It is believed that they grant power to those with evil souls.
chat.properties|m.usage_sprite_level: Usage\: /{0} [level]\nSets the battle sprite to that level.
guildhelp.properties|l.treasury_console: The Guild Treasury can be accessed from the Command Console. | action | console
item.properties|f.blitz_needle: For when suppression just isn't good enough, the Blitz Needle specializes in "oppressive fire".
conversation.properties|m.barracks_boost: Purchase a Krogmo Coin Booster from the Upgrades Merchant\!
conversation.properties|m.casino_pitboss: I worked my employees hard to get where I am today.
mission.properties|r.arc_mintut_6: Sounds great\! Thanks for the info\!
item.properties|f.winter_grave: A tremendously powerful hand cannon whose moniker should come as no surprise to anyone who happens to be viewing it from the wrong end. A charged shot can even plow through multiple enemies.
mission.properties|m.delved_too_deep_1a: Come in, {0}\! I can't believe it\! I lost your signal completely when you entered the Core Terminal. What happened down there?
conversation.properties|m.core_resting_2: Can't wait to get back to Haven...
item.properties|f.dark_matter_deposit_4: A mother lode of metalliferous minerals that will generate a jackpot of dark matter.
mission.properties|m.reporting_duty_4a: That's the kind of spirit I like to see. Continue to complete missions for Spiral HQ as they are assigned to you. With your help we stand a chance at reaching the Core and saving Isora.
chat.properties|m.usage_recharge: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nCharges a player (yourself by default) up with mist energy.
conversation.properties|m.npc_veteran_e: A bomb is great for dealing with a horde of monsters.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_gate_construct: Destroy the operational war machines within the ruined factory\!
item.properties|f.boosted_plate_mail: A suit of Spiral Plate Mail with a supercharged internal power source. The upgrade didn't make the armor any lighter.
mission.properties|o.p_r6_kit_2: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.
conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_6: That jelly palace...what an odd place. Also, I wonder what that strange device you found inside the palace was? It didn't appear to be made by the likes of jellies.
social.properties|m.booted: {0} has been banned from the party.
mission.properties|b.go_shopping: The Haven Bazaar is a place where all manners of item-related goods and services can be found.  Whether you're in the market for a more powerful sword or just want to make your armor stand out in a crowd, it's got what you need\!
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_b_2a: It is now. I was just on my way to the bazaar to drop off some supplies when I was ambushed by these gremlins. I thought they were from Emberlight, a colony of gremlin outcasts, but it looks like I was mistaken. \n\nJust to be safe, would you mind helping me get these items to the bazaar?
item.properties|f.salamander_mask: A mask crafted from the hide of a Salamander.
mission.properties|o.monstrous_research: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research
prologue.properties|m.ozlo_evac: All hands\: Evacuate the ship immediately\!
mission.properties|b.strength_unity: Something has riled up a pack of beasts in the Aurora Isles and they have descended upon a Geo Knight research team.  Cornered, the team has sent a distress signal and Spiral HQ has issued the task of saving them to you. \n\nBy standing together, the Geo Knights have made it this long but their time is running out. Assemble a team and confront the beasts that seek to devour your fellow knights\!
projectx.properties|e.name_invalid_space: Sorry, names may not contain more than two spaces.
social.properties|m.already_played: You have already completed this mission today.
conversation.properties|m.npc_supplies_a: Those supplies came just in time.

item.properties|f.spur: A mechanized sword with a built in motor that generates energy bursts when used.
item.properties|f.rename_knight: Allows you to choose a new name for your knight. This item is destroyed once used.
dungeon.properties|m.candlestick_keep.de: All that remains of the Owlite Academy, the Candlestick Keep is now a grim shadow of the once great school of magical arts.  Knights who have made it out of this cursed keep have only this advice to offer- 'stay in the light.'
mission.properties|o.p_r7_weap_4: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
item.properties|f.quilted_demo_suit: A suit snugly lined with luxurious stay-alert quilting. It smells a bit sweaty.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_5: ...and the required materials, orbs of alchemy, and crowns needed to transmute the item.
mission.properties|m.heart_of_matter_3a: Thank you, {0}.  I hope you succeed.  As you know, we believe the Alpha Squad made it this far, but it is unclear what became of them... Euclid, Parma, Grantz.... Rulen. \n\n(Lieutenant Vaelyn seems to almost drift off)
item.properties|f.prize_box_splash: Contains various unique costumes and items to celebrate the warm days of summer.  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
item.properties|f.furni_crate_toughbox_w: It's filled with dangerous explosives and razor-sharp swords\! Keep out of reach of children.
conversation.properties|r.moorcroft_arch: I'll find those black kats and recover the Ancient Pages\!
conversation.properties|m.monsterboost_s: Hey\!  I hear you're the one bringin' in all these spikes?
item.properties|f.proto_gun: A compact firearm issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
mission.properties|o.dreams_and_nightmar: Prepare for the worst and journey to the Core
item.properties|f.firotech_alchemer: An alchemical handgun that fires bullets of liquid flames that split on impact.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_mewkat: An adorable little spectral kitten that enjoys wandering around and mewing at just about everything it sees.
mission.properties|m.darkest_forces_1a:
{0}, still holding it together I see and earning the rank of Defender Elite no less.  Bravo. 

I've had a chance to analyze your combat data from your last mission and it's proving quite interesting.  The mecha knights in particular appear to actually be reacting to your attacks as if improvising.  But I can't say just yet. 

In any case, that's not relevant to today's data that I'm presenting.
item.properties|f.miracle_hood: A miraculous mask said to grant a single miracle to the wearer when they need it most.  In practice, it'll likely save your skin more often than that.
conversation.properties|r.atg_greeter_1b: No thanks, I'll explore the place myself.
dungeon.properties|i.difficulty_hard: Elite difficulty features an exceptional challenge for fearless players who have mastered combat. Monsters and traps are very deadly. Heat, crown, loot payouts and chances for rarities are greatly increased.
item.properties|f.thunderous_plate_mail: A legendary suit of armor said to imbue the wearer with the might of heavenly thunder.
item.properties|f.chaos_cloak: A forbidden mantle said to grant the wearer protection within the nameless realm where all elements are said to converge into one and divide into all.
helptips.properties|m.scenario_roarmulus: 'Project R' is nearly complete. We must gather more scrap\!
mission.properties|r.go_shopping_6b: I think I've got it Bechamel, thanks\!
mission.properties|m.darkest_depths_1a: {0}, you defeated the Roarmulus Twins and saved Haven\!  On behalf of the Strangers and all the Spiral Knights in Haven, thank you\!  I can see why you have been promoted to Defender, you are truly deserving of such an honor.
mission.properties|m.anniversary_gremlin: A dash of Moonstone, a pinch of... H... How did you... Who are you\!? You're not supposed to be here\!
mission.properties|b.p_r7_mat_4: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
dungeon.properties|m.sleeper_sanctuary: The Sanctuary|A Calm in the Storm
mission.properties|m.great_escape_3a: One was clearly not enough last time... so now there are two\! TWO\! Brilliant\!
item.properties|f.grim_shell: A shield alchemized from the shell of a corrupted tortodrone. Shadows seem to lengthen and cling to it whenever it is brought to bear.
item.properties|f.adv_evo_catalyst: A contained charge of highly unstable energy that can be synthesized by battle sprites. In doing so, sprites can evolve into even more advanced forms with even more powerful skills.
mission.properties|b.crimson_chaos: Spiral HQ has been monitoring several known Crimson Order bases in hopes of intercepting one of their elusive high-ranking members. Recon knights assigned to watch one of those bases report that it has suddenly gone silent and have requested backup before investigating it further. Head down to their location and investigate the base for any signs of what has happened.
mission.properties|o.abandoned_depot: Learn the basics of survival in the Abandoned Depot
mission.properties|o.p_r9_kit_2: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.
helptips.properties|m.atg_blocks2: Blocks can even affect each other\!
sprites.properties|d.golden_harness_adv: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal piercing damage. \nReduces cooldown of all skills by 5% \nCan be used by\: Seraphynx, Maskeraith
projectx.properties|e.wrong_level_item: Must use required item to level up\!
item.properties|f.super_blast_bomb: An upgraded Blast Bomb that combines an unstable heat source with untested explosive material to make one seriously unsafe package.
item.properties|f.black_kat_mask: An impressive mask instilled with the might of Kat Nappers, the undercover sleeper cell of the Kat Tribe.
conversation.properties|m.npc_minerknigh: They say these minerals power every gate in the Arcade.
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_short_pu: A short torch filled with peculiar purple fire.
conversation.properties|m.casino_imposto: Oh, haven't seen you around here before\!
item.properties|f.arthro_pod: A streamlined helmet fashioned after the tough chitin of a beetle's carapace.
logon.properties|m.downtime: Gremlins have knocked the game out of service. Please check back soon.
mission.properties|o.rise_or_fall: Test your might with a slimy showdown in the Battle Arena
pvp.properties|m.love_review_confirm: Are you sure? Once in review, you will no longer be able to make changes. Please completely test your level before submitting. It may take up to a week to review.
mission.properties|m.shocking_sentient_s: Gaaah\! I need to get out of here\! \n\nEmergency Sneakfield...activate\!
support.properties|m.subheader_step4: Your complaint has been sent, thank you for helping us keep the game an enjoyable environment.\n\nWe read through all complaints filed, but we do not report back to you on what happens with each complaint. And we may not be able to look over your complaint right away, but rest assured they are all read and handled according to our policies.
dungeon.properties|m.vanaduke_desc: Within the throne room of the citadel Lord Vanaduke stands waiting to mount a final defense against any who manage to breach his citadel's defenses.
item.properties|f.shadow_blaster: An enhanced blaster modified to fire shadow rounds.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_5a: Once again, lots of empty transport crates. Trouble is brewing, {0}. You best go on ahead and clear the area of hostiles so that a rescue squad can arrive safely.
logon.properties|m.tos_1: By logging on, you acknowledge and accept the
item.properties|f.vial_stun_ultra: An ornate glass vial containing shimmering flash pellets. It can be used to inflict enemies with Stun.\n\nThis particular vial is the most dangerous of them all. Throw it like a grenade and your foes will be too stupefied to give chase\!
mission.properties|b.p_r3_min: Chief Geo Knight Wegner is always seeking to further his research on the mysterious minerals that are found in the Clockworks.  The experiments he conducts on his available samples tend to result in their disintegration.  Because of this he's always in need of brave knights to delve into the Clockworks to procure more for samples for him.
conversation.properties|m.af_chat_fiend_: I've got a case of the Mondays.
monster.properties|m.vanaduke_1: What's this? More wolves hungry for the blood of Almire? Our great kingdom shall never fall to the likes of beasts\!
exchange.properties|m.billing_spending_l: You have reached your spending limit. Your card has not been charged.
item.properties|f.graviton_vortex: A Graviton Bomb fortified with potentially dangerous amounts of shadow steel. Its blast should draw your foes toward it... if it doesn't rip the entire universe in two, that is.
guild.properties|m.warn_in_default: WARNING\: Your guild is in default\!
item.properties|f.primal_ore: An extraordinary metal imbued with the savage spirit of the wild.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_mastery_1a: Hello again, {0}.  I understand you're well on your way to reaching the Core and need an arsenal that will keep you alive.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_2c: All battle sprites wear a mechanical harness that aligns their skills to a damage type. Not all sprites can wear all harnesses though. For example, a drakon cannot output piercing damage. \n\nBy default, you have an iron harness that any sprite can equip. If you want to branch out as you likely do with your weapons and gear, you need to purchase new harnesses.
item.properties|f.cautery_sword: A sword adapted from a medical tool, its heated blade reduces tissue damage. It is very formidable at destroying monsters of the slime family.
item.properties|f.celestial_nav_helm: A special helm built to commemorate Isoran spacefarers of old.  With this equipped, you can see a clear path across the night sky to countless worlds beyond.
social.properties|m.join_friend_mission: Join your friend {0} at depth {1} on the Mission\: {2} ({3})
mission.properties|m.crossing_chasm_b_4a: Thanks, {0}.  I thought we were done for back there. \n\nLet's get the artifact back to Spiral HQ before someone else tries to nab it.
mission.properties|b.alone_in_dark: The spookats of Moorcroft Manor have another valuable piece of intel for us that is worth investigating.  They say that a lost soul of the former Kingdom of Almire resides in a soldier's graveyard near the Firestorm Citadel.  This soul is willing to provide us with the information on the nature of the citadel as well as how we can get through it and reach the Core. \n\nReaching him will not be easy given his location.  Graveyards are terrible places, especially at this depth.  It is highly advisable that you move through the graveyard as quickly as possible in your search for this lost soul.
mission.properties|o.alchemy_mastery: Discover the potential of master level alchemy
item.properties|f.exp_center_2f: An expansion that adds a large central meeting room to the Guild Hall.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Be careful confronting the Warmaster\!
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogmas: Two cannons have stopped firing\!  Report at once, you mongrels\!
uplink.properties|m.retgift: The attached Spark of Life is a gift, sent from the Skylark straight to you\! Please use it with our compliments.
mission.properties|b.welcome_to_haven_b: Having survived the journey to Haven you must contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink and give her your report.  She has information as to what to do next.
guild.properties|e.guild_deleted: Sorry, that guild has been disbanded.
mission.properties|r.shadow_knows_4a: I'm going to need you to go over that-
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_0_1a: Well met, {0}. This is the Hall of Heroes, where veteran knights come to offer their services to members of our order who have attained the rank of Soldier or higher. \n\nBy undertaking more missions, I am confident that you will one day stand among us.
item.properties|f.honor_blade_3: A ceremonial sword issued to Champions of the Spiral Order. Though intended for formal occasions, its fine edge makes it suitable for combat use.
logon.properties|m.session_expired: Your session has expired. Please log in on the website again and relaunch the game.
projectx.properties|e.too_young: You must be at least 13 to play Spiral Knights.
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_3_2:
It was those blasted cloaking fiends\! They came from the shadows and staged an ambush.   When I get my hands on Seerus I'll... Argh\! 

(Feron slumps to one side, clearly more injured than he initially appeared) 

Blast, I'm having trouble gripping my sword...
item.properties|f.blast_bomb: An all-purpose bomb issued to Spiral Knights who have proven themselves in the field.
exchange.properties|m.billing_steam_erro: Steam Error\: User is in a restricted country.
item.properties|f.jaws_megalodon: A fearsome helm made to resemble a deep sea monster.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_gremlin: Gremlin construction sites often contain valuable schematics of gremlin structures and even weaponry.  Once obtained by Spiral HQ, they provide rare insights into gremlin engineering. \n\nGremlin schematics are typically stored in terminals somewhere on site.  These terminals are locked down and heavily guarded.  Once you draw the attention of one gremlin, expect the entire crew to come after you\!
mission.properties|b.terminal_meltdown: Drawn to the Firestorm Citadel, a horde of fiery slime and beast monsters have swarmed a nearby fuel depot putting the depot and our access to the citadel at risk. Should these monsters spread the fires into the fuel drums, the whole place will go up in flames. \n\nSpiral HQ needs you to enter the depot and put out the fire before time runs out and an explosive disaster is triggered\!
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft2_r6: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
item.properties|f.silverweave: A length of understated cloth intricately interwoven with precious metal. It's tastefully ostentatious, yet prudently protective.
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_1_2: Our advance has ground to a halt because of that artillery on the walls pinning us down.  Earlier, we staged a diversion to allow a small squad of knights to break through the front to silence that artillery...but they seem to have failed.  Now they're trapped in there, and we're stuck out here\! \n\nI need you to break through the front lines, get inside the artillery control center, and find a way to take out those cannons for good\!  Meanwhile, I'll get the troops reorganized so we can follow up your assault.  Good luck in there, soldier\!
item.properties|f.raging_warrior_helm: A helm worn by a fabled sword master so angry, his rage alone could fell armies that rose against him.
mission.properties|r.apocrea_2_3a: I will try. Tell me what to do.
item.properties|f.wizard_box: Contains one of various unique weird and wonderful wizardly items. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
helptips.properties|m.loading13: If you are the party leader, you can remove any player from your party. Click the status icon of the player you wish to remove and select "Remove from Party."
mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_5a: The attachment is corrupted and cannot be opened.
item.properties|f.hood: A mystical hood whose greatest power is concealing the wearer's identity.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: There are three distinct battle sprites available. Each has responded to the power emanating from this world differently and each offers a unique combat experience. \n\nThese sprites include the fiery drakon, the radiant seraphynx, and the shadowy maskeraith.
conversation.properties|m.casino_monster: I am here to listen. Let it all out.
item.properties|f.magnus: A large handgun with hard hitting rounds that can leave even the strongest of monsters dazed. A charged shot can even pierce through multiple enemies.
item.properties|f.officer_door: Installs a force barrier at the entrance of the room that can only be passed by guild members of Officer rank and up.
item.properties|f.drake_scale: A solid scale wrested from a brutal beast.
helptips.properties|m.scenario_fiendbook: 5 Ways to Appease Your Pit Boss
projectx.properties|m.shutdown_warning: This server will be refreshed in {0} minutes. {1}
item.properties|f.super_splinter_bomb: A shard bomb stuffed with even more synthetic mineral. It can also be used to mince vegetables, if you don't mind picking the occasional crystal out of your teeth.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_shad: Hello {0}, I am Sylvin, a knight who utilizes gear that offers high shadow damage defense.  The recipes I have for you produce armor and shields that protect you from the shadow attacks of fiends and the undead. \n\nShadow defense can be harnessed from the shadows themselves.  The armor and shields I specialize in are derived from the very fiendish and undead creatures that seek to use the power of the shadows against you.  Plus, it looks incredibly scary and cool.
item.properties|f.furni_spiralorder_fiel: A sturdy Spiral scanner that assembles in minutes, provides hours of intel, and lasts for years.
craft.properties|m.empty: You have not yet learned any recipes.
item.properties|f.shrouded_crest: Blackened, cursed, and hidden from sight. Thrice-damned herald of an ill-fated soul.
item.properties|f.spiral_demo_helm: A sturdy helm designed for use by explosively-inclined knights.
mission.properties|o.blades_fallen: Place the sword of an unknown knight at the memorial in the soldier's graveyard
mission.properties|m.winterfest_danger_1: Hail\! You must be the brave knight Spiral HQ has sent to deal with these Grinchlins. Mount Krampus is not like other levels so allow me to explain to you how it works.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_12a: No problem, I've got the time.  Let's head back to Punch and Vise.
mission.properties|m.true_champion_3a: You can always count on me\! \n\nNow then, I'm sure you've got lots to do.  We're going crazy over here trying to make heads or tails over that recon module you discovered outside of the Core.  How the heck could the Alpha Squad have 'entered' the Core?
mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_r9: It is during each and every Winterfest, that a faction of green-furred gremlins make quite a mess, in the town of Emberlight. These 'grinchlins' as they are called, stop at nothing until they've hauled, each and every present from the town of Emberlight. \n\nAnd so Impostoclaus has asked the Spiral Knights, to take up their arms and fight, the monsters that threaten the town of Emberlight. So grab a present and answer his call\! Ensure that a merry Winterfest is had by all, in the town of Emberlight.
exchange.properties|m.getenergy_info: Purchase energy with your credit card, PayPal, mobile phone, or various other methods.
item.properties|f.spine_cone: A ferocious device that is positively bursting with briars.
item.properties|f.bronze_bolt: A simple bronze bolt found everywhere throughout the Clockworks.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_b631f6: Power up a derelict Mecha Knight.

conversation.properties|m.test_greeter_1: You here for some testing?  Ok, make sure you read up on the latest info regarding what to test on the Test Server board in the official Spiral Knights forums.  Thank you, move along.
