item.properties|f.sorcerer_robe: A fine robe known to be worn by powerful sorcerers, and this one guy Bob.
exchange.properties|m.trade4energy_toolt: Enter the amount of energy you want to buy, in multiples of 100.
mission.properties|r.first_contact_b_1a: This is {0} of the Skylark.  I read you loud and clear Kora.
item.properties|f.black_kat_mail: An impressive mail instilled with the might of Kat Nappers, the undercover sleeper cell of the Kat Tribe.
conversation.properties|m.biscotti_2:
Great\! There are two ways to help me out\: 

You can accept the new Prestige Mission 'Total Caketastrophe,' which is available daily. 

Or you can journey into the Clockworks and weed out infestations of these 'Creep Cakes' as much as you like.  Just look for the tell-tale frosting\!
chat.properties|m.usage_shout: Usage\: /{0} message\nShouts a message to a wider area.
item.properties|m.weapon_tip_locked: Weapon Slot (Buy Weapon Slot Upgrade to Unlock)
sprites.properties|d.maskeraith: The maskeraith is a battle sprite that embodies the shadows. Its skills focus on subterfuge and deadly toxins.
mission.properties|m.silent_legion_3a: An intense sadness radiates from his fallen form.  His eyes fade and a darkness washes over him.  Arkus is lost.
helptips.properties|m.tut_hearts: Break these blocks to receive hearts. Hearts restore your health. You cannot pick them up unless you need them.
mission.properties|m.alone_in_dark_1a:
(You see the lost soul of Almire standing before you.  In his face you see a profound sadness.  Staring beyond you he begins to speak without introduction.) 

Lord Vanaduke brought the fire from the mountains to our kingdom.  Everything burned.  His enemies.  Even his family. 

My family was lost too.  I fled the battle as soon as I saw the wave of flames in the distance.  I was able to reach my home just in time to see it burn.  I don't even remember how it ended.  I have no memory of my passing.
guildhelp.properties|u.design_wiki: A full list of available furniture can be found on our official wiki. | URL | http\://wiki.spiralknights.com/Furniture
conversation.properties|m.monster_codex_: Snarbolax \nThe mythical Snarbolax is immune to knight attacks. Ringing the Beast Bell when it is nearby will stun the beast into submission.
conversation.properties|r.fc_court_4_acc: Free 6 Lost Sprites? I can do that\!
mission.properties|m.pioneers_2a: It should, there're plenty of new recruits that chatter about them constantly. They're like heroes to some knights. \n\nThe Alpha Squad was an elite squad of knights that Ozlo personally selected to first enter the Clockworks in an effort to locate the source of the massive energy signal below.  Because all systems on the Skylark were offline for several weeks, radio communication was not possible.  Instead, they left a series of recon modules throughout their travels, sort of like a breadcrumb trail.
item.properties|f.ignition_armor: Light armor augmented to help protect knights venturing into heated situations.
item.properties|f.sunset_duster: A sturdy set of leather clothing made for a pilgrim with true grit.
conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_9: Another strange device\! This one was clearly not made by the Almirians any more than the previous device was made by jellies. One thing we've noticed however\: this device is still active. On top of that, the energy signature is similar to the readings we took off the Artifact before it was stolen. This requires some further research I think.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_snar: A large model Snarbolax, depicting in minute detail his jaws that bite and claws that catch.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_crowns: Crowns are the currency of the Clockworks. You can use them to purchase all kinds of things like new weapons and armor. While playing with others, every party member gets crowns whenever anyone picks some up.
helptips.properties|m.atg_vials: Inflict a variety of status effects on enemies by throwing VIALS at them\!
mission.properties|m.once_only: This mission can only be played once per day.
item.properties|f.confetti_leaf: A fantastic party favor used in forest festivities.
conversation.properties|m.npc_recruit_a: I just need to rest a bit before moving on.
helptips.properties|m.mission_trap_chamb: All drones can move in a few different ways.
conversation.properties|m.mission_apocre: If you're going further, be on your guard. I smell a trap.
conversation.properties|m.casino_monster: Luck changes, sometimes from bad to worse...
exchange.properties|m.billing_bad_expira: Please check that the expiration date is correct and try again. Your card has not been charged.
mission.properties|r.hall_of_heroes_stri: Ok, let's see what you have to offer.  (Browse recipes)
mission.properties|b.mission_sprite_2: Rhendon is waiting for you in an area of the Clockworks known as the Restless Railroad where reconnaissance has located a cache of missing battle sprites. Secure the sprites and clear the area of hostiles. You are authorized to utilize any sprites you secure in order to complete the mission.
projectx.properties|i.limit_fps: Limit the frame rate to avoid overtaxing your video card, especially if offscreen.
mission.properties|r.cwt_mintut_6: Sounds great\! Thanks for the info\!
item.properties|f.skolver_coat: The ultimate in Wolver-hide clothing, this coat has been expertly crafted to give your melee attacks extra power.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_10: Congratulations {0}.  The Geo Knights owe a great deal to your efforts.
item.properties|f.static_flash: A Proto Bomb modified to generate small bursts of electricity upon detonation.
item.properties|f.infernal_guardian_helm: A charred, stygian helm belonging to an abyssal warrior.
craft.properties|e.cant_use_accessory: This item is not compatible with this accessory type.
dungeon.properties|m.moorcroft_desc: A mysterious old manor home to a number of restless spirits. Moorcroft Manor appears to act as a station stop for spirits in their travels, however none of them appear to actually be going anywhere in particular.
sprites.properties|d.hexing_haze: Creates a miasma around you that hexes any target within. Each hex has a timer that deals damage to its target upon termination. For every target acquired by hexing haze, the duration of the miasma increases.
item.properties|f.sacred_wraith_helm: A honed helm for those who are gunning for gremlins.
conversation.properties|m.casino_bouncer: Welcome to the High Wobbler Lounge\!
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_4a: Your sprite will evolve as you level it up. At certain key levels your sprite will require an Evo Catalyst be fed to it in order to level up further. Once fed, your sprite will physically change its appearance\! \n\nIt will be interesting to see how these strange, new forms of battle sprites evolve in time.
mission.properties|b.pumping_up: You are free to use the Advanced Training Hall whenever you like in order to practice with new weapons or learn about other unique features of the Clockworks.  Check it out and see what it has to offer\!
mission.properties|e.good_unavailable: Sorry, that item is no longer available.
dungeon.properties|m.emberlight_desc: A village of outcasts, Emberlight serves as a refuge for gremlins who were banished from the Great Colony. Now they live humble lives, selling wares and repairs to passing travelers, always fearful that one day the gremlin king Tinkinzar would see fit to wipe them out entirely.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_87eae7: Revive a downed party member, giving them only half a pip of health.
item.properties|f.scary_skelly_shield: A small, spooky shield to safeguard you from shadow.
auction.properties|e.auction_bid: The auction may not be cancelled, it already has a bid.
craft.properties|e.no_accessory: There is no accessory of this type on this item.
mission.properties|b.p_moorcroft2:
Someone or something has summoned a horde of cursed black kats into the Clockworks. These shadowy beasts hunger for arcane power and raided the Moorcroft Manor Archives' precious collection of magical grimoires. 

In the wrong hands these ancient tomes could be catastrophic, but it turns out that black kats can't read, so they instead decided to just eat them.

The residents of Moorcroft Manor would like you to retrieve the Ancient Pages of the magical grimoires that quite likely reside in the stomachs of black kats. We'll leave you to figure out just how to recover them... 

For this mission, journey into a fiery furnace where intel has located a black kat nest. Recover those Ancient Pages and return them to Moorcroft Manor\!
mission.properties|o.vicious_viscous: Prove your valor against a legion of powerful piercing monsters
item.properties|f.wild_buster: A handgun alchemized from a hardened tortodrone shell. While wielding it, you can feel the fierce energies within just waiting to be unleashed.
item.properties|f.mighty_great_cleaver: A custom made Sudaruska designed by Biscotti, head chef of the Skylark. Though she swears it's used just for cooking, one can't help but think more than a few monsters have met it at the chopping block as well.
item.properties|f.prize_box_solstice: Contains various unique items that celebrate the Solstice\! Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.exp_east_3f: An expansion that adds two rooms and a small overlook to the eastern side of the Guild Hall.
item.properties|f.proto_duelist: A six-shot firearm preferred by the marksmen of Spiral Knight recruits.
mission.properties|m.occurance_at_owlite: (This appears to be the Owlite tome that the spookats said describe the place above the Core.  Its pages are very worn and only portions of the original text can be deciphered.)
mission.properties|m.eye_of_needle_3a: Exactly\!  So what the heck is it doing in the Clockworks now?  It just doesn't make any sense. \n\nSo, if we are to believe that indeed a lost kingdom from the past has somehow wound up in a massive, mechanical world in present day, the question remains, why?
item.properties|f.venom_veiler: The ultimate in toxic dispersal devices, the Venom Veiler can be used to destroy pests on crops. Failing that, it can also be used to destroy crops.
mission.properties|o.explosive_plot: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: We wouldn't have made it past that artillery without your help\!
item.properties|f.cracked_crystal: A rare, crystallized formation of heat used to forge higher levels of weapons and gear. Though cracked, it still glows ever so faintly.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_6a: Here we have an alchemy station that you'll no doubt become very familiar with as you upgrade your arsenal. \n\nWell, that's it for the shops. Would you like another tour?
dungeon.properties|m.lobby_desc: A lobby before entering a gate where knights can strategize and gear up for the adventure to come.
projectx.properties|e.password_mismatch: The passwords you entered do not match.
item.properties|f.divine_mote: A small morsel of special food favored by battle sprites who forever bask in the light of the heavens.
conversation.properties|m.forge_knight_7: Now that you know about the Forge, would you like to give it a look?
mission.properties|b.p_r6_gate_gremlin: Gremlin construction sites often contain valuable schematics of gremlin structures and even weaponry.  Once obtained by Spiral HQ, they provide rare insights into gremlin engineering. \n\nGremlin schematics are typically stored in terminals somewhere on site.  These terminals are locked down and heavily guarded.  Once you draw the attention of one gremlin, expect the entire crew to come after you\!
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_2a: Battle sprites level up by acquiring heat, just like your weapons and gear. They can acquire heat in two ways\: absorbing it as you battle in the Clockworks and by consuming materials and synthesizing them into heat.
mission.properties|r.apocrea_1_1a: What is this place and what are you talking about?
mission.properties|m.ending_in_fire_3a: We thought things were getting pretty predictable, even at the depths you've been exploring.  The Core was in sight.  But now some kind of massive negative energy anomaly has surfaced above the Core, blocking access to it.  Recon Knights have said that all they see near it is fire, endless fire. \n\nWe don't know what it is just yet, but squads near that depth have already gone missing.  This is bad news.
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_4_2: With the Biotechs' help, I should be on the mend and fit for duty again in no time.  {0}, I can't stress enough how important this victory is for all Spiral Knights.  You've helped us deal a mighty blow to the Crimson Order by destroying their Grand Arsenal. \n\nThanks to you, gremlin forces will not have any more of these massive war machines for some time. And with our Technicians studying what is available in Seerus's personal quarters we may end up gaining valuable insights into gremlin technology or even the location of the rest of the Crimson Order\!
item.properties|f.mechaknight_suit: A slim suit of armor designed to disguise a knight as they delve into the depths of Cradle.
dungeon.properties|m.golden_slime_prize: Each spin of the wheel rewards you with a random prize, sometimes including very special items\! Requires one Golden Slime Coin or crowns if none are available.
mission.properties|o.elemental_my_dear: Learn about monsters that inflict elemental damage
guild.properties|m.confirm_remove: Are you sure you want to remove {0} from {1}?
conversation.properties|m.mon_pocket_1:
Greetings\! I'm Nonna with the Emberlight Adoption Agency\! 

We at the Emberlight Adoption Agency collect baby monsters that have managed to become lost in the darkest depths of the Clockworks.  No longer having a home or any means of caring for themselves, we try to find these needy monsters a good home\! 

By purchasing one of these adorable 'monster pockets' you can carry around a baby monster of your very own\! 

The Emberlight Adoption Agency will visit Haven from time to time, and you never know what we will have to offer\!
lottery.properties|m.lottery_announcemen: In {0}, a Birdsong Trading Co. giveaway drawing will be held amongst all online players for a prize of {1}\!
mission.properties|o.occurance_at_owlite: Locate the ancient tome within the haunted Owlite keep
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest_r6: Help Impostoclaus deliver presents to the orphans of Emberlight.
item.properties|f.mod_calibrator: This complicated device was specially built to calibrate mods, and should not be confused with a Calibrator Mod, which modifies calibrators. It's a common mistake.
mission.properties|m.ending_in_fire_4a: We need you to explore the surrounding levels and collect any intel you can.  You can start with an Owlite castle of some sort that recently surfaced near this anomaly.
helptips.properties|m.atg_treasure: GREEN Treasure boxes contain crowns and other useful items\! RED Treasure boxes are rarer than green blocks and contain better items\! HEART boxes contain hearts that will restore your health.
guildhelp.properties|l.emporium_console: The Birdsong Emporium and Design Mode can be accessed from the Command Console. | action | console
item.properties|f.vitasuit: A special suit that provides a hearty, healthy bonus to the wearer.
mission.properties|m.creators_and_create: Not all, but most of them are believed to have been directly manufactured from gremlin design, yes.  We think that most were originally engineered during the building of the Clockworks.  Some remain under gremlin control, others have gone rogue and the rest have become something else entirely.
mission.properties|o.toy_soldiers: Destroy the Mecha Knight factory's production center
item.properties|f.honor_shield_1: A ceremonial shield issued to Spiral Knight recruits. Though intended for formal occasions, its solid construction makes it suitable for combat use.
mission.properties|m.arc_mintut_1: Hello. I'm Wegner, Chief Geo Knight of the Skylark and head of geological studies within the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.sacred_wraith_armor: A stalwart suit of armor for those who are gunning for gremlins.
mission.properties|o.ancient_generator: Explore the Ancient Generator and restore power to the Rescue Camp before night falls\!
mission.properties|r.welcome_to_haven_3a: I'm all ears Kora, tell me about energy\!
mission.properties|m.silent_legion_recon:
I am drawn to this place. 

In the eyes of these silent warriors I see myself\: cold, strong, unflinching... and crumbling. I have been asked to let it go, to move on, but this I cannot do. 

Their faces, their dying cries... they haunted me in my dreams, so I no longer sleep.  Now I see them when I close my eyes, so I shall not blink. 

I will remain here, among the stones... never blinking, never forgetting.
uplink.properties|m.auction_incomplete: We're sorry, but the item you tried to sell was not sold.\n\nTip for sellers\: Always sell shiny items that everyone wants at super good prices.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_9a: You cannot stop what you cannot see.
item.properties|f.rocket_hammer_2: Designed by Warmaster Seerus himself, this nefarious gremlin weapon is equipped with a rocket engine that can launch the wielder forward with a powerful hammer smash.  This particular model is a more stable version that blew up gremlin test subjects far fewer times than the prototype.
item.properties|f.fusion_blaster: An enhanced elemental blaster designed to banish creatures that lurk in the shadows.
helptips.properties|m.loading11: If you become cursed some of your weapons will be marked by the curse. Trying to use a curse marked weapon will cause you damage.
conversation.properties|m.fc_court_compl: Our focus with the Spirit Mother is strong now thanks to you\! Use the water that flows from the spirit wells to extinguish the shadow fire. The path ahead is is ridden with shadow fire and Vanaduke's minions and while we sprites can do little to aid you in battle, we can at least summon spirit wells in certain areas.
item.properties|f.firetail_mail: A scorching simian mail typically worn by commanders in combat. It will ward off many wounds made to the wearer.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_kit: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
item.properties|f.proto_bomb: A small bomb used by Spiral Knight recruits to learn the art of blowing things up.
item.properties|f.jelly_helm: Gelatinous headgear made from gooey guardians.
item.properties|f.wicked_idol: One of many statuettes carried by fiends as a means of gaining favor with their dark gods. The most valuable ones are 'MIBE' (mint in box of evil).
item.properties|f.dread_venom_striker: An assassin's armament whose edge causes deep wounds that seep with vitriol. You should probably store it separately from your snacks.
item.properties|f.hot_edge: A modified Proto Sword capable of generating temperatures high enough to burn organic material.
item.properties|f.padded_demo_suit: An upgraded suit for bombers that is lined with soft, stimulating padding.
mission.properties|o.plan_of_attack: Recover the gremlin schematics in the secret test lab
conversation.properties|r.final_test_kni: (Tell Feron about the Rescue Camp, Razwog and the Artifact)
item.properties|f.ice_axe: A technical climbing tool that can pick apart monsters with precision.
guild.properties|i.buy_environments: Change the environment for the Guild Hall.
item.properties|f.needle_shot: An Autogun modified to fire piercing bolts at an alarming rate.
mission.properties|b.p_legion_almire_r6:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ believes that an ancient codex originating from the cursed kingdom of Almire is located somewhere in a dark and terrifying necropolis.  This necropolis is believed to be teeming with all manners of undead monstrosities and only the Recon Rangers have what it takes to get in, acquire the intel and get out alive\!
item.properties|f.volcanic_plated_sentin: A helm reinforced with volcanic plating to defend against a range of elements.
item.properties|f.cryotech_alchemer_mkii: An upgraded Alchemer that fires bolts of extremely low temperature material at an increased rate.
conversation.properties|m.npc_spikeknigh: Readings in Haven look good so far...
mission.properties|m.advanced_alchemy_1a: We meet again, {0}.  Spiral HQ has asked me to introduce you to some advanced alchemy.  Don't worry, this won't take long.  I've got an old mecha knight to work on anyway.
conversation.properties|r.rc_warning_1a: I understand, I'll be sure to hear what Virgil has to say.
mission.properties|m.honor_duty_1a: Well met, {0}, Champion of the Spiral Knights.  Your service to our cause has been of the highest caliber.  Without you, reaching the Core would still be a dream.  Now, we have a chance of actually restoring the Skylark and returning home.
pvp.properties|m.coins_earned.n: You have earned {0} Krogmo Coins playing {1}\!
conversation.properties|m.moorcroft_arch: Then scour the Clockworks for those wretched kats and destroy them\! Even if they ate the books you will be able to recover the Ancient Pages. These pages can be given to Montague in exchange for rewards. Help us and we'll help you\! \n\nBlack kats can be found randomly when encountering spookats in Tier 2 and Tier 3 (Arcade Gates and Missions). There is also a daily Prestige Mission that likely leads to a black kat nest.
mission.properties|r.explosive_plot_4a: Roger that Kora, I'm on my way\!
conversation.properties|r.core_tech_3: I'll continue to explore the Clockworks and collect the minerals needed for your research.
item.properties|f.super_stun_gun: An upgraded Stun Gun whose powerful blast will discourage even the most disconcerting of Clockworks monsters.
global.properties|m.peer_shutting_down: The requested peer is shutting down.
item.properties|f.kat_hiss_cowl: A magnificently crafted cowl said to resemble the Kat Tribe hero, Torair, who clung to the gates of the Owlite High Academy of Magicks as both it and his explosives burned.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_mat_234: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
mission.properties|m.intro_reward_rank: Select a mission card to receive a mission briefing, see the available rewards and enable options for starting the mission\!
item.properties|f.toy_soldier_cap: Standard issue for recruits who can march, salute, and occasionally fall off shelves.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_gate_beast: Rescue the Geo Knights from the clutches of wild beasts\!
item.properties|m.expire_days.n: This item expires {0} days after it is equipped.\n
item.properties|f.surge_breaker_armor: A reliable set of armor adept at weathering the most shocking of revelations. It's not bad at resisting electric attacks, either.
conversation.properties|m.tut_intro2_1a: ...come in, {0}, are you there?  This is Recon Knight Rhendon\!
chat.properties|m.usage_team: Usage\: /{0} message\nSends a message privately to your team.
item.properties|f.green_shard: A shard of Valestone that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
conversation.properties|m.forge_knight_3: In town, you can access the Forge at any time.  In the Clockworks, you can access it by using an Arsenal Station.
mission.properties|o.alchemy_beginners: Learn about the wonders of alchemy\!
item.properties|f.azure_guardian_helm: A noble helmet reserved for the most senior members of the Spiral Order. The technique which weaves dragon scale seamlessly into the metal is a closely guarded secret.
item.properties|f.pvp_bomb: Creates a cross-shaped blast that increases in size with power ups.  Does not require charging to use.
conversation.properties|m.casino_pitboss: Productivity is up two percent since I started mandatory overtime.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_gate_gremlin: Gremlin construction sites often contain valuable schematics of gremlin structures and even weaponry.  Once obtained by Spiral HQ, they provide rare insights into gremlin engineering. \n\nGremlin schematics are typically stored in terminals somewhere on site.  These terminals are locked down and heavily guarded.  Once you draw the attention of one gremlin, expect the entire crew to come after you\!
dungeon.properties|m.jigsaw_valley_desc: Appearing to be sky islands ripped apart and put back together again as if it were a puzzle this world can sometimes be confusing to navigate. Unfortunately it seems to also be home to a host of mindless slimes and constructs who do not seem to mind its erratic layout.
conversation.properties|m.casino_yesman_: I'm sorry, you missed Happy Hour by a minute. Next time.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_4a: Hey, it looks like one of the sprites has taken a liking to you\! Well, let's not let that extra power go to waste, I'll stay here and protect these sprites. You use your new friend to help clear the rest of the area of hostiles.
mission.properties|m.steam_overlay_disab: The Steam overlay must be enabled in order to purchase expansions. Please ensure that "Enable Steam Community In-Game" is checked in the Steam "In-Game" settings, then restart the game.
item.properties|f.prize_box_cozy: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Cozy style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
conversation.properties|r.rc_instruct_2c: On second thought, I'm going to head out.
item.properties|f.voltaic_radical_suit: A suit said to be replicated by a sentient mechaknight. It comes with a synthetic skinsuit that pulses with an electric energy.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_1_3b: I'm sorry {0}, but you currently do not meet the necessary requirements. Please speak to me again when you are currently equipped with a 2 star or greater armor, helmet, shield and weapon.
chat.properties|m.usage_kick: Usage\: /{0} player name\nKicks a player offline.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_gate_undead: Save the lost Knight from joining the ranks of the dead in the haunted manor\!
dungeon.properties|m.ironclaw_munitions_: The Ironclaw Munitions Factory is a gremlin-operated weapons factory that specializes in the production of high-calibur explosives.  Intel has revealed that it is developing a secret weapon known as 'Project Roarmulus' designed with the sole purpose of destroying Haven\!
item.properties|f.raptor: An ancient pistol imbued with enchantments designed to smite the fiendish creatures of the Underworld. Like its namesake, its bullets fly fast and strike with deadly force.
item.properties|f.gh_env_rain_torrent: A environment with almost too much rain.
mission.properties|b.return_of_ur: A Recon squad has reported that deep within a fiendish city, devilites are attempting to summon a legion of powerful trojan warriors.  Based on intel from a devilite internal memo, the trojans are known as the 'Legion of Ur,' and are said to have once numbered in the thousands.  Strangely, the memo indicated that the Legion of Ur was sealed away in the Underworld and that an alternative approach would be required for bringing them back. \n\nWhatever means the devilites intend to use to bring a few thousand trojans into the Clockworks, they must be stopped.  Infiltrate their city and stop the fiendish army before they become unstoppable\!

mission.properties|b.silent_legion:
Guardian Knight Arkus was one of the finest warriors serving the Spiral Knights until some time shortly after the crash.  As one of the first to search for the Alpha Squad, Arkus's own squad perished in a grisly battle with a horde of dust zombies.  Since then, Arkus has blamed himself for their loss, saying that he betrayed his Guardian's Oath to protect his squad. 

Arkus now journeys into the Clockworks alone, never risking the loss of another squad and we believe, somehow trying to find the squad he once lost.  As these expeditions began to appear self-destructive, Spiral HQ issued him a direct order to cease. 

Arkus ignored these orders and has gone deep into the Clockworks and not returned.  Not wanting to lose the last member of his squad, Spiral HQ is asking you to pursue him to his last known whereabouts, some kind of mysterious statuary at depth 26.

mission.properties|b.p_legion_almire_r4:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ believes that an ancient codex originating from the cursed kingdom of Almire is located somewhere in a dark and terrifying necropolis.  This necropolis is believed to be teeming with all manners of undead monstrosities and only the Recon Rangers have what it takes to get in, acquire the intel and get out alive\!

mission.properties|m.legion_almire_2a:
An excerpt from the accounts of Lord Brandell, High Chancellor of Almire\: 

Like so many of its people, Law and Order have fled Almire.  Only Justice remains, but she too has been twisted by the cursed flames that ravage our kingdom.  Justice is now the burning scepter of our once great Lord Vanaduke.  Justice is swift, unflinching, merciless. 

My position has afforded me much in my life.  I used to love the view that my tower offers. From these lofty heights I thought of myself as the first one to greet the spring season, the first to smell the life in the air as the flowers bloomed.

mission.properties|b.p_tortodrone_r9: Pieces of fallen tortodrones and clusters of dark matter have been showing up in the Clockworks, leading Spiral HQ to believe that the Fiends are somehow linked to the disappearance of those once-mythical beings. In order to discover what the Fiends are up to, you will need to find a way to unlock one of their Grim Gates and travel through it. Spiral HQ suspects that the glyphs that the Fiends carry with them might be the keys to opening the gate yourself.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: Congratulations, {0}\! You have become bonded with your battle sprite\! item.properties|f.volcanic_plate_mail: Superior plate mail imbued with the elemental essence of flame and designed to withstand tremendous impact.

Your briefing should explain everything.

mission.properties|r.darkest_depths_1a: Thank you Kora, I'm just as glad as anyone to have Haven safe once more.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_gate_slime: The best way to keep slimes at bay is with copious amounts of rock salt. Slimes just hate the stuff as touching it makes them dissolve.  It's not pretty. \n\nResearch teams stationed in lichenous lairs will often surround their entire camp with rock salt so that they don't end up some slime's dinner.  As you can imagine, they go through the stuff fast.  When they run low, a squad is called in to battle their way to the camp and deliver the life saving seasoning.
logon.properties|m.machine_tainted: This computer has been used by a banned account and cannot be used to create new accounts.

mission.properties|m.reporting_duty_2a: After the Skylark crashed, its primary tearium core exploded, destroying a portion of the ship and leaving it without a main power source. Since so far we haven't found several hundred tons of tearium just lying around, the bird has effectively lost its wings. \n\nWith the help of the Strangers, we were able to set up a small base of operations here in Haven. Once we got our systems online, we discovered that within the heart of this rock resonates a power signature of unprecedented magnitude.
item.properties|f.lockdown_recon_shield: A highly advanced device used by Recon Specialists of the Spiral Order that renders the user nearly invisible to the naked eye.

conversation.properties|m.rc_instruct_1a: Greetings, recruit.  Always good to see another knight make it to the Rescue Camp.  I imagine you're looking to prepare for your journey to Haven.  A good place to start is the gate here into the Clockworks.  Simply approach the control panel at the north end of the lift and press the action button ([[?ACTION]]).\n\nAny questions?
mission.properties|r.winterfest_danger_1: I have no time to talk.
mission.properties|m.creators_and_create: We've had a few cases where knights have met non-hostile constructs that they swear behaved like true sentient creatures.  But that is very difficult to believe. Gremlins are brilliant, but brilliant at the kind of direct engineering that simply gets the job done and little else.  Brute force. \n\nArtificial life?  Well, that's something else entirely.
item.properties|f.spitfire: A modified Proto Gun augmented with a low intensity burst of flame.

pvp.properties|m.removed: Your coliseum signup has been cancelled.

item.properties|f.potocrowns: An unlucky thing for your foes to find, it explodes in a painful blow.

mission.properties|r.pierce_of_cake_4b: I think I've got it thanks for-

mission.properties|m.legion_almire_1a:
Nothing like a death-defying romp through a haunted necropolis to really get the blood pumping, eh Rangers? 

The necropolis originates from Almire, fallen kingdom of some crazy lord something-something, population\: innumerable legions of Undead.  Apparently these less-than-living residents are guarding something that Spiral HQ would like to acquire. 

Our job is to recover a special book, a piece of a much larger collection of works that may give us more insight into the nature of this cursed kingdom.  So grab your helmets, and your best zombie-basher- I'm not expecting a warm reception. 

Let's ride, Rangers\!

mission.properties|b.operation_crimson_h:

Recon Knights under the command of Lieutenant Feron recently discovered Seerus's 'Grand Arsenal,' his development center and storage facility for all his weaponry.  Now, Feron himself is leading several squads of knights directly into the Grand Arsenal, with the intention of weeding out Seerus and destroying his war machines.

support.properties|m.subheader_step209:
Sometimes we make a mistake when trading with players. This happens to all of us.

But Game Masters can't know what the agreement with the trade was. One player could claim this wasn't what was agreed on, while the other could claim it was. And we can't just blindly pick a side. So we have to rely on players double checking what they're trading before they click to confirm.

So if you just made a trade you didn't really mean to, then I'm afraid Game Masters won't be able to assist you. Instead you'll want to talk to the other player and see if the player is nice enough to reverse the trade.

Also remember never to trade anything away "as a loan" unless you are OK with this player not returning the item. Game Masters won't be able to recover it for you.

mission.properties|b.monstrous_research_: Having fought the elite Darkfang Clan gremlins, evaded the crushing blows of lumbers and withstood the optic blasts of retrodes, you have no doubt collected samples from these encounters that would be of great use to Spiral HQ's research teams.
item.properties|f.freeze_raider_helm: A fur lined helmet, sure to keep you warm on a winter raid.

mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_2_3b: I'm sorry {0}, but you currently do not meet the necessary requirements. Please speak to me again when you are currently equipped with a 3 star or greater armor, helmet, shield and weapon.
item.properties|f.thunderball: An orb of pure electricity that is typically found at the bottom of the sea of all places.

conversation.properties|m.monsterboost_s: Well, that's why I'm not just telling everybody back at Haven about it. This little puppy may be a little too peppy for your average knight, especially when those razor disks come flying back at you\!\n\nBut I figured you'd probably get a kick out of it\!

item.properties|f.frozen_great_cleaver: A custom made Triglav designed by Biscotti, head chef of the Skylark. Though she swears it's used just for cooking, one can't help but think more than a few monsters have met it at the chopping block as well.
item.properties|f.crest_of_ur: A crest from the lost Legion of Ur, an elite band of fiendish warriors said to have once conquered the Underworld. Whomever holds it can faintly hear the sound of drums and the clomping of hooves.
item.properties|f.token_page: A crumbling page torn from a long-forgotten grimoire of the Moorcroft Manor archives. The indecipherable language written upon it glows faintly in the dark as if containing power in its very words.
mission.properties|o.shadow_beast: Defeat the Snarbolax in the Gloaming Wildwoods and recover the recon module
mission.properties|m.anniversary_start_1: {0}\! Am I glad to see you\!  Things are getting pretty bad down here.

item.properties|f.fang_of_vog: A sword said to be created from the fang of the fire beast, Vog.
conversation.properties|m.rc_virgil_3a: It seems to lead to some kind of elevator, but with no power, the whole thing is just dead.
sprites.properties|d.dark_veil: Increases the defensive power of the shadow cloak.

helptips.properties|m.p_dz_schematic_hei: Unauthorized access of our schematics library detected. Security team dispatched. Lockdown commenced.
item.properties|f.ghost_bell: A small, silvery bell worn by considerate ghosts that alerts the living when they are close by.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_12: I admire your courage but if initial reports of this construct monster are accurate, you'll need some additional help. I'll prepare a selection of battle sprites to be ready for bonding to you, {0}. We'll talk again once I've made the proper preparations.
item.properties|f.nog_blaster: One highly volatile chamber full of creamy, high-cholesterol cheer that when fired really packs a punch.
mission.properties|r.elemental_my_dear_3: I think I've got it thanks for-

item.properties|f.furni_pet_wandering_go: A festive fall snipe that will explore its surroundings.
helptips.properties|m.tg_end: Hey, you made it\! That's just great, really. You just saved me a whole lot of paperwork, so thanks. Hope those retrodes weren't too much of a surprise. Head on over to the elevator and we'll call this expedition complete.
mission.properties|m.silent_legion_1a: Have they sent you for me?  To bring me back?  No, I am where I belong now. I no longer serve the Spiral Order and will remain here. \n\nLeave this place and never come back.  Leave me be.
item.properties|f.luck_potion: A syrupy secretion said by some to strengthen serendipity. (Spiral HQ is unable to determine any actual effect.)
dungeon.properties|m.dark_city_desc: This once bustling city from an advanced world is now home to innumerable fiends from the Underworld. Under the light of the moon they burn their dark sigils into the ground, summoning more of their cohorts for reasons yet unknown.
conversation.properties|m.monster_codex_: Devilites \nDevilites are the workhorse of the underworld. If a Pit Boss catches an idle Devilite he may promote them to an angry Overtimer or a docile Yesman.
mission.properties|o.new_threat: Confront a dangerous new threat to Haven

guildhelp.properties|m.treasury_info: The Guild Treasury contains all the items and crowns collectively owned by the guild. In order to be placed within a Guild Hall, furniture must first be added to the Treasury. The costs of new rooms, items from the Birdsong Emporium and weekly upkeep are also paid from the Treasury, so guild members will have to be certain to keep the Guild Treasury full of crowns\!\n WARNING\: Anything added to the Guild Treasury can never be removed by any member of the guild, including the guild master. By adding items or crowns to the Guild Treasury, they forever become property of the guild. There are no exceptions.
item.properties|f.prize_box_almire_furni: Contains various unique Almire-themed furnishings. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|m.rc_buddyknight_1a: {0}\! I hear they've selected you to save the day, eh?  Well, before you get all 'hero' on me and go marching off into the darkness below why don't you and I go head on over to the other side of the camp and teach a few of the monsters that tore up this camp last night a lesson?
mission.properties|b.p_r9_gate_fiend: A fiendish city is a strange place that Spiral HQ still does not fully understand.  Devilites are everywhere, and if they see one of their Pit Bosses nearby, they will do anything to look like they're being productive.  Unfortunately, productivity is often defined by attacking or imprisoning intruders, like a squad of knights passing through. \n\nIt is unclear what purpose imprisoned knights would ultimately serve in a devilite agenda. Those that have survived captivity have reported that conditions were poor, but the worst of it was the copious amounts of paperwork they had to fill out daily.  This is a fate no knight deserves\!
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_4a: Heh, don't look now, {0}, but there's a ghost over your shoulder\! Let's hope these sprites haven't invested all their power into good looks. \n\nUse that one to clear the path ahead so a rescue team can get through safely\!

item.properties|f.nefarious_hood: A hood said to be crafted by a nefarious imp. The floating rune is certain to cloak you during clandestine campaigns.

With accessories, you can make your gear really stand out in a crowd, I highly suggest giving it a try.  You'll soon become the apple of every one's eye\!
conversation.properties|m.lab_knight1_1a: We salvaged what we could from the Skylark and cobbled together the rest with help from the Strangers.

mission.properties|b.the_gauntlet: One final battle stands in your way before reaching the Firestorm Citadel. Thought to be devised by Lord Vanaduke himself, this unrelenting gauntlet is teeming with all manners of dark creatures and culminates in a nightmarish battle arena that must be conquered in order to gain access to the gates of the Firestorm Citadel. \n\nThis mission will take everything you've got and requires a full arsenal of powerful weapons and gear.  If Lord Vanaduke is testing you, give him the fight that he's asking for and show him what a true Champion can do\!
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_11a: Well, that about covers the basics of the Bazaar.  It's a really fantastic place to find just about anything you need. \n\nDo you want me to go over it all again or do you think you've got it?

mission.properties|m.shadowplay_2a: Go. I will allow you to have one last moment before I destroy your meddling kind. However, should you choose to turn down my generous offer then you are welcome to come and face me in the Core where I will hasten your demise.

Spiral HQ has launched a full-scale assault on the heavily fortified castle of Warmaster Seerus, a devious gremlin of the Crimson Order. item.properties|f.metal_sonic_mask: A sinister looking mask crafted by a mechanical genius whose ability is said to rival that of even the greatest gremlin Gear Sages.
conversation.properties|r.energy_info_3b: Your lessons have energized me\! I'm off to adventure, bye\!
item.properties|f.vial_sleep_super: An ornate glass vial containing a drowsy draught. It can be used to inflict enemies with Sleep.\n\nThis particular vial looks much more dangerous than the standard. Throw it like a grenade and your foes will be snoring in seconds\!

mission.properties|b.p_toxic_plant_r6:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has uncovered a gremlin bioweapons facility deep within the Clockworks. It is believed that this facility belongs to a member of the Crimson Order known only as 'Herex.' The Recon Rangers have been tasked with infiltrating the facility and uncovering the nature of Herex's bioweapons before they are put to use.

help.properties|m.support_4: To report a bug in the game, press F2. Keep in mind that bug reports are not answered, but they include non-personal debug information that helps track down the root of the problem. If you need assistance from a GM, please file an in-game support request.

It is because of you that so many knights have returned to the surface safely and that we know so much more about the Clockworks.

Armed with your new sprite, your mission is to find this 'Collector' and rescue the knights and sprites it has taken captive.

mission.properties|o.p_r6_gate_beast: Rescue the Geo Knights from the clutches of wild beasts\!
item.properties|f.exp_east_2f: An expansion that adds two rooms and a small overlook to the eastern side of the Guild Hall.
item.properties|f.stranger_robe: A robe once worn by one of the enigmatic Strangers.  Local Snipes seem to be drawn to the wearer.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_button: If a door won't open, search under blocks for a hidden floor button to open it.
mission.properties|m.elig_unlock: You must unlock this Expansion Mission.
item.properties|f.storm_avenger_helm: A helm worn by heavenly guardians who watch over a kingdom hidden atop a snow-covered mountain.
uplink.properties|d.starter_pack: A Starter Pack is everything a Knight needs to begin their adventure on the strange, new world of Cradle. Gift it to a friend that you know will have your back\!
support.properties|m.subheader_step2_gif: We have saved the offending gift box message already waiting to be added to the complaint, so there is no need to hurry from here. Please carefully choose the correct option matching what the player did\:
item.properties|f.hexoskeleton: Protects the thorax, abdomen, and legs. No molting necessary.
item.properties|f.emberbreak_armor: Armor with a hacked elemental core aimed at resisting fire. However, this non-standard modification creates other elemental weaknesses.
mission.properties|m.anniversary_start_4: Great\!  I'll meet you near the exit once you've cleared them out.  Careful though, they seem to have adapted the use of birthday candles as weapons...
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_8a: Well, that's the end of the tour, {0}. Would you like me to go over that again or are you ready to try everything out for yourself?
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_3_2a: Well met, {0}. It is good to see you once more. \n\nNow then {0}, for your 4 Star Certification you must be currently equipped with a 4 star or greater armor, helmet, shield and weapon.
mission.properties|m.explosive_plot_1a: Congratulations {0}\!  Knight Elite huh?  Wow, you must be proud\!
item.properties|f.warmaster_helm_1: A remake of a mask once worn by Warmaster Seerus of the Crimson Order.  Made from fractured mask fragments, it only somewhat resembles the original.
mission.properties|m.creators_and_create: Hello {0}, it seems you had few problems with the oozing hordes and their like which can no doubt be chalked up to a good education on their behaviors prior to the mission.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: Then it sounds like we narrowly avoided a horrible catastrophe. If we had opened the Core and unleashed The Swarm all of Cradle might have been destroyed. Perhaps even the universe\!
mission.properties|b.p_toxic_plant_r9:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has uncovered a gremlin bioweapons facility deep within the Clockworks. It is believed that this facility belongs to a member of the Crimson Order known only as 'Herex.' The Recon Rangers have been tasked with infiltrating the facility and uncovering the nature of Herex's bioweapons before they are put to use.
conversation.properties|m.biscotti_1: Hi there, I'm Biscotti, Head Chef of the Skylark\!  We've got a little situation on our hands that may or may not involve sentient, monstrous cakes that may or may not have completely overtaken my kitchen and infested the Clockworks... \n\nAnyway, I've worked it out with the Strangers to provide rewards for turning in slices of cake that prove you've helped eradicate these horrible monsters that may or may not exist.
mission.properties|m.reporting_duty_5a: Then I now authorize you to take on Arcade Missions.  You can access the Arcade via your Mission interface or approach the gates directly here in the Arcade itself. There is a massive world beneath your feet waiting to be explored.\n\nGood luck to you\!
helptips.properties|m.back_to_haven: This path will take you back to Haven if you are not able to enter the Fiend's Grim Gate.
sprites.properties|d.iron_harness_adv: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal normal damage. \nReduces cooldown of all skills by 5% \nCan be used by\: All battle sprites
item.properties|f.woven_pathfinder_helm: A flexible helm built for mobility and interlaced with slime fibers to protect against prickly and thorny foes.
item.properties|f.spiral_brigandine: Light armor issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_6a:
Wow, this thing is a massive tower of everfrost.  I've only ever seen little handfuls of the stuff, nothing close to what we're seeing here. 

The intel we've collected so far suggests that fiends utilize large deposits of the stuff to trap the souls of the lost within it, like some kind of icy prison. 

It would seem that Maulos, that horrible arch-fiend you just took down, had a different use in mind and was actually destroying this everfrost to unleash swarms of angry, frozen souls into the Clockworks.  Had he finished the job, well, I don't even want to think about how many sweaters we would all be needing right now...
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: What little we've recovered from the Core Terminal has every Geo Knight, Biotech, and Tech Knight absolutely stumped. We'll be analyzing these findings for quite some time.
item.properties|f.vile_striker: A sneaky saber that stores a payload of poison. Its serrated edge is not meant for cutting bread\!
chat.properties|m.usage_follow: Usage\: /{0}\nTell your comrades to follow you\!
mission.properties|m.apocrea_2_6a: Good luck to you. Travel swiftly and avoid their grasp.
mission.properties|m.eye_of_needle_5a: It would seem so.  And this place, it just radiates evil, it's almost indescribable.  It's even starting to affect the levels surrounding it- fires are breaking out everywhere. \n\nYou're one of the best we've got, {0} and if there's anyone that could lead a squad through the citadel it's you.  But even reaching it won't be easy.  We're going to need to take care of a few fires and gather a bit more intel before storming the gates.
uplink.properties|m.rank_mig: Spiral Knights has recently undergone a change that has added new mission rewards to missions you have already completed. They are attached.\n\nEnjoy\!
item.properties|f.grand_tortoise: A shield empowered by the limitless fury of a tortodrone. The very plates of this colossal carapace shake as the unstable energy within waits to be unleashed.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_3_3b: I'm sorry {0}, but you currently do not meet the necessary requirements. Please speak to me again when you are currently equipped with a 4 star or greater armor, helmet, shield and weapon.
item.properties|f.clockblocker: A mechanical shield with machined wheels, pinions, and gears that mesh with exacting tolerances, making it a precision timekeeping instrument.
mission.properties|m.laboratory_visit_1a: Greetings, {0}\!  I hear you've recently arrived in Haven from across the great chasm.  While you were out there, did you encounter any of our battle sprites?
mission.properties|o.shadowplay: Discover the source of the disturbance in Firestorm Citadel
item.properties|f.slime_coin_gold: A slippery shekel exuded via protoplasmic alchemy, this coin is usable only at the Golden Slime Casino.
mission.properties|r.advanced_alchemy_2a: Wow, sounds like I have a lot to learn\!
conversation.properties|r.rc_greet2_3a: I'll meet up with Rhendon before I investigate the generator.
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_1c: No thanks, I'll explore on my own.
helptips.properties|m.party_button: The party button will activate when all living party members are standing on it.
pvp.properties|m.love_upload: Select the level type you'd like to upload.\nNote\: the file selection dialog will not be visible if you are playing full-screen.
helptips.properties|m.energy: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to spend energy on this device.
item.properties|m.item_locked: This item is bound to you.\n
item.properties|f.firefighter_helmet: Normally worn by firefighters, this helmet doesn't offer much defense but grants the wearer high fire resistance.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_3: Hi there, {0}\! As Head Chef of the Skylark I've been assigned to oversee the nutritional development of our new sprite companions. They seem to have really diversified themselves down there in the Clockworks. It will be interesting to see how they develop. \n\nDo you have any questions about feeding and caring for your sprite?
sprites.properties|d.enduring_light: Increases the duration of the ray of light.
mission.properties|m.elemental_my_dear_1: Hello again, {0}.  Spiral HQ has informed me that you are ready to learn about monsters that inflict elemental damage correct?
item.properties|d.gsc_vip: C O M P L I M E N T A R Y\n\nBecause you are a key casino patron, we are pleased to offer you membership free of charge.
conversation.properties|m.deskclerk_1a: Welcome to Moorcroft Manor, where tired spirits come to rest their legs (if applicable). If you plan on staying the night, please remember we will perform a light turn to your room every ninety-nine years, a continental breakfast is served compliments of the house every full moon and you may never leave this place for ever and ever. Enjoy your stay\!
item.properties|f.plated_shade_armor: A suit of fiendish fabric interlaced with dark matter to conceal its wearer while they creep in camoflauged corners.
item.properties|f.honor_blade_1: A ceremonial sword issued to Spiral Knight recruits. Though intended for formal occasions, its fine edge makes it suitable for combat use.
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft2_r7: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_vana: An artistic arrangement of Lord Vanaduke's mask, armor and scepter. It represents the folly of greed, the agony of despair, and how awesome fire and spikes look together.
conversation.properties|m.core_tech_2: That's easy, keep gathering minerals within the Clockworks and powering those gates within the arcade.  We need to analyze how mineral power affects the Core.  The problem is that very little power reaches down to these depths.  We can only gather so much data from each gate as it launches.
helptips.properties|m.terminal_1: Welcome traveler, this is a Clockwork Terminal. Take a moment to rest and change your gear. \n\nUse the elevator either to return to Haven or delve into a more dangerous stratum of the Clockworks.
mission.properties|o.delved_too_deep: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
item.properties|f.fowl_cowl_vol: A beaked mask shrouded in a scorched hood. Herald in the new year in this elemental gown.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: We're in\!  This is it\!
mission.properties|m.new_threat_bystande: I just heard an explosion in the back of the lab\! \n\nWe'll handle these monsters, {0}.  You go and make sure the Artifact is secure\!  Hurry\!
guild.properties|m.invite_message_name: Enter an optional message to {0} with your invitation\:
guild.properties|m.no_open_halls: There are no open Guild Halls
uplink.properties|e.already_received: That knight cannot receive another gift of this type.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_2_3a: Congratulations {0}, you meet the necessary requirements and have received your 3 Star Certification.  Take the elevator behind me in order to complete your mission.
conversation.properties|r.rfc_court_2a: Speaking of 'below', how do I get there now?  This place is collapsing\!
mission.properties|b.p_r9_gate_undead: The ruins of Owlite castles are dark and cursed places that are swarming with legions of undead spookats.  The worst of these, the seemingly invincible grimalkins, constantly lurk in the shadows, awaiting the moment your life-saving light is finally snuffed out. \n\nSome knights succumb to the darkness and become paralyzed with fear in these shadowy realms. The only thing that can save them are brave knights who have long lost their childhood fears of the dark and all the terrible creatures that lurk within.
item.properties|f.great_defender_c: A well-crafted costume version of a classic shield.
item.properties|f.robo_wrecker: A wrench-like tool thought to be of gremlin design.  Though its origin is mysterious, its abilty to destroy constructs is well-documented.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogmas: Who sent you infernal, iron assassins?  Was it Herex? It matters not. There are ways of finding out...
mission.properties|o.monstrous_research_: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
mission.properties|m.heart_of_matter_1a: Hello {0}, I've been meaning to talk to you for some time, but it seems Spiral HQ is keeping you very busy.
mission.properties|b.hall_of_heroes_1:
The Hall of Heroes is where knights go to receive their Star Certification allowing them to access deeper depths of the Clockworks.  Each certification ensures a knight meets the star level required to deal with challenges in the upcoming missions. 

The Hall of Heroes also allows knights the opportunity to speak to veteran knights and discover their loadouts, even offering the opportunity to purchase recipes for these loadouts. 

Visit the Hall of Heroes and receive your 2 Star Certification in order to obtain access to missions within deeper levels of the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.book_of_dark_rituals: An ancient grimoire filled with unspeakable eldritch rites. Just like any cursed tome, there is likely some twisted individual out there who wants it for extremely nefarious purposes. Trade with caution.
item.properties|f.prize_box_raiders: Contains one of various unique items and accessories for raiders. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|m.intro_arcade: Arcade Missions allow you to explore the ever-changing Clockworks without specific objectives. Visit the Haven Arcade to discover how you can transform the Clockworks to suit your needs\!
conversation.properties|m.npc_mineraltec: Hmm, certain combinations seem to attract different kinds of monsters.
item.properties|f.volt_breaker_helm: A Circuit Breaker Helm modified to provide further protection against shock.
mission.properties|o.p_r6_weap_2: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
projectx.properties|i.cull_transients: Prevents display of some off-screen graphics effects\npossibly speeding up graphical performance, but may\ncause some effects not to appear.
mission.properties|o.p_tortodrone_r4: Investigate the Ancient Grove and put a stop to a Fiendish plot.
helptips.properties|m.tglobby_equip: Inside the Clockworks, use Arsenal Stations to change your equipment.
helptips.properties|m.tg2_vials_1: Vials are one type of pickup. When thrown they release the alchemical agents within creating an elemental explosion. You can give them a try in the next room.
logon.properties|m.converted_to_steam: This account has been converted to Steam.  Select Use Steam Account to log on.
item.properties|f.kat_claw_cowl: A magnificently crafted cowl said to resemble the Kat Tribe hero, Scraith, first to scale the walls of the Owlite High Academy of Magicks.
item.properties|f.ultra_shock_barrier: Surrounds you with deadly orbs of lightning that can give hostiles a jolt
item.properties|f.drake_scale_shield: A solid shield shaped from stout scales.
item.properties|f.grey_feather_cowl: A downy hood made for scholars who like to get out into the field. It's softer than the most luxurious of pillows, yet extraordinarily protective.
guild.properties|m.removing_features: Removing this expansion will lower upkeep but will also remove any installed rooms or doors in the expansion. Any furnishings in the expansion will be returned to the Guild Treasury.\n\nAdditionally you will lose the following features\: {0}
guild.properties|e.cannot_invite_gm: You cannot invite a Game Master to join your guild.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_bomb: Hello {0}, I'm Remi, a knight who specializes in bombs and explosives.  The recipes I have for you are pretty straightforward- producing weapons and gear that focus on blowing up your enemies to smithereens\! \n\nUsing bombs isn't a fire and forget kind of affair though.  Bombs require an understanding of timing, both before and after you drop one, in order to get the most bang for your buck.  The gear I specialize in will make you a knight that your squad sends in to take down many enemies at once.  Bombs are great for clearing out a mob of beasties in one swift KA-BOOM\!
helptips.properties|m.mission_trap_chamb: They can be killed but often you can just avoid them.
mission.properties|m.crossing_chasm_b_7a: I'll take the artifact to the Lab.  When you're ready you should head into Haven and meet up with the rest of the crew.  I have a feeling we might be stuck on this planet for quite some time, so we might as well see what we can do to help.
mission.properties|b.prestigious_opportu: It seems you have been excelling in the eyes of Spiral HQ.  Contact Intel Agent Kora and learn how you can take on extra missions from Spiral HQ.
item.properties|f.vial_sleep: A glass vial containing a drowsy draught. It can be used to inflict enemies with Sleep.\n\nThrow it like a grenade and your foes will be snoring in seconds\!
conversation.properties|m.sl_guard_4: Good luck to you then.  Shadow Lairs will be the greatest challenge you will face yet.
mission.properties|o.p_apocrea_r4: Investigate the area of the Clockworks where several knights have gone missing.
mission.properties|r.search_continues_2a: A prison to keep something inside?
conversation.properties|m.winterfest_bra: The path of danger takes you further up this perilous mountain. For now you will pass on the cache of Grinchlin treasures stored here for a chance at an even greater haul further up the mountain. \n\nBe warned\! Should you be overcome by the challenges ahead before reaching the next shelter, you will forfeit all treasures\!
mission.properties|m.cwt_mintut_5: Minerals are used to create sprite food in the Laboratory. Sprite food is very important to the development of your sprite, so grab those minerals when you see them\!
conversation.properties|m.casino_imposto: Waiter? Oh sorry about that good sir.
item.properties|f.gold_dragon_armor: Armor once worn by a member of the 'Gold Dragons,' a squad of fearless knights that specialized in the elimination of high-profile Morai targets. After disbanding, their surviving members were united with other squads by Desna to form the Recon Rangers.
item.properties|f.slime_lockbox: A slippery, slimy lockbox won at the Golden Slime Casino.  It contains one of many special items.  It can be opened with a Slime Key or a Silver Key.
item.properties|f.spiral_sallet: A light helmet issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
item.properties|f.cosmic_dust: A portion of special food favored by battle sprites who hail from space deep beyond the furthest of stars.
conversation.properties|m.rc_virgil_2a: This walkway leads right out over a massive chasm.  Don't want you getting blown off into the oblivion below.
item.properties|f.kat_claw_cloak: A crudely crafted cloak made to resemble a cut-throat warrior of the ill-fated Kat Tribe.
mission.properties|b.p_apocrea_r4: Several capable knights have gone missing in a seemingly normal area of the Clockwork Tunnels. Spiral HQ suspects foul play and has assigned you to investigate the level.
mission.properties|m.winterfest_danger_2: Mount Krampus is the home of the Grinchlin faction and their allies. They are a very stingy lot and won't drop any loot themselves. All their treasures are stored in the shelters you'll find up the mountain.
helptips.properties|m.atg_statustraps: Beware\!  Some traps can cause damage AND inflict harmful status effects.
item.properties|f.ionized_salt_bomb: A solid chunk of rock salt with an explosive surprise inside. Jellies hate surprises.
item.properties|f.kat_suit: A clawed costume made by Moorcroft tailors. It's perfect for curious knights who are prone to pause for naps after a long night of adventuring.
item.properties|f.primal_buster: A handgun alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. While wielding it you can sense the natural energy within waiting to be unleashed.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_1a: Greetings, {0}. I imagine you have some questions about battle sprites. How can I assist you?
item.properties|f.moonstone_deposit_3: A large lump of minerals that will generate a great many units of moonstone
prologue.properties|m.preface2: We, the crew of the Skylark, fled to the stars seeking a source of incredible power, our last hope to save our homeworld.
redeem.properties|e.max_attempts: You have tried too many invalid codes. Try again in a few minutes.
item.properties|f.vial_poison_super: An ornate glass vial containing debilitating toxins. It can be used to inflict enemies with Poison.\n\nThis particular vial looks much more dangerous than the standard. Throw it like a grenade and wither the attack power of your foes\!
item.properties|f.torpor_tantrum: The ultimate sleep bomb. It's like a bedtime story, only more explodey.
conversation.properties|m.core_lead_3: Yes, Captain Ozlo himself has ordered that we hold out as long as possible and learn whatever we can.  If we ever leave this planet, it will be because of this Core.  \n\nI am confident that aside from a potential energy source, the Core is a kind of nerve center for everything you see within the Clockworks.  You can feel it in what little air is down here; a wild, ominous sense that this is no mere machine.
conversation.properties|m.npc_onwatch_b: I know they will come back.
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_b_1a: There you are, {0}\!  I was beginning to think you wouldn't show up\! \n\nOk, let's get to work securing this place.  But first, you'll need to equip that Proto Bomb I gave you.  Head over to the Arsenal Station behind me and equip it.
item.properties|f.scintillating_sun_shar: A large chunk of solar-charged Luminite primed with a potent explosive. The pyrotechnic show upon detonation is positively stunning.
exchange.properties|m.billing_success: Thank you for your purchase\! ${0} has been charged to your credit card. {1} Energy will be delivered to your energy supply momentarily.
conversation.properties|r.och_leader_4_2: It's been an honor to aid you.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_kit: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
item.properties|f.volt_breaker_shield: A Circuit Breaker Shield modified for increased protection against shock.
conversation.properties|m.npc_campknight: Have a seat and rest a while.
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: The seraphynx sounds like the battle sprite for me\!
item.properties|m.add_more_bonuses: Add more fire crystals to unlock chances for bonuses\!
mission.properties|m.legion_almire_3a: Now only death and smoke hang in the air, even from these great heights. And the fires; the unnatural fires that seem to burn eternal, the fires that turn even the most pious men into horrible nightmares, I know that these fires shall soon take me as well. \n\nI will not give my former Lord the gift of my own life.  It is not his to take, to twist. This shall be my final order.  This shall be my Justice.
item.properties|f.hatchet: A heavy blade used to chop vines and foliage in the wilderness surrounding the Rescue Camp.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_7a: It's unclear, {0}. Given Rhendon's report, I'd say they learned something from the old arcane tomes you discovered near these sprites. Fascinating that they appear to have adapted their combat abilities because of this.
conversation.properties|m.forge_knight_4: When using the Forge, you will see a list of any items that are ready to level up. Selecting an item will show you how it can be enhanced.
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_3a: Well, keep your wits about you. If the surface of this world is crawling with monsters, who knows what you'll find down there in the dark\!
social.properties|m.empty_feed: No recent event activity. Check back later.
mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_3a:
Re\: Re\: Resource allocation request, Amu-Sol 

Thank you for your prompt response.  Unfortunately your resource allocation has been denied. 

Reason\: 
Provided summary of need for requested resources\: 'All hail the great and terrifying Maulos, true lord of the Blinding Abyss.'
helptips.properties|m.tg2_vials_3: Now that you have a grasp of using pickups, let's apply what you've learned in a combat environment.
item.properties|f.shining_crystal: A rare, crystallized formation of heat used to forge higher levels of weapons and gear. The heat within burns like a star shining in the night sky.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Get inside, use the elevator...blow up whatever is controlling those cannons\!
item.properties|f.prize_box_surprise_2: Contains two randomly chosen Prize Boxes in celebration of the Spiral Order's anniversary on Cradle.  No key required to open.
item.properties|f.groundbreaker_armor: A suit of armor worn by knights who were among the first to brave the depths of the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.guild_bond: Deposit in your guild's treasury to redeem the crowns.
exchange.properties|m.mobile_tooltip: Opens a page in your browser where you can buy Energy with your mobile phone.
mission.properties|m.the_flickering_flam: That is our assumption as well. I hate to send you back into that horrible place, {0}, but if there is any hope of quickly getting to the bottom of this mystery it is you. The citadel is still very dangerous so please be careful\!
mission.properties|b.p_ghost_machine_r6:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 


Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has received a distress call from a derelict facility deep within the Clockworks. The distress call came in the form of a digital message saying only 'save us.' Believing it to be a potential trap, Spiral HQ has deployed Desna's Recon Rangers to investigate the facility and assist anyone who may have sent the message.
mission.properties|o.p_r6_kit: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.
conversation.properties|r.hav_grem_1a: Tell me what you know about the gremlins.
item.properties|f.kat_tribe_fetish: A tattered fetish from the now-extinct Kat Tribe, the ferocious feline warriors responsible for the destruction of the Owlites and their prestigious High Academy of Magicks. The fetishes were carried into battle by Kat warriors and are said to bring good luck despite the ill fate of the Kat Tribe itself.
mission.properties|b.work_idle_hands:
Devilites are a type of fiend that seem to have a very rigid corporate structure that governs their every action.  Recon Knights have discovered a series of devilite 'offices' throughout the Clockworks, typically found in the remains of an alien city. 

Analysis of the data collected from these offices indicates that devilite corporations are outsourced by gremlins in order to design and manage various projects that include weapons specifically engineered to target Spiral Knight squads. 

It's time these devilites were issued pink slips and their fiendish projects cancelled.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_ebcd68: Defeat the Royal Jelly squatting in the Royal Jelly Palace.
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_9b: Great, then I will go ahead and give you credit for this mission. \n\nRemember, if you would like to come back for more training, The Advanced Training Hall is located in Haven Town Square.  Take care out there, {0}.
item.properties|f.crimsonite_deposit_1: A small mineral deposit that will generate a single unit of crimsonite.
conversation.properties|m.mission_collec: It looks artificial, but it seems to have a sinister awareness...
steam.properties|m.convert_to_steam: Would you like to move your knights, energy, achievements, etc., to your Steam account? \nThis will allow you to log on automatically at start up as well as to take advantage of \nSteam features such as achievements, voice chat, and invites.
mission.properties|b.oilers_in_boilers:
A boiler room beneath Moorcroft Manor has been overrun by a legion of oily slimes known as 'oilers' that seem to enjoy fiery conditions.  This could prove disastrous for any levels in close proximity should the slimes enter the boilers and cause an explosion. 

Moorcroft Manor serves as an invaluable connection point into Tier 2 and its departed residents have been the most gracious of hosts.  It is in Spiral HQ's best interest to send a squad in to deal with the smoldering slimes before they create a firestorm that seals off our access to Tier 2. 

It is up to you to locate the oilers and remove them from the boilers\!
helptips.properties|m.devilish_drudgery: The office minions of the Underworld are a disgruntled lot, attacking any unauthorized personnel on sight.  While not terrible threats on their own, they can become far worse if one of their Pit Bosses gets a hold of them.  Watch out\!
conversation.properties|m.final_test_kni:
Astounding\!  I would have never expected a new recruit to crawl out of that fiery wreckage alive\!  You must really be something else... 

The name's Feron, Lieutenant of the Spiral Order.  We had believed this entire complex was derelict until the elevator leading to it suddenly surged to life.  Upon investigating the whole place soon went up in a blaze\! 

How did you end up here?
item.properties|f.freezing_pulsar: A pulsar modified with a freezing agent that grows colder over time. Pulsar shots become more powerful the further they travel.
item.properties|f.spiral_scale_helm: A light mail helm that slightly shields oneself from piercing strikes.
item.properties|f.prize_box_dangerous: Contains various unique items used by Desna's elite Recon Rangers. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\!

The Recon Rangers have been dispatched to infiltrate Amu-Sol and discover the source of these freezing storms.

mission.properties|b.p_moorcroft1:
Someone or something has summoned a horde of cursed black kats into the Clockworks. These shadowy beasts hunger for arcane power and raided the Moorcroft Manor Archives' precious collection of magical grimoires. 

In the wrong hands these ancient tomes could be catastrophic, but it turns out that black kats can't read, so they instead decided to just eat them.

The residents of Moorcroft Manor would like you to retrieve the Ancient Pages of the magical grimoires that quite likely reside in the stomachs of black kats. We'll leave you to figure out just how to recover them...

uplink.properties|m.firestorm_start:
Intel Agent Kora here, at your current depth establishing communications is difficult- I hope you receive this message.  You currently stand in the Firestorm Citadel, some kind of ancient fortress that this planet apparently like to collect.  It is an incredibly hostile region of the Clockworks, you will not last long without the right gear and a talented squad. 

We have detected a faint signal that indicates some kind of artifact of the Alpha Squad's expedition is located within the throne room of this citadel.  We need you to recover this artifact- it could be a valuable clue for discovering their current whereabouts. 

I won't lie to you, no squad that has taken this mission has managed to return from the citadel.  As you have no doubt seen, the place burns with an unnatural fire and a legion of similarly unnatural horrors roam every hall.  Now may be a good time to turn back and craft some fire-resistant gear.  A trial by fire will only get you burned. 

Good luck\!

uplink.properties|m.tf2_start:
G'Day, loyal customer\! 

You may have recently heard that I've become the fourth richest man in America, having surpassed the fifth richest man in wealth, and having killed the previously-fourth richest man in a harpoon duel. While this is, of course, entirely true (especially the part about the harpoon duel, which was long and bloody), it's not nearly enough. Fourth place might be fine for HIPPIES who wouldn't know victory if it wandered up and offered to braid their ponytails, but it's damn well not good enough for Saxton Hale\! 

Mister Reddy, my accountant, explained to me that the best way to light a fire under the backside of Mann Co.'s revenue would be to "open up new markets". I'd relate exactly how we plan on doing that to you, but as he was talking I immediately started doing military presses to keep from dying of boredom, and missed out on the intricate details. 

All you need to know, dear customer, is that I need a good man to find his way to a town called "Haven", bravely stride into one of the many gates there and then cut his way down to the first "Clockworks Terminal". Since we couldn't find a good man, you'll have to do it yourself. You'll be amply rewarded, of course\: there's NOTHING I wouldn't do for an employee who risked life and limb on a trivial task necessitated by my selfish whims. 

Don't bother directly contacting me once you're done, as I'll be too busy kickboxing giraffes to care. One of my other employees will handle things from there. Best of luck\: you'll need it\! 

Sincerely yours, 

SAXTON HALE 
Australian 
CEO, Mann Co.
