guildhelp.properties|m.guild_hall_info:
The Guild Hall is the nerve center for any Spiral Knights guild. Here, guild members can relax, plan future missions, and take advantage of the various Guild Hall amenities at their disposal. The Guild Hall is extremely customizable, and can be expanded to fit guilds of all sizes. It can also contain a wide variety of unique furniture and room types, so coordinate with your friends to make your Guild Hall a true reflection of your guild\!
 When a Guild Hall is first opened, it consists of two rooms\: a lobby, and the Command Console room. Guilds wishing for more space to customize can purchase expansions to increase the base size of their guild hall. These are available from the Command Console while in Design Mode.
 Guilds that have expanded the usable space in their Hall can fill that space with a variety of different rooms, available for purchase from the Birdsong Emporium. These rooms can be as simple as an empty room for placing furniture, or they can contain one of a number of different guild amenities, such as alchemy terminals, shops and more\!
 Guild Halls require a large amount of resources to maintain, which is represented by a weekly upkeep cost in Crowns. As a Guild Hall gains more expansions, this cost increases, so make sure there's enough Crowns in your Guild Treasury to pay for everything\!

Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has uncovered a gremlin bioweapons facility deep within the Clockworks. It is believed that this facility belongs to a member of the Crimson Order known only as 'Herex.' The Recon Rangers have been tasked with infiltrating the facility and uncovering the nature of Herex's bioweapons before they are put to use.

mission.properties|b.skies_under_cradle: The Clockworks are a fascinating underground complex that houses entire worlds within its colossal, iron geo-globes.  One of them that recon knights have discovered is known as the 'Aurora Isles,' a series of mysterious floating islands under a false sky. \n\nAs a newly ranked Apprentice, you now have clearance to explore the ruins within these islands and collect any useful materials you may discover.
item.properties|f.slumber_squall: A powerful alchemical bomb that creates a thick fog of sleepy mist.
helptips.properties|m.mission_trap_chamb: All drones clad in gold armor are invincible.
auction.properties|m.start_recipe: Select a learned recipe to search for the ingredients.
sprites.properties|d.plentiful_pain: Increases the bonus duration of hexing haze as additional targets are acquired.
mission.properties|m.occurance_at_owlite:
...returning as something unnatural... 

...endless inferno.... 

...Almire destroyed... 

...they can never leave, they can never escape the flames...
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_2a: Do Strangers sell anything else besides weapons and gear?
pvp.properties|m.coins_awarded_message: You were awarded Krogmo Coins for participation in {0}\!
helptips.properties|m.loading3: You can revive another player by clicking on their portrait and granting them a Spark of Life
chat.properties|m.usage_level_up: Usage\: /{0} (weapon armor helmet shield) [crystals]\nAttempts to level up the specified equipment using fire crystals.
sprites.properties|d.protection: Increases the defensive powers of the angelic aura.
mission.properties|r.explosive_plot_3a: It's because the Strangers took us in that they're now targeted...
item.properties|f.polar_day_warden_hood: An insulated hood that will keep a knight warm when facing bitter polar winds. The full coverage mask makes it ideal for hours of daytime watch duty.
item.properties|f.volt_breaker_armor: Upgraded Circuit Breaker Armor further hacked to resist shock.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_4: Feeding your battle sprite is easy\! Simply open up your battle sprite interface and select your sprite icon. From there you can select a material from your arsenal to drop into the feeding tray. \n\nOnce you've queued up a material for your sprite to synthesize, simply click 'feed to sprite' and bon appetite\!
mission.properties|m.pioneers_3a: When our technicians finally got the Skylark's communications systems online, we could not establish a link with the Alpha Squad and they have never been heard from since. Their channel is completely dead. \n\nTheir dead line is what has us all scratching our heads.  Our comlinks are built to withstand all manners of extreme conditions, even explosions.  Heck, they survived the Skylark going down after all.  There's nothing I can think of that could kill the link completely.
item.properties|m.hatch_egg_prompt: The Battle Sprite inside will bind to you upon opening.
item.properties|f.glowing_crystal: A rare, crystallized formation of heat used to forge higher levels of weapons and gear. The heat within burns bright enough to light a darkened room.
conversation.properties|r.final_test_kni: Thank you, Lieutenant, I'll head on into Haven.
uplink.properties|m.title: SPIRAL UPLINK
exchange.properties|m.anonymous_purchasi: Purchasing is disabled until you create an account.
item.properties|f.furni_bench_manor: An exquisite bench, perfect for perching in plush repose.
support.properties|m.sent_mail: Sent mail with subject "{0}" to knight {1}.
conversation.properties|m.hav_mecha_1a: I got a great deal on this broken mecha knight. If I can just figure out how to get it working properly I'll have myself a personal bodyguard for my expeditions into the Clockworks.
mission.properties|m.anniversary_start_3: In any case it would seem that this new 'recipe' caused the cakes to turn into horrible monsters that have overtaken my kitchen and infested the Clockworks.  I'd like to have my kitchen back, so could you please assist me in destroying these horrible Creep Cakes?
uplink.properties|m.metal_sonic: Thank you for purchasing Sonic CD on Steam\!  Attached is your Metal Sonic Suit and Mask.  These items are costumes that can be equipped over any armor allowing you to look like Metal Sonic whenever you like\! \n\nPlease note, gear can only be equipped in towns or at an Arsenal Station.  If you are a new recruit and have just emerged from your crash pod, make your way to the Rescue Camp.  Once you reach the Rescue Camp you can equip your Metal Sonic Suit and Mask.
item.properties|f.plate_mail: A clinking, clanking, cumbersome armor suitable for withstanding a clobbering.
mission.properties|r.reporting_duty_2a: If we could somehow harness that power...
mission.properties|b.first_contact: You have escaped your crash pod and reached a Rescue Camp just as the sun set across the alien landscape.  Using your comlink, it is now time to establish contact with Spiral HQ.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_partypad_2: This is a party pad. It's a big floor button that only activates when all members of the party are standing on it. They often open doors, but sometimes there is a little more to it than that...
item.properties|f.mercurial_demo_suit: A demo suit made from gremlin technology. It is for the bomber that wants a boost of speed, more power and a greatly reduced chance of dying by electrocution... which is probably every bomber out there.
support.properties|m.option_210_1: If you're sure the other options didn't cover your complaint, and you're sure the player broke our Terms of Service, then please enter a short explanation here for what your complaint is.
item.properties|f.furni_clutter_skescape: A piece of Spiral technology used to escape disabled starships. They're very cramped inside.
exchange.properties|m.billing_duplicate: Your credit card is starting to smoke from overuse. Please let it rest for just a few minutes and try again.
prologue.properties|m.helmsman_warning: Captain\! Energy signatures are shifting\! I've never seen anything like-
conversation.properties|m.casino_pitboss: I just put in another bulk order for office supplies. We keep running out.
helptips.properties|m.candlestick_keep: Beware the horrible Grimalkins that lurk in the dark\!  These cursed wraiths cannot be destroyed and the only thing they truly fear is the light of the enchanted candles.  Light them with embers and take refuge in their shining embrace.
item.properties|f.piggy_banker: A small volatile bank that is sure to burn a hole in your enemies' pockets.
conversation.properties|m.rc_injured_b: One of those mechanical monsters got me.  The cursed thing's claws tore right through my armor\!
item.properties|m.in_style_kit: (This modifier is also present in your style kit.)
conversation.properties|m.hav_grem_3c: Most of them will attack you on sight, but there are some; outcasts from the colony, that have taken refuge in the towns below the surface. Theirs is a hard life, hated by their own kind and no longer in a world they call home.
mission.properties|m.chasm_b_rhendon_1a: Looks like we've got no choice, {0}.  This gizmo isn't worth dying over.
chat.properties|m.usage_zgo: Usage\: /{0} zone name\nMoves to the named zone.
conversation.properties|m.almire_histori: We've recovered what little remains from Owlite Keep concerning the Kingdom of Almire. Combined with the snippets we've gotten from the nature sprites within Firestorm Citadel itself, we are starting to get a clearer picture of Almire's history.
item.properties|f.fierce_flamberge: A scorching saber whose main thrust is to rotisserie your foes.
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research_: By now you have likely collected some interesting materials in the first stratum of the Clockworks that would be useful to Spiral HQ.  Help advance their continued research of the mysteries of Cradle by donating materials.
conversation.properties|m.winterfest_cam: Those Grinchlins are tricky and unpredictable. I'd recommend bringing a variety of gear just to be prepared for whatever they might throw at you.
mission.properties|m.apocrea_2_2a: I'm just another soul hiding from the gaze of the Apocrea. But I refuse to give up. Until they find me I will do anything I can to save another soul from my fate.
mission.properties|r.pioneers_3a: Where do I come in to all of this?
conversation.properties|m.npc_campguard_: I'm here keeping watch.  You never know when monsters might attack.
mission.properties|m.search_continues_5a: I haven't given up the search for Euclid, Parma, Grantz and Rulen.  They're out there somewhere and I will find them, even if it means entering the Core myself.
guild.properties|i.charter: View important information about this guild.
item.properties|f.prize_box_polar: Contains various unique costumes and accessories popular in the polar regions. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
conversation.properties|m.core_lead_4: I'm saying that we know this entire world isn't natural, and I for one don't believe that those hordes of miserable gremlins, no matter how industrious, could have built an entire world.  They had to have been aided by something far beyond their measure and perhaps whatever that is lies within the Core. \n\nThe same goes for the Alpha Squad.  They wouldn't just disappear, even within the furthest depths of the Clockworks.  They were our very best.  It was this Core that swallowed them.
logon.properties|m.paying_customers_only: This server is only available to customers who have spent at least $4.95 on Energy in the last three months.
item.properties|m.open_box_prompt: Prize Boxes contain random prizes inside.
item.properties|f.furni_library_lectern_: A podium perfect for pondering over many a quaint and curious volume of forgotten lore.
item.properties|f.heavenly_iron_helm: A powerful helm said to be crafted from angelic shields.  It retains many divine properties celestial beings possess but lacks their weakness to fire.
mission.properties|o.choose_your_sprite: Talk to Morlin and choose a battle sprite as your companion
item.properties|f.frost_gun: A modified Proto Gun augmented with a low intensity, alchemical freezing agent.
uplink.properties|m.confirm_att_account: This is an account-wide mail, you can read it with any of your knights but the attachment can only be accepted once.\n\nAccept the attachment now?
item.properties|f.auction_room: A businesslike room providing access to the Haven Auction House.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_weap_2: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
mission.properties|r.elemental_my_dear_3: Once again you talked pretty fast, can you go over it-
item.properties|f.vial_poison: A glass vial containing debilitating toxins. It can be used to inflict enemies with Poison.\n\nThrow it like a grenade and wither the attack power of your foes\!
mission.properties|r.honor_duty_2a: I hope her findings produce something meaningful.
item.properties|f.dark_thorn_shield: A gloomy guard that gives one's sword strikes a supernatural savagery.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_4_3b: I'm sorry {0}, but you currently do not meet the necessary requirements. Please speak to me again when you are currently equipped with a 5 star or greater armor, helmet, shield and weapon.
item.properties|f.kat_claw_hood: A crudely hewn hood made to resemble a cut-throat warrior of the ill-fated Kat Tribe.

mission.properties|o.p_r3_gate_fiend: Free the captured Knights from a fiendish corporate prison\!

conversation.properties|r.test_greeter_1: I shall do my best in this test\!

item.properties|f.furni_trophy_battlesta: A magnificent display commemorating a knight's ascension to the highest echelon of the Spiral Order.

mission.properties|b.crossing_chasm_b: Having restored power to the Rescue Camp and established contact with Spiral HQ, it's time you attempted to cross the chasm north of the Rescue Camp and reach Haven where the rest of the Spiral Knights have taken refuge. \n\nIn order to cross the chasm you will need to take an elevator down into the Clockworks and find another to bring you up on the other side.  There's no telling what dangers lurk in the dark depths below so Rhendon will be accompanying you on your journey.
item.properties|f.owlite_wand: They say the wand chooses the wizard, so don't let this one see your cute friend.
sprites.properties|d.ray_of_light: Fires a concentrated beam of light that damages anything passing through it.

help.properties|m.clockworks_2: The depths below Haven can be classified into three progressively challenging Tiers. Be sure to equip Tier-appropriate gear when venturing forth, and remember\: the greatest treasures the Clockworks have to offer are far underground near the planet's Core, so delve deep\!

guild.properties|m.invite_name: Enter the name of the knight you wish to invite\:
item.properties|f.confetti: Use this item to throw it into the air and celebrate good times. Come on\!

By entering you will not be able to turn back until you complete the challenges within.\n\nHowever, should you manage to come out victorious you will be rewarded for your bravery. Enter at your own risk\!
item.properties|f.seraphic_mail: A beautiful mail coat that causes its wearer to strike out at evil with righteous fury.
conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_7a: (You sense great pride coming from the fallen knight, but he says no more and stares off into the distance towards a lifetime that only he sees.)
item.properties|f.helm_side: An accessory that can be attached to the side of select helmets.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: {0}, you've already done so much for all of us but I must now ask you to make one final sacrifice. We might never have a chance to return home to Isora, but right now Cradle needs us. I would like you to spearhead our Operations on Cradle.
shop.properties|m.purchaseWindowDepotAd: Out of energy? Get more in the supply depot\!

item.properties|f.toxic_core: A solid, pulsating lump that oozes with vitriol.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_5: A sprite's appetite will increase naturally over time, though slowly. To increase appetite quickly, take it for a run in the Clockworks. Absorbing heat from monsters is a great way to burn calories\!
item.properties|f.empty_room_checker_sma: An empty Guild Hall room with a checkerboard pattern on the floor.
dungeon.properties|m.battle_arena_desc: Said to be watched by countless drifting souls for entertainment, Battle Arenas offer escalating challenges for the brave warriors who wish to claim the treasure of the Arena King.
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_b_7a:
What the heck was that?  Where did that door come from? 

It would seem that this mechanical world beneath our feet has it in for us, {0}. Better watch yourself\! 

Anyway, I think this area is secure, at least until night fall.  Let's head back to camp.
mission.properties|m.expansion_purchase_:
By purchasing an Expansion, you will unlock the missions included in the Expansion to play as often as you like. 

Unlocking an Expansion unlocks it for all knights on the account. 

Only players who have unlocked an Expansion Mission may join an Expansion Mission. 

Expansion Mission rewards cannot be sold, dropped or traded.
item.properties|f.onesie: One size fits all. Machine washable, heavy duty cycle. Air dry only.
item.properties|f.luminite: A fabled mineral of a radiant, golden color said to contain the faith, wisdom and zeal of the life surrounding it.
mission.properties|r.advanced_alchemy_3a: Thanks Bosco\!  I'll gather some recipes and get crafting\!
mission.properties|b.shopping_again: Bechamel has already given you a tour of the Haven Bazaar that included where to acquire new weapons, armor and recipes.  Now it's time to pay him another visit and learn about some of the more advanced services the Bazaar offers. \n\nYou will pay a visit to Punch and Vise, Brinks and even visit Bechamel's own shop\!
item.properties|f.hailstone: A small rock that's always a little cold to the touch. It's great for chilling beverages without diluting their flavor.
item.properties|f.supply_deluxe_compact: A package of useful supplies valued by Spiral Knight research teams working deep within the Clockworks.  This deluxe pack has enough supplies to last an entire squad of Knights one week.
item.properties|f.dark_shard: A shard of Dark Matter that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
helptips.properties|m.tg_pots: Some objects can be picked up and used or even thrown across the room. Try throwing a pot at that switch.
item.properties|f.prize_box_blazing: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Blazing style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.magmatic_fanatic_mask: A mask said to have been worn by fanatics that worshiped a magma god. Its fires will light the path to victory.
item.properties|f.dragon_scale: An armored scale from what was thought to be an extinct creature. It reflects light with an otherworldly sheen.
item.properties|f.crimsonite: A fabled mineral of a fiery, red color said to contain the passion, anger and strength of the life surrounding it.
item.properties|f.owlite_robe: A costume recreation of the fine robes worn by Owlites, based on the most recent archaeological findings.
guild.properties|m.treasury_warning: WARNING\: Deposits made to the Treasury cannot be removed. Please review carefully before confirming.
conversation.properties|m.npc_teaser_kni: This last mission sure was a strange one. We were clearing the way to an elevator when we saw some odd structures off in the distance. We couldn't see any way to reach them though.  I guess we'll just have to keep an eye out for them in the future.  The Clockworks is ever-shifting after all.
item.properties|f.ranger_signal_flare: A flare that signals a nearby Recon Ranger to provide support fire
conversation.properties|r.lab_biscotti_4: Where can I acquire these items?
mission.properties|r.mission_sprite_3_11: I'll put an end to their scheme.
item.properties|f.slicer: Energy spikes go in. Flying razor disks of barely-understood primordial energy come hurtling out\!  And look out for that extra-peppy boomerang effect...
item.properties|m.prize_box_rose_regalia: Rose Regalia Returns Again Prize Box
item.properties|f.owlite_mask: A mask of an owlite scholar. The Kats of Moorcroft have assured us with confidence that this reconstruction matches their "grotesque and feathered visage".
conversation.properties|m.rc_warning_1a: Up these stairs lies the gate to Haven. Be sure to talk to Virgil before you enter so you know what to expect.
mission.properties|b.king_of_ashes:
Within the ever-burning depths of the Firestorm Citadel, Lord Vanaduke lies in wait for any living being to pass into his accursed kingdom.  Any squad that has ever attempted to infiltrate the citadel has perished or was simply lost, like the countless lost souls bound to this terrible realm. 

Lord Vanaduke is ready for war, believing in his twisted mind that any who dare enter the citadel to be an invading force bent on overtaking his kingdom.  He stands as the last obstacle before gaining access to the Core and the Spiral Knights having any chance of restoring the Skylark and returning home. 

As a Champion of the Spiral Knights, you alone have what it takes to lead a team into the very heart of this inferno and face the titanic might of Lord Vanaduke.
mission.properties|o.go_shopping: Visit the Haven Bazaar and discover what it has to offer
item.properties|f.quilted_hunting_cap: A flexible helm lined with luxurious stay-alert quilting. It smells like animal.
conversation.properties|m.emberlight_vis: None know for sure. Tinkinzar not seen for many many years. Crimson Order carries out Tinkinzar's plans for Cradle. Emberlight was blight on master plan because built by outcasts. Haven probably the same, founded by non-gremlins. Not part of plan\!
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_gamepad_1: Gamepad used for targeting, attacking, movement, advanced commands and quickslots
pvp.properties|m.upload_wait: A file picking window is trying to show...
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: So, you have chosen the radiant seraphynx, battle sprite of those who wish to protect their party and provide them aid? \n\nOnce you choose there is no going back\!
conversation.properties|m.energy_info_1a: Do you know what the most important resource on Cradle is? ENERGY\! That's right my friend, something so special it's worth shouting about\! Want to know about this super important stuff? I happen to be an expert on the subject\!
mission.properties|b.dreams_and_nightmar: Respond to the distress signal from the Core Terminal. We have no intel on what to expect. \nThis is a dangerous mission. Prepare for anything.
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_2a: Missions range from dangerous combat engagements to talking to certain people, such as myself.  By completing missions, you'll earn progress towards new ranks, which will in turn give you access to increasingly powerful gear.  Greta informed me that you'll be tackling our power supply problem in the Ancient Generator?
item.properties|f.wolver_mask: A simple mask made from wolver pelt.
item.properties|f.stellar_sentinel_suit: This suit was was once worn by Isoran starfarers of eons long passed that stood watch over extrasolar operations. With this equipped, you feel like you could dive into the heart of a star.
mission.properties|m.intro_rank: Rank Missions are the main campaign of Spiral Knights. Completing Rank Missions earns you rewards and allows you to achieve higher ranks as a Spiral Knight.
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_b_: The inhabitants native of Haven are called 'Strangers.' You can't miss them- they're the towering, cloaked figures with masks. Despite their intimidating appearance, they have been extremely helpful to us and mostly keep to themselves. The odd, little birds in town certainly seem to like them anyway\!
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_cj_wasd_mo: Mouse used for targeting, attacking and menu navigation
item.properties|f.plasma_capacitor: The addition of an advanced Spiral power source gives this bomb a shockingly large blast radius.
projectx.properties|m.reboot_warning_pen: The server will be rebooted in under {0} minutes. {1}
item.properties|f.cold_iron_carver: An enchanted sword crafted from cold iron whose blade wards off the creatures of the dark.
mission.properties|r.new_chapter_3a: Thanks Kora, I'll do my best\!
mission.properties|b.p_r6_mat_2: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
board.properties|m.gate_closed: Sorry, that gate is no longer open.
chat.properties|m.emote_self: You can't do that to yourself.
mission.properties|m.new_chapter_2a: We can't say for sure just yet, but it would seem as though that however Cradle was formed, it included large pieces of other worlds around it.  If this is true then we've never seen anything like this before.
item.properties|f.furni_beacon_floor_yel: A Spiral-issued light source typically used to recommend caution.
item.properties|f.ticktocktop: Enough complications to make your head spin.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_5a: That's right, you can acquire recipes and materials in order to alchemize weapons and gear at alchemy stations.  Come on, I'll show you one.
social.properties|m.autofriend_multiple_: You have {0} friends playing Spiral Knights\!
item.properties|f.wildfire: An elite handgun that can offer a tremendous surprise for the enemy on the battlefield as its small charges of energy transform into raging wildfires. Wildfire shots become more powerful the further they travel.
support.properties|m.option_210_0: You should only be using this option if none of the other options covers your complaint. Click here to go back and see if the other options might be useful.
item.properties|f.winmillion: An ornate blade that propels bolts of energy outward with every swing. Inexperienced users have been known to cut themselves when first practicing with it.
helptips.properties|m.tg2_end: Great job\! With another successful run through the Training Grounds you should be getting the hang of things by now. It won't be long before you are exploring the depths of the Clockworks on your own.
mission.properties|m.pierce_of_cake_1a: Hello there, {0}.  Spiral HQ has informed me that you will be needing a quick lesson in the species of monsters within the Clockworks that inflict piercing damage, yes?
chat.properties|m.usage_guild: Usage\: /{0} message\nSends a message to all guild members.
mission.properties|m.intro_prestige: Prestige Missions are bonus missions offered to you daily. Completing Prestige Missions earns you prestige.
item.properties|f.exp_center_4f: An expansion that adds a small central room to the Guild Hall.
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_2_1: Well done, {0}\!  That was quite a fireworks show\!  Thanks to you we've been able to clear that accursed landing zone and move our base of operations up to inner gates\!
social.properties|m.join_guild: Join your guildmate {0} at depth {1} in the {2} Gate\!
mission.properties|m.new_threat_12a: Hmm, most of our sensor equipment seems to have been damaged.  It might take some time to get things working to the point where I can track down the Artifact.  While we work on that, you should get in contact with one of our Biotechs, Hahn.  He's a little rough around the edges, but he can help you prepare for the challenges you'll likely face. \n\nI'll contact you later as soon as I have my tracking equipment back online\!
item.properties|f.plate_helm: A heavy duty helm suited for heavy combat.
item.properties|f.honor_shield_3: A ceremonial shield issued to Champions of the Spiral Order. Though intended for formal occasions, its solid construction makes it suitable for combat use.
item.properties|f.grey_feather_mantle: A cloak for renowned Owlite scholars, this feathery frock is filled with the wisdom of the ages... and is super soft\!
support.properties|m.option_208_0: If a player is trying to get your account name or password from you right now, or already did and is admitting to this in chat, you should click here to file a complaint.
helptips.properties|m.recon: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to activate Recon Module.
dungeon.properties|m.terminal_core_desc: A small terminal in the darkest depths of the Clockworks that looks out on to the colossal, ever-beating heart of the world.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: So, you have chosen the shadowy maskeraith, battle sprite of those who wish to lurk in the shadows and strike the enemy with sneak attacks? \n\nOnce you choose there is no going back\!
item.properties|f.reset_star: A special sprite food that resets applied skill points and reverts any ultimate skill selection.
mission.properties|r.eye_of_needle_3a: And why is it now blocking access to the Core, now that we're so close?
projectx.properties|e.name_too_long: Sorry, the name is too long.
projectx.properties|m.opening_billing_ur: Opening energy depot site in your web browser...
item.properties|f.spark_plug: A small, mechanical component that really gets a construct's motor running.
social.properties|m.trader_busy: Oops\! That player is otherwise occupied.
item.properties|f.capsule_health_ultra: A capsule that restores an extreme amount of health. Never leave home without one\!
item.properties|d.furni_lay: USE\: Have a quick lie down.
dungeon.properties|m.golden_slime_prize_: Each spin of the wheel rewards you with a random prize, sometimes including very special items\! Requires 50 Golden Slime Coins or equivalent crowns.
item.properties|f.reaper_rib: A bone stained black by the wickedness of its former possessor.
item.properties|m.use_change_eye: Use your {0} to change your eyes?
monster.properties|m.fired_2: Your productivity is down .03% this week. You're fired.
mission.properties|m.intro_reward_presti: Select a mission card to receive a mission briefing, see the available rewards and enable options for starting the mission\!
item.properties|f.winter_pullover: A not-so-stylish sweater for the snowy season. The perfect pullover to embarass your family and guildmates alike.
item.properties|f.wooly_pullover: A stylish sweater for the pre-snowy season. {0}
helptips.properties|m.atg_heat: Pick up HEAT to level up your items and make them better over time\!
mission.properties|o.becoming_champion: Speak with Lieutenant Feron via Comlink
item.properties|f.nether_cannon: A handgun alchemized from the shell of a corrupted tortodrone. A tormented howl of rage can be heard on the wind when it is unleashed upon your foes.
item.properties|f.royal_jelly_mail: A viciously viscous set of armor crafted painstakingly from the most noble specimens of quivering slime.
item.properties|f.swimsuit_trunks: A pair of spiral issue trunks intended for coastal expeditions and fun in the sun.
conversation.properties|m.arc_mintut_5: Minerals are used to create sprite food in the Laboratory. Sprite food is very important to the development of your sprite, so grab those minerals when you see them\!
conversation.properties|m.casino_klepto_: I won't steal anything... I promise\!
mission.properties|m.becoming_champion_4: I mean that the Core isn't a big battery that runs this world, but rather it and the whole of this world is a massive prison designed to keep something from ever leaving. \n\nThink about our geo-scans of Cradle just before the crash- they show it as being composed of hundreds of massive slabs of other worlds, almost like plates of armor.  Then you have the Clockworks, the most unnatural thing I've ever seen.  An entire world whose sole purpose seems to be stopping anyone from ever reaching its Core.
item.properties|m.equip_locked: Equipping {0} will bind it to you. You will not be able to trade this item once bound. Are you sure?
item.properties|f.misplaced_promissory_n: An old document promising to pay a sum at a date long gone. Grants Normal Defense and increased Defense with decreased health.
item.properties|f.blight_needle: It's a proven fact that even the most virulent of toxins is a lot more contagious if it's fired indiscriminately over a large area.
item.properties|f.dread_skelly_shield: A large, bony bulwark bathed in blackish brume. It occasionally issues a quiet, forlorn whisper, usually about remembering to block.
mission.properties|r.the_flickering_flam: That gremlin Herex must be involved.
mission.properties|m.apocrea_2_1a: What's this? You still have your body. Perhaps you can help us.
helptips.properties|m.scenario_fiendbook: Four Ways to Bring About the End of the World
item.properties|f.kat_eye_raiment: A reclaimed raiment said to resemble the Kat Tribe hero, Preowa, whose artillery silenced the Grey Feather Tower Sages.
item.properties|f.maskeraith_pod: A sprite pod containing a level 1 Maskeraith Battle Sprite. \n\nThe Maskeraith is a battle sprite that embodies the shadows. Its skills focus on subterfuge and deadly toxins.
conversation.properties|m.ritual_4a: Well, that was unexpected. I'll get it right next time\!
item.properties|f.quicksilver_mail: A fine set of mail made out of what was once a Quicksilver.
helptips.properties|m.sl_elevator_active: Shadow Key required to open.\nShadow Keys can be acquired randomly in lockboxes or purchased from the Supply Depot.
item.properties|f.volcanic_demo_suit: Highly protective gear for the cutting-edge demolition man. The internal cooling system makes you feel a little like you've been cryogenically frozen.
item.properties|f.hunters_lodge_room: A monster hunting lodge curated by the great hunter, Armero. Contains a guild alchemy machine containing monster trophy recipes. Guild alchemy machines use resources from the Guild Treasury and deposit results into the Guild Treasury.
conversation.properties|m.npc_veteran_f: I keep a sword around for close encounters.
mission.properties|r.hall_of_heroes_1_1a: I was told I am to receive Star Certification here?
item.properties|f.heavy_gear: A weighted gear that previously assisted in the operation of an enormous machine.
item.properties|f.confetti_fall_equinox: When thrown, this fall confetti bursts with autumn embers.
helptips.properties|m.need_key_grim_gate: The Grim Gate requires a Fiendish ID Card to activate.
item.properties|f.gh_theme_poison: A very unique theme that gives your Guild Hall all the beauty and ambiance of a sewage system.
support.properties|m.item_granted_messag: You have been granted an item. Click below to claim.
item.properties|f.almire_rug: This rare rug was removed from the remains of a regal residence.
helptips.properties|m.rescue_door_sk: I've almost got this door open. While I'm working at it, rescue the captive knights in the area\!
conversation.properties|m.atg_guard: Greetings\!  Beyond this door you will find the advanced training hall. As a Spiral Knight, you are free to use it to practice your skills and learn more about the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.obsidian_mantle_of_dev: 'Wrap thy self in my embrace and succumb to my infinite love. Let your breath drift from you like candle smoke, dreaming deeper and deeper still.'
mission.properties|o.p_r4_gate_fiend: Free the captured Knights from a fiendish corporate prison\!
dungeon.properties|m.starlight_cradle_de: Beneath a moonlit sky azure islands drift in a sea of stars. These islands are home to creatures that are more than happy to creep upon those that succumb to this world's endless lullaby.
item.properties|f.valiant_visor: A lightweight visor for scouting and skirmishing, often highly accessorized.
helptips.properties|m.scenario_compound_: The others must never know.  Silence them. -H
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_1a: You made it, {0}\!  I'm happy to see you arrive here in Haven safe and sound.  I'll confirm with Spiral HQ that you will now be undertaking missions in Haven.  To start, I've issued you a few missions that will help get you acclimated with all that Haven has to offer.  Be sure to say hello to the Strangers as you begin exploring.
social.properties|m.pvp_played: become the new Coliseum Champion, having played {0} games of {1} in the past 7 days\!
item.properties|f.rock_jelly_shield: Crafted from the most adamant of slimy specimens, it also functions as an emergency source of calories for stranded knights.
item.properties|f.celestial_shield: Cradle's equinox inspired the dual nature of this specialist shield, which protects against the dazzling light of day and the chill of night in equal measure.
item.properties|f.moonstone_deposit_4: A mother lode of metalliferous minerals that will generate a jackpot of moonstone.
conversation.properties|r.hav_clock_2d: On second thought, I've got some adventuring to do. Bye\!
mission.properties|m.new_threat_bystande: Careful in there.  Looks like they had a big one with them...
mission.properties|m.target_acquired_1a: Hello {0}, I hope you're ready for me to send you out into the lion's den once more.
item.properties|f.furni_wardrobe_sklocke: A locked cabinet containing currently unequipped clothing and armor.
helptips.properties|m.loading1: The Clockworks below the surface cycle levels in real time. You will never see all the levels a world has to offer in a single trip. Only a true adventurer will discover all the secrets\!
support.properties|m.request_updated_mai: Your support request regarding {0} has been updated.
dungeon.properties|m.scarlet_fortress_de: Named for its vibrant tapestries, the Scarlet Fortress is a deconstructed mass of a forgotten castle, drifting endlessly in the void of the Clockworks. Strange bestial ghosts haunt its long corridors, tirelessly pursuing those that enter their domain.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_3: When you acquire a recipe and use it, it consumes the recipe, but logs it in your 'known' recipes forever\!  Once it's known, you can create as many items of that recipe as you wish, so long as you have the right materials.
item.properties|f.paper_mask: A simple paper {0} mask made to celebrate the Dark Harvest Festival. It's not well made and eventually falls apart.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_2: Ok, here is the gist of it all- collect materials and recipes and turn them into weapons and gear.  Easy right?
helptips.properties|m.atg_torto: Tortodrones can be found patrolling the Clockworks.  They will not attack unless attacked first - but be warned, once they are enraged, they are fearsome and deadly opponents.
item.properties|f.nitronome: An advanced explosive issued to only the most elite Spiral Knight grenadiers. It's made from a synthetic substance that ticks ominously even when unarmed.
mission.properties|m.honor_duty_2a: I've read your report of the Core, it's fascinating.  What an impossible structure and to think that the Alpha Squad might actually still be alive but... inside that thing is just incredible. \n\nI understand that Lieutenant Vaelyn has already led a team to the Core terminal and is establishing a base of operations for research.  This is of great value to all Spiral Knights and we have you to thank\!
item.properties|f.big_beast_basher: It was suggested that this brutally sharp mining pick could probably be used to hunt both beasts AND minerals. The Clockworks were never the same.
conversation.properties|m.npc_lostknight: I could leave but think of all I could learn if I stayed\!
mission.properties|b.delved_too_deep: The truth has been revealed. It's time to update Intel Agent Kora and Spiral HQ about what you and Lieutenant Vaelyn have learned.
item.properties|f.medieval_war_helm: A heaume sturdily built to last for a hundred years of war.
guild.properties|m.remove_expansion: Removing this expansion will lower upkeep but will also remove any installed rooms in the expansion. Any furnishings in the expansion will be returned to the Guild Treasury.\nYou will lose the following rooms\: {0}
mission.properties|m.rc_buddyknight_4a: Accept my mission and let's get to work blowing some stuff up\!
item.properties|f.pith_helm: A simple but effective helm favored by Spiral Knight recruits.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_1a: Well met, {0}. It is good to see you once more and under such auspicious terms.
conversation.properties|m.rc_end_3b: While the path is dangerous, you will not be traveling very deep, so the monsters you encounter should be easy enough to handle. However, scouts have been reporting increased gremlin activity in the area since we set up camp, so watch out.
item.properties|f.torto_skull: A cavernous, musty helm made from the remains of a Tortodrone- a reminder that sometimes it pays to not stick your neck out.
conversation.properties|m.casino_royalje: Here's a jelly gem for ya...
item.properties|f.indestructible_giftwra: Presents wrapped with this Grinchlin gag can never be opened again. Leave it to Grinchlins to ruin complimentary gift wrapping services for everyone.
conversation.properties|m.fountain_1: Greetings and welcome to Haven\!  If you head north, you'll reach the Arcade where you can get up to speed on the details of our mission.  If you head west, you'll reach the Bazaar, where the Strangers have a selection of gear and weapons for sale.  Be sure to check their stock daily, it changes\!
item.properties|f.skelly_mask: A spooky mask good for both scaring children and protecting from shadow attacks.
helptips.properties|m.tg3_lift_2: The door ahead is locked, but you can open it with the hit switch to your left. Try throwing a clay pot at the switch. They're quite useful in this way if you don't have a gun handy.
mission.properties|o.p_anniversary_r4: Meet with Biscotti in her kitchen and provide 'baking assistance.'
item.properties|f.blazebreak_armor: A reliable set of armor adept at deflecting the most fiery of rhetoric. It's not bad at resisting flame attacks, either.
item.properties|f.polar_twilight_warden_: An insulated coat that will keep a knight warm when facing bitter polar winds. The fur-lined armor plating makes it ideal for hours of scanning the horizon during polar twilight.
helptips.properties|m.tg_welcome: Welcome to the Training Ground, recruit. In this derelict section of the Clockworks you'll find areas we have built in order to train you in the fine art of not dying a horrible death. So pay attention to these helpful tips, ready your weapon, and get moving\!
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_4: Required items will appear once your sprite is ready to level up. After your sprite has consumed enough heat, a 'required material' notice will appear above the feeding tray. This material MUST be fed to the sprite in order for it to advance further.
item.properties|f.heavy_demo_suit: Reinforced armor intended for explosive experts.
auction.properties|m.no_mybids: You have not bid on any recent auctions.
pvp.properties|m.title: KING KROGMO'S COLISEUM
mission.properties|o.p_r7_gate_fiend: Free the captured Knights from a fiendish corporate prison\!
mission.properties|b.heart_of_matter: Lieutenant Vaelyn led the first squad into the Clockworks that attempted to located the Alpha Squad.  She is a talented squad leader thought to be on par with Euclid himself.  Vaelyn has never given up her search and is now attempting to put together an on-site Core research team in order to better understand the very place where the Alpha Squad's trail is thought to end.
item.properties|f.shogun_helmet: A grand helmet worn by warriors who long ago united a land under the banner of the rising sun.
mission.properties|o.crossing_chasm: Cross the perilous chasm and connect with Spiral HQ in Haven
mission.properties|o.alien_ooze: Rescue the field research team from a lichen colony
item.properties|f.grey_owlite_shield: A resplendent replica of the shield thought to have been issued to the most eminent of Owlite wizards. Wielding it fills you with righteous vengeance.
item.properties|f.dusker_coat: A warm adventurer's coat that'll let you strike with the ferocity of an Alpha Dusker.
item.properties|f.boosted_plate_helm: A Spiral Plate Helm with a supercharged internal power source. It's a little hard to see out of.
mission.properties|o.p_r6_mat_1: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
projectx.properties|m.queue_position: You are at position {0} in the logon queue.
item.properties|f.harlequin_suit: A costume for those who juggle, tumble, or have the gift of mischief.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_kit: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.
item.properties|f.valestone_deposit_4: A mother lode of metalliferous minerals that will generate a jackpot of moonstone.
projectx.properties|e.name_invalid_chara: Sorry, that name contains an invalid character.
conversation.properties|m.impostoclaus_f: Our mission to save Winterfest ends in defeat\! The grinchlins have won, we must retreat\!
item.properties|f.furni_pet_wandering_ro: A festive new years snipe that will explore its surroundings.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_4b: Skill points are gained regularly as a sprite levels up. They can be applied to skills within the battle sprite interface. \n\nWhen applying a skill point, you must choose an augment to increase, such as the cooldown rate or overall damage.
mission.properties|o.chilled_to_bone: Investigate the shadowy remains of the Candlestick Keep
item.properties|f.storm_caller: A party favor of the gods, used to summon a bolt of lightning from the heavens.
pvp.properties|m.super_brawl-info: Super Brawl is a fantastic, free-for-all fight for up to eight knights\! You will be awarded points for defeating other contestants and lose points for being defeated. The contestant with the most points at the end of the five-minute round wins\!
sprites.properties|d.no_mercy: Increases the damage inflicted by hexing haze.
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_3_1: (Lieutenant  Feron appears to have been injured) \n\nThere you are, {0}, here for the big finale, eh?
uplink.properties|m.newsletter_resub: If you had previously subscribed to the newsletter, just confirm your email address and resubscribe to claim your Proto Crest accessory\!
item.properties|f.neutralizer: You'd be surprised at the number of practical applications to be had from two substances that, when combined, leave quite literally nothing in their wake. Neutralizer bullets envelop the enemy in an energy field that explodes after taking damage.
item.properties|f.great_defender: A sturdy Defender upgraded with its own internal energy source for more effective protection.
chat.properties|m.no_such_gift: {0} has no gifts of that type.
conversation.properties|r.rc_bomb_1a: Sounds like a blast\! Maybe I'll buy some from the traveling merchant.
item.properties|f.woven_pathfinder_armor: A flexible suit of armor built for mobility and interlaced with slime fibers to protect against prickly and thorny foes.
item.properties|f.crimsonite_deposit_4: A mother lode of metalliferous minerals that will generate a jackpot of crimsonite.
item.properties|f.gm_armor: Impressive indigo armor that's the indisputable indication of one of the Spiral Order's incredible Game Masters.
item.properties|f.brute_jelly_shield: A thick shield made from the remains of particularly ill-mannered slimes. It is durable, light, and delightfully berry-flavored.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_gate_gremlin: Steal the gremlin schematics from the gremlin construction site\!
item.properties|f.virulent_catalyzer: The incorporation of Spiral technology has given this harrowing handgun a powerfully poisonous payload. Catalyzer bullets envelop the enemy in an energy field that explodes after taking damage.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_weap_1: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
dungeon.properties|b.i_agree: I will never talk about C.U.B.E. Club
conversation.properties|m.npc_veteran_c: I always carry a blaster, never know when it might come in handy.
item.properties|f.super_shard_bomb: A shard bomb stuffed with even more depleted Crimsonite. The choicest cure for a combative creature is clearly a crystal to the cranium.
social.properties|m.friend_party_full: Oops\! {0}'s party is no longer accepting new members.
conversation.properties|m.vise_seerus:
Hello there lad\!  
Taking on ol' Seerus aye?  Careful now, he's not right in the head. Proper imbalanced that one.  

He and I go way back, but not in any way worth remembering.  Should your mission prove successful, see if you can bring me back a little souvenir.  I'll make ya something nice for your troubles.
pvp.properties|m.playagain_team.n: {0} more guildmates are needed for a {1} team.
mission.properties|o.p_tortodrone_r9: Investigate the Ancient Grove and put a stop to a Fiendish plot.
item.properties|f.moonstone_shard: A shard of Moonstone that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
item.properties|f.big_angry_bomb: An immensely powerful bomb with a terrible attitude.
item.properties|f.fused_demo_helm: An upgraded Demo Helm fused dangerously with the unstable core from a powerful Blast Cube. It produces an unpleasant hum in your ears.
item.properties|f.ticket_variants_1: Use this ticket at the Variant Forge to reset an item's variants to 1 random variant.
item.properties|f.triglav: No stories have been told about this almighty blade, but that's only because people are rarely in the mood to talk after having been crushed by a mountain.
mission.properties|r.darkest_depths_4a: I'll make it.  Just you wait.
chat.properties|m.usage_help: Available commands\: {0}\nEnter\: "/{1} <command>" to learn more about each command.
conversation.properties|m.npc_techknight: Good data is like a good pudding, you can never have too much of it.
help.properties|m.monster_construct: Deal ELEMENTAL - Weak to ELEMENTAL - Strong against PIERCING
item.properties|f.shadow_key: A mysterious key that grants a party entrance to Shadow Lairs.  A Shadow Key is destroyed once used.
item.properties|f.horned_owlite_shield: A sturdy shield similar to the sort said to have been carried by Owlite youth.
projectx.properties|e.name_invalid_dash: Sorry, there must be two letters surrounding any dash, and two dashes maximum.
helptips.properties|m.loading6: If you become poisoned you will not be able to heal yourself. Avoid taking too much damage until it wears off.
item.properties|f.vial_poison_ultra: An ornate glass vial containing debilitating toxins. It can be used to inflict enemies with Poison.\n\nThis particular vial is the most dangerous of them all. Throw it like a grenade and wither the attack power of your foes\!
sprites.properties|d.iron_harness: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal normal damage. \nCan be used by\: All battle sprites
item.properties|f.slime_key: A slippery key that can only open a Slime Lockbox.  Once used, the key is destroyed.
item.properties|f.starlit_hunting_cap: An advanced hunting cap, illuminated and downy, that resists the strongest sleep mists.
mission.properties|b.from_below: A squad of Desna's Recon Rangers is trapped somewhere in the depths of the Clockworks by a mysterious force. Judging from the severity of the reports and panicked communications from the squad, Spiral HQ believes that only someone with your experience is capable of handling whatever deadly force has trapped them.
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_7a: No problem, I've got the time.  Let's start from the top.
item.properties|f.shadow_driver: A high-tech alchemical sidearm that fires powerful shadow bullets that split multiple times on impact.
mission.properties|b.p_fast_advancement: Use this Test Server exclusive mission to quickly power up your weapons and gear.  Each level of this mission is exactly the same, allowing you to change your equipped weapons and gear at each depth. \n\nOnly a few heat embers are needed to max out any item\! 'Return to Haven' before you reach the end so you can come back to this mission.
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_b_3a: Whew, well that was much faster with you lending a hand, {0}. Listen, if you ever need a guided tour around the bazaar, just come talk to me. I can tell you anything you need to know about the shops and services here. \n\nHave a look around\! I'm sure you'll find plenty of interesting items. Thanks again\!
helptips.properties|m.tg3_charge_1: Spiral Knights are capable of unleashing the hidden powers locked from within the weapons they use called "charge attacks." Charge attacks are more powerful than a standard attack and can often produce special effects.
mission.properties|m.collector_prisoner_: Ugh, I can barely see... did Spiral HQ send you to rescue us?
item.properties|f.kilowatt_pulsar: A Pulsar upgraded with Spiral technology to deliver an unpleasant shock on impact. Pulsar shots become more powerful the further they travel.
chat.properties|m.usage_sprite_ultimate: Usage\: /{0} skill ultimate\nUpdates a sprite skill's ultimate value.
help.properties|m.clockworks_1: The Clockworks is your gateway to the planet's Core\! It's filled with a huge variety of worlds and populated with monsters and treasure beyond your imagination. Beware, however\: the deeper you go below the surface, the tougher and smarter your opponents will become\!
item.properties|f.wrapping_paper: Wrap an item in this decorative gift box and add a personalized message.
item.properties|f.heavy_dark_matter_bomb: A solid chunk of Dark Matter with an explosive surprise inside. Gremlins hate surprises.
item.properties|f.barbarous_thorn_blade: A mythical blade that lashes out with the fury of the Snarbolax itself. Those who wield it claim to feel the fiery stare of the beast upon them whenever they close their eyes.

Intel had reported a gremlin deconstruction crew dismantling a portion of the Clockworks in order to generate scrap resources for use in their Project R. Using powerful welding torches, they are truly burning the place to the ground. 

One of the squads investigating the site has gone missing and is believed to be now held in captivity at the site. 

Infiltrate the fiery deconstruction zone and rescue the captive knights.  But be warned, the deconstruction crew are said to have a powerful security construct hidden somewhere on site.

mission.properties|b.p_ghost_machine_r9:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 


Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has received a distress call from a derelict facility deep within the Clockworks. The distress call came in the form of a digital message saying only 'save us.' Believing it to be a potential trap, Spiral HQ has deployed Desna's Recon Rangers to investigate the facility and assist anyone who may have sent the message.

item.properties|f.vitasuit_deluxe: Four out of five Spiral medics recommend this armor for everyday use. The fifth was crushed by a Tortodrone.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_min: Chief Geo Knight Wegner is always seeking to further his research on the mysterious minerals that are found in the Clockworks.  The experiments he conducts on his available samples tend to result in their disintegration.  Because of this he's always in need of brave knights to delve into the Clockworks to procure more for samples for him.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_weap_4: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.

conversation.properties|m.hunter_1a:
Hello there my good Knight, I am Armero, great hunter of the wilds and curator of this prestigious lodge you see before you. 

On the walls are some of the many trophies claimed from many courageous expeditions, where life and limb were put on the line in order to experience the pure, untamed thrill of the hunt. 

Now I say, do you have the same spark within you? The same taste for the open air, for danger?

mission.properties|b.weight_of_darkness:
It is speculated that all fiends within the Clockworks crossed over from a dimension known as the Underworld.  While how they crossed over and what their motives are on Cradle is unclear, data collected from fiendish cities seems to indicate that they are now stranded on Cradle, much like us. 

The undead on the other hand remain a mystery.  Why spirits return to the material realm is unknown, though it is clear that many of the spirits within the Clockworks have come from other worlds.  Given how hostile these creatures can be, the only way to obtain useful data is through direct interactions, like combat. 

Spiral HQ is requesting that you collect combat data for the powerful fiend and undead monsters in Tier 3 of the Clockworks in order to better understand the nature of these creatures. 

It is highly recommended that you equip yourself with shadow resistant gear with elemental and piercing damage weapons\!
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_9a: Okay then, let's start from the top.

* There are multiple Control Points scattered around the map

* To capture a Control Point, stand on it until it changes to your team's color 
* The team with the highest score at the end of the match WINS\!

dungeon.properties|m.gloaming_wildwoods_: Spiral Knight recruits are advised to avoid this dark and misty forest until they are experienced with the dangers of the Clockworks. The Gloaming Wildwoods is home to packs of vicious beasts, the worst of all being the mythical Snarbolax. Said to be 'a living shadow,' the Snarbolax prefers the taste of prey that had been a state of terror before death and will often mercilessly harass its victims before delivering the final blow.

In order to discover what the Fiends are up to, you will need to find a way to unlock one of their Grim Gates and travel through it. Spiral HQ suspects that the glyphs that the Fiends carry with them might be the keys to opening the gate yourself.
item.properties|f.sacred_ghost_helm: A haunting helm for those who are gunning for ghosts.
mission.properties|m.time_enough_at_last:
Yes, it is isn't it?  I should not have come here alone.  I should have stayed with my squad. 

(Edger looks off into the distance) 

I don't even remember how it happened.... maybe I never will.  But it didn't hurt.

item.properties|f.stranger_hat: A hat once worn by one of the enigmatic Strangers.  It seems to have small, colorful feathers hiding in every seam.
mission.properties|m.pierce_of_cake_2a: Very well {0}, let's get right to it.  It seems the closer monsters get to the Core, the more their unique properties begin to surface.  In most cases this takes the form of their being able to inflict special damage types that require special defenses in order to withstand properly. \n\nIn Tier 2, a monster inflicting a special damage type will always produce a split normal/special damage output.  Thus, normal defense is still a somewhat valid defense choice.

item.properties|f.raider_helm: A pristine raider helmet, save for a few dings.

mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_r3: It is during each and every Winterfest, that a faction of green-furred gremlins make quite a mess, in the town of Emberlight. These 'grinchlins' as they are called, stop at nothing until they've hauled, each and every present from the town of Emberlight. \n\nAnd so Impostoclaus has asked the Spiral Knights, to take up their arms and fight, the monsters that threaten the town of Emberlight. So grab a present and answer his call\! Ensure that a merry Winterfest is had by all, in the town of Emberlight.
item.properties|f.grand_solstice_ring: A magnificent, enchanted ring that embodies the spirit of the solstice. Its surface seems to change color over time, sometimes hot and sometimes cold to the touch.
item.properties|f.phantamos: A powerful handgun brimming with dark energy. The Phantamos represents one of the most recent additions to the Spiral Knight's arsenal, as containing shadow energy of this degree took a great deal of research.
conversation.properties|m.mission_lab_by: We formed a barricade around the Artifact but it was overrun. I'm sorry...
mission.properties|m.shadow_knows_2a: Spiral HQ has informed me that you are ready to learn about monsters that inflict shadow damage correct?
item.properties|f.swiftstrike_buckler: A small, easy to use shield that enables the user to perform fast attacks.
item.properties|f.cooling_cell: A small device used in complex machines to keep them from overheating. Also handy to keep in your pockets on hot summer days.
dungeon.properties|m.royal_jelly_desc: The Royal Jelly Palace is an ancient castle overtaken by a legion of slime monsters. It is unclear what purpose the castle serves, though it is rumored to house a Royal Jelly, said to be nobility within the slime kingdoms. If true then the purpose of the castle is likely to serve the Royal Jelly, and nothing more.
item.properties|f.prize_box_aerodynamic: Contains unique aerodynamic costumes and accessories. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: I'm not ready to choose yet.
conversation.properties|m.impostoclaus_w: Glorp\! Glorp\! Winterfest is saved and one thing is clear\: all hearts now sing with holiday cheer\!
conversation.properties|n.rfc_dungeon_1a: I have lingered in halls even after all these long centuries, denied my eternal rest by my cursed lord. I feel his spirit clinging onto this shattered realm even now. He refuses to leave and thus dooms us all.
item.properties|f.drakon_pod: A sprite pod containing a level 1 Drakon Battle Sprite. \n\nThe Drakon is a battle sprite that embodies fiery destruction. Its skills focus on raw, offensive power.
item.properties|f.ironmight_plate_shield: A superior shield forged from sun silver. The meaning of the crest on its face has been lost to time.

mission.properties|o.from_below: Find and save the squad of Recon Rangers
item.properties|f.dark_matter_deposit_3: A large lump of minerals that will generate a great many units of dark matter.
help.properties|m.tier_2_monster: Monsters split their damage between NORMAL and one other special damage type (PIERCING, ELEMENTAL or SHADOW).\nMonsters utilize STATUS EFFECTS more often. Equip armor with FIRE, FREEZE, SHOCK or POISON resistance\!
mission.properties|o.securing_camp: Find and talk to Rhendon to gain access to missions.
conversation.properties|r.tut_intro3_2a: I'll scout ahead then\! Be careful, Rhendon.

item.properties|f.obsidian_hood_of_sight: 'Through my eyes you will see the path to ages. Pure is my gaze, free from the lies of reality.'

item.properties|f.caladbolg: A formidable greatsword of lore, its blows cleave the battlefield like a rainbow crosses the sky.
item.properties|f.supply_pack_compact: A package of useful supplies valued by Spiral Knight research teams working deep within the Clockworks.  This compact pack has enough supplies to last a single Knight one week.
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_16: Thanks Tylen, I'll be seeing you\!
conversation.properties|m.hunter_4a: That's the spirit\! Give those monsters what for\!
mission.properties|m.cwt_mintut_2: Yes, exactly\! During your travels in the Clockworks you will encounter five special minerals\: crimsonite, moonstone, valestone, luminite and dark matter.
item.properties|f.fowl_cloak_vol: A scorched feathered cloak. Set a fire under your feet and ensure punctuality as sure as the roosters crow.
item.properties|f.prize_box_disguise: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Disguise style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: We'll hold the line\!
item.properties|f.cursed_idol: A small, stone statue carved into the form of one of the thousands of arch fiends of the Underworld. The shadowy surface color seems to move and shift like smoke.
mission.properties|m.cwt_mintut_6: Our geological research is ongoing, so there may yet be other fascinating uses for these strange and powerful minerals.
item.properties|f.iron_dragon_helm: A helm once worn by a member of the 'Iron Dragons,' a squad of fearless knights that specialized in the elimination of high-profile Morai targets. After disbanding, their surviving members were united with other squads by Desna to form the Recon Rangers.
mission.properties|m.first_contact_b_1a: This is Intel Agent Kora of Spiral HQ\! We have received a distress signal from your coordinates, do you read me?

craft.properties|m.confirm_remove_access: The accessory will be removed and destroyed. Are you sure?
item.properties|f.vog_cub_coat: This hide garment is so flame retardant that you won't even mind that it reeks of wood smoke.
mission.properties|b.great_escape: Recon Knights have collected intel that has revealed the gremlin 'Crimson Order' has begun ordering gremlins to build makeshift prisons within the Clockworks where Spiral Knights are being taken and imprisoned.  It is believed that these orders are coming in direct response to your destruction of the Roarmulus Twins. \n\nFurther data suggests that these makeshift prisons are a temporary solution until a larger facility can be built.  Spiral HQ however, has no intention of these imprisoned knights staying long enough to find out.
item.properties|f.blazebrand: A high-tech blade that fuses Spiral and Clockwork technology. It can produce a concentrated high-temperature explosion that is harmless to knights.
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research: By now you have likely collected a few material samples from your early expeditions into the Clockworks.  Spiral HQ is requesting some of those materials for their ongoing research of the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks.
helptips.properties|m.loading4: Rare monsters offering unique items roam the Clockworks. Have you discovered any yet?
item.properties|f.polaris: It's said that the explosions caused by this stellar sidearm are so bright that you'll always be able to find your way in the darkness. Polaris shots become more powerful the further they travel.
conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_6a: Hold fast, traveler. You stand in the court of the Kingdom of Almire. Do you not hear the trumpets sound the return of our mighty legions? Are you not in awe of the prestigious heraldry of our great houses and statesmen?
mission.properties|r.search_continues_1a: Thank you, Lieutenant. Any more information with regard to the Alpha Squad?
item.properties|f.wild_star: A perfect crystalization of special food favored by battle sprites who are deeply connected to the natural order of the great wilderness.
mission.properties|b.p_tortodrone_r4: Pieces of fallen tortodrones and clusters of dark matter have been showing up in the Clockworks, leading Spiral HQ to believe that the Fiends are somehow linked to the disappearance of those once-mythical beings. In order to discover what the Fiends are up to, you will need to find a way to unlock one of their Grim Gates and travel through it. Spiral HQ suspects that the glyphs that the Fiends carry with them might be the keys to opening the gate yourself.
item.properties|f.kat_eye_cowl: A magnificently crafted cowl said to resemble the Kat Tribe hero, Preowa, whose artillery silenced the Grey Feather Tower Sages.
item.properties|f.gh_theme_spooky: A dark and foreboding theme perfect for a Guild Hall whose members are among the recently departed.
helptips.properties|m.atg_togswitch: Switches can open AND close doors.
item.properties|f.dragon_scale_helm: A mythical helmet crafted from the scales of a creature of legend.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: The rest of us thought we weren't going to make it. But then...then the light surrounded us and we were safe. We've taken to calling it The Sleeper. We aren't sure what it is exactly, but it needs our help. This world was created to protect it but somehow The Swarm breached the Core and has been feeding on the energy and growing like a leech ever since.
item.properties|f.scarlet_shield: A shield found within the Scarlet Fortress. It grants the user extra health. Those that carry one have said that they can sometimes hear a faint heartbeat emanating from within it.
item.properties|f.exp_east_4f: An expansion that adds three rooms and a small overlook to the eastern side of the Guild Hall.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_8a: Yes, quite. These sprites have adapted the power to cloak, to use the very shadows around them for subterfuge. Between that and their newfound skills in toxins and debilitations, I'd say they could be quite handy on the battlefield.
helptips.properties|m.clockwork_tunnels: There are strange sounds and energies emanating from the Clockworks. Delve deep and unravel its mysteries but be careful not to get caught in the mechanisms.
mission.properties|o.new_chapter: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
mission.properties|b.toy_soldiers: Recon Knights are reporting much greater numbers of mecha knights in the first stratum of the Clockworks and have discovered a mecha knight production facility close to Haven. \n\nMecha knights are believed to be gremlin-engineered sentries of the construct family that share many of the capabilities of a Spiral Knight.  Proceed with caution when seeking out the production center and then shut it down for good\!

mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_danger:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

On behalf of Impostoclaus, Spiral HQ has located the base of operations of the nefarious Grinchlins. It's time to take the fight to them and end their Winterfest terrorism once and for all. But it won't be an easy task. 

Those who accept this mission must climb Mount Krampus, a perilous trek filled with Grinchlin ambushes and icy deathtraps. Along the way you will find shelters that allow you to collect Grinchlin treasures and escape the mountain, or press on toward the summit for even greater rewards\! Just be warned\: Grinchlins and their allies are a stingy lot and will not drop ANY loot. All the treasures to be found on Mount Krampus are at the shelters. And should you pass on them for greater rewards ahead, you risk losing everything if you fail\! 

Some say that on the very summit of Mount Krampus lies a stash of Grinchlin loot that may contain treasures none have ever seen before...

conversation.properties|m.arc_leader_1: Well met soldier, and good work on reaching our base camp here in Haven. I'm Lieutenant Feron. I have been assigned by Captain Ozlo to oversee our Clockworks mining operation.\n\nBefore you lies "the Arcade," a fascinating complex that serves as our link into the heart of the Clockworks. Since you're new here, I'll give you a quick run-down of what Spiral HQ has us doing here.
mission.properties|m.another_trace_2a: The place is as strange as it sounds.  Apparently, monsters within the slime family actually have a ruling aristocracy of elite slimes.  These 'Royal Jellies' are enormous, selfish and ill-tempered slimes that live in opulent palaces that we can only guess have been squatted in as we do not believe slimes are capable of building structures.
conversation.properties|m.rc_end_1a: This is it, recruit. This is the final gate that leads out of the Rescue Camp, through the chasm and into Haven. Once you pass through, you will never need to return here. You can buy everything found in the Rescue Camp and much more in Haven. \n\nAny questions?

Indecipherable even in the stillness of this place.  Are they leaving me here?  Why must I be left behind? \n\nYou... I warned you not to proceed, to stay away from me.  Now you'll learn what they did... that those who are close to me die\!

guildhelp.properties|m.emporium_info:
The Birdsong Emporium allows high-ranking guild members to purchase items for the guild using funds from the Guild Treasury. These items include various Guild Hall furniture items and upgrades. Purchased items go directly into the Guild Treasury, and thus cannot ever be removed from the guild.
 Furniture comes in a variety of types and sizes and is used to decorate your Guild Hall's rooms and halls to make them feel more like home. Some furniture even has special effects when activated\! Any furniture currently in your Guild Treasury can be placed into the Guild Hall using Design Mode.
 The Birdsong Emporium is also where you purchase Guild Upgrades that enhance your guild's capabilities, such as by increasing its maximum member count.
 As a Guild Hall's size increases by adding expansions, the selection of items available in the Birdsong Emporium's catalog also increases. Be sure to check back often to see what's available\!

mission.properties|b.p_moorcroft3:
Someone or something has summoned a horde of cursed black kats into the Clockworks. These shadowy beasts hunger for arcane power and raided the Moorcroft Manor Archives' precious collection of magical grimoires. 

In the wrong hands these ancient tomes could be catastrophic, but it turns out that black kats can't read, so they instead decided to just eat them.

The residents of Moorcroft Manor would like you to retrieve the Ancient Pages of the magical grimoires that quite likely reside in the stomachs of black kats. We'll leave you to figure out just how to recover them... 

For this mission, intel has located a black kat nest beyond an area with electrifying resistance. Recover those Ancient Pages and return them to Moorcroft Manor\!
mission.properties|b.time_enough_at_last: A knight named Edger has gone missing while exploring the Scarlet Fortress.  Given that this crumbling castle is swarming with spookats and jelly cubes, his squadmates fear for his safety and have asked a more experienced knight like yourself to investigate. \n\nLocate Edger within the fortress and bring him back to Haven\!

mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_construct: Gremlins are not very good about cleaning up their messes.  Our Recon Knights will often stumble across what they believe to be decommissioned gremlin weapons factories that are still actively bustling with hostile constructs, and in some cases are even stocked with operational, active war machines\! \n\nSpiral HQ has ordered that whenever possible, these factories and their war machines are to be shut down for good to avoid any future casualties.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_5a:
Ok, back to business then. 

Punch can add Unique Variants, a kind of special bonus to your weapons and gear for a price. But his methods are, er... chaotic.  You never really know what you're going to get. 

Vise is a little more precise.  He can unbind your weapons and gear for a price, allowing you to sell or gift the item again\!

I have no doubt you will soon be a Champion amongst the Spiral Knights and instrumental in our solving the great mystery that is the Core, restoring the Skylark and returning home.  You have proven that you have what it takes to face the legions of dark forces that lurk below the surface.

mission.properties|b.p_legion_almire_r9:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ believes that an ancient codex originating from the cursed kingdom of Almire is located somewhere in a dark and terrifying necropolis.  This necropolis is believed to be teeming with all manners of undead monstrosities and only the Recon Rangers have what it takes to get in, acquire the intel and get out alive\!
helptips.properties|m.tut_dash: Evade damage from monster attacks by pressing [[DODGE]].
mission.properties|b.p_r7_gate_slime: The best way to keep slimes at bay is with copious amounts of rock salt. Slimes just hate the stuff as touching it makes them dissolve.  It's not pretty. \n\nResearch teams stationed in lichenous lairs will often surround their entire camp with rock salt so that they don't end up some slime's dinner.  As you can imagine, they go through the stuff fast.  When they run low, a squad is called in to battle their way to the camp and deliver the life saving seasoning.
