mission.properties|m.best_of_beast_2a: Yes well, let's get started then. \n\nTier 3 is closest to the Core and much like how high level items respond to its power, so do monsters.  Many of them take on new forms and are considered at their most dangerous.  You must prepare before taking on each mission.
conversation.properties|m.arc_leader_2: After the Skylark crashed, its primary tearium core exploded, destroying a portion of the ship and leaving it without a main power source. Since so far we haven't found several hundred tons of tearium just lying around, the bird has effectively lost its wings.\n\nWith the help of the Strangers, we were able to set up a small base of operations here in Haven. Once we got our systems online, we discovered that within the heart of this rock resonates a power signature of unprecedented magnitude.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_7a: Grantz was the real veteran of the bunch.  A seasoned Guardian, Grantz specialized in keeping his squad safe, namely by crushing anything that would mean to do them harm. \n\nGrantz took his Guardian's Oath very seriously, often putting himself directly in harm's way in order to protect another.  The guy was selfless.  I imagine that if disaster truly befell the Alpha Squad, Grantz didn't let it end without one hell of a fight.
helptips.properties|m.atg_vitapods: Pick up VITAPODS to temporarily increase your maximum health until you return to Haven.
item.properties|f.teddy_bear_buckler: A high-tech energy shield disguised as a harmless teddy bear. The perfect companion to defend against minions of the night.
conversation.properties|m.sl_guard_3: All Shadow Lairs are locked with a strange mechanism that can only be unlocked with a 'Shadow Key.'  Shadow Keys can be purchased from the Supply Depot. \n\nOnce a party member uses a Shadow Key, the party is locked and cannot be changed, so choose your party members wisely\!
item.properties|f.antigua: A mysterious relic from a forgotten time. It uses explosive powder to fire its rounds.
item.properties|f.prize_box_lucky: Contains various lucky and rare items. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.ice_queen_crown: A regal crown resembling that of the ever-frigid Ice Queen.  In addition to providing great defense, it is said to dramatically boost one's ego and create a cold detachment from those around them.
item.properties|f.magma_driver: Spitting gobs of molten death at an alarming rate, this sublime sidearm is not recommended for use around (or on) anyone (or anything) that you happen to care deeply about.
item.properties|f.icebreaker_armor: Upgraded Frostbreaker Armor further hacked to resist freeze.
conversation.properties|m.hav_grem_3b: All gremlins belonging to the colony serve King Tinkinzar. Tinkinzar is said to be a great ruler and mechanical genius, responsible for the vision of the whole of the Clockworks. It is our understanding however that the king is never seen by common gremlins, but instead his orders are delivered and carried out by his Crimson Order, a fearful and zealous band of gremlins who alone share audience with the great king.
conversation.properties|m.npc_supplies_b: It's been days since we had fresh supplies.
mission.properties|b.vile_engine:
Somewhere below a level that lichens have taken to inhabiting lies a strange facility of unknown origin that seems to be used for the production of toxic slime monsters. The 'slime generators' are capable of rapidly producing slime monsters that then quickly populate nearby levels. 

Squads in neighboring levels have already reported overwhelming numbers of toxic slimes, making it impossible to lead expeditions beyond depth 23.  It is time a knight of your caliber form a squad to infiltrate this strange facility and shut down production of these vile creatures. 

Any data that you could collect as to their origin would be highly valuable to Spiral HQ.
conversation.properties|m.ritual_2b: Where did you find that?\! Hand it over\! I can finally complete my work\! But just a friendly warning\: I have no idea what might happen. It could be very bad. You probably want to be prepared in case things go... awry.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_mat_3: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
item.properties|f.sun_shards: A shard bomb formed from a small explosive encased in solar-charged Luminite. Whatever you do, don't look directly at it.
item.properties|f.furni_clutter_housepla: A jolly green plant inside a cheerful pot.
help.properties|m.energy_1: Energy is used to purchase items from the Supply Depot such as weapons, gear, orbs of alchemy, sparks of life, and fire crystals. \n\nTo purchase or trade for energy, simply open the Supply Depot and click the 'Get Energy' button.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: You did it\!  That explosion took out the cannons\!
mission.properties|o.great_escape: Infiltrate the gremlin prison, free the captured Knights and stage an escape
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research_: Biotech Hahn is attempting to further his research of fiend and undead family monsters and is requesting samples from your recent missions.  He has once again specifically requested that you be reminded of his 'best free lecture yet' when making your decision as to whether or not to comply.
helptips.properties|m.tut_bash: When your shield is full, press [[SHIELD_BASH]] to bash and stun monsters\!
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_6c: No thanks, I'll explore on my own.
mission.properties|o.p_r3_mat_1: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_2a: Strangers like Quillion here sell you weapons and armor.  Each one specializes in a particular kind of item, so talk to them and find out what they carry. They're not very chatty, but they always have a fresh stock of items every day\! \n\nJust be sure that you've reached the appropriate rank to equip an item\!
mission.properties|o.p_r7_gate_undead: Save the lost Knight from joining the ranks of the dead in the haunted manor\!
mission.properties|b.built_to_destroy:
Once known to Spiral HQ as 'Project R,' the Roarmulus Twins have been identified as a gremlin-engineered weapon of tremendous power built with the sole purpose of destroying Haven.  Stored deep within the heart of the Ironclaw Munitions Factory, this weapon is not only protected by hordes of shock-powered constructs and gremlins, but the factory is a highly dangerous, explosive hazard itself\! 

In addition to shutting down the Roarmulus Twins, Spiral HQ would like you to recover the Alpha Squad recon module that is believed to be located somewhere within the factory. 

It is highly recommended that you form a full squad before deploying.
mission.properties|m.anniversary_gremlin: Oh no\! Tell her the cakes will be ready. Erm, I'm just a little behind.  I'll make you a deal\: I'll give you some extra cake if we can keep this between you and me. I don't want to be kicked out of the party.
item.properties|f.glacius: Mixing some advanced theories on cryogenics with the technology powering the Cooling Chamber produced this advanced armament, which is capable of flash-freezing the most formidable of foes.
item.properties|f.exp_west_4f: An expansion that adds three rooms and a small overlook to the western side of the Guild Hall.
helptips.properties|m.atg_healpad: Stand on a HEART GENERATOR to restore your health\!
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_b_1a: Hi there {0}\!  Wow, you've made Soldier already?  You're really moving up fast in the ranks. \n\nAnyway, I'm Bechamel, and I'm here to give you a tour of some of the Bazaar's more advanced services. To start, do you want to learn how to even further power up that gear of yours?
item.properties|f.swift_flourish: An upgraded Flourish for knights who make a point of dispatching opponents with a bit of flair.
conversation.properties|m.casino_royalje: Three lichens slide into a room...
mission.properties|b.p_anniversary_shock: We've been receiving reports that Groat, a local Emberlight chef has been acting... strange. It seems that Biscotti commissioned him to do some baking on her behalf but the responsibility may have gone to his head.  He disappeared into the Clockworks soon after Biscotti delivered the last crate of batter. With the Anniversary celebrations at stake once again, Biscotti needs some culinary champions to help her sort out this mix-up\!
item.properties|f.frost_sword: This sword is as cold as ice, and it's willing to sacrifice your love, in addition to any monsters that happen to get in your way.
item.properties|f.thricer_slicer: At some point the eggheads will figure out what these mysterious energy spikes are. But in the meantime, now we can slice and sling them at double the rate, with extra mysterious orbital spins\!
chat.properties|m.usage_joinknight: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nAttempts to join a player's instance or party.
item.properties|f.wild_shell: A shield alchemized from a hardened tortodrone shell. It's tough enough to dull a jelly barb on impact.
exchange.properties|m.offertosell_toolti: Enter the amount of energy you want to sell, in multiples of 100.
item.properties|f.dusker_cap: A hide helm for knights that prefer to take their opponents on toe-to-toe.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_2: Indeed\! A battle sprite can synthesize matter into useable energy. This machine can take certain materials and alchemize them into extra special sprite food... that is, when it's finally calibrated.
mission.properties|m.pierce_of_cake_3a: Yes, at this point you must begin forming an arsenal that protects you against special damage types. \n\nYour current missions will have you facing monsters with piercing damage attacks.  Thus, you must begin acquiring helmets, armor and shields that defend against piercing damage.
helptips.properties|m.unlock_grim_gate: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to use a Fiendish ID Card \n\nWARNING\: If this Grim Gate is unlocked the party will become locked and stay locked for the duration of the mission. Choose your party members wisely\!
projectx.properties|m.reboot_warning: The server will be rebooted in {0} minutes. {1}
item.properties|f.prize_box_spritely: Contains various unique accessories and new Sprite colors to celebrate Battle Sprites. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.vial_sleep_ultra: An ornate glass vial containing a drowsy draught. It can be used to inflict enemies with Sleep.\n\nThis particular vial is the most dangerous of them all. Throw it like a grenade and your foes will be snoring in seconds\!
item.properties|f.frosted_helm: A delicious helm made of cake created during the Spiral Knights Anniversary Celebration. Since it's made of cake, it eventually falls apart.
conversation.properties|m.tier_2_require: Well met, {0}.  In order to proceed and explore deeper depths of the Clockworks you must first achieve Rank 7-1. \n\nReturn here once you have completed the requisite Rank Missions.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_3: Do you have any more questions about feeding and caring for your sprite?
item.properties|f.divine_orb: A lustrous sphere of special food favored by battle sprites who forever bask in the light of the heavens.
item.properties|f.polar_night_wolf_coat: A warm coat, favored by those knights stationed in the polar regions. The thick fur is needed during their never ending night patrols.
conversation.properties|m.rc_greet2_1a: Greetings, I'm Squad Leader Greta.  You must be {0}. Rhendon said we should be expecting you, and not a moment too soon.  This Rescue Camp is facing a crisis.
item.properties|f.forbidden_fruit: A sinful snack favored by famished fiends.
uplink.properties|m.gift_received: Please accept this token of friendship.
item.properties|f.radiant_pulsar: A cutting-edge handgun intended for use only by the Spiral Order's best and brightest. Pulsar shots become more powerful the further they travel.
helptips.properties|m.tut_miniboss: You've almost made it to the Rescue Camp, run through the force barrier ahead\!
item.properties|f.sweet_dreams: Don't be fooled by this weapon's fluffy exterior. It hits much harder than it looks. The perfect weapon for fighting things that go bump in the night.
item.properties|f.furni_beacon_floor_gre: A Spiral-issued light source typically used at checkpoints.
item.properties|f.infernal_guardian_armo: Charred, stygian armor worn by those who defend the infernal depths.
item.properties|f.proto_shield: A small shield issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
conversation.properties|m.monster_codex_: Lord Vanaduke \nLittle is known about the eternal Duke of the Almirian Empire. Our sensors show the mask is a source of power as well as a potential weakness.
item.properties|f.plague_needle: Knights are divided on whether this gun's bolts pierce and then poison, or poison and then pierce. To the unlucky target, this distinction is irrelevant.
item.properties|f.jar_o_fireflies: A small jar of hibernating fireflies that can be released on a festive occasion.
projectx.properties|m.please_relaunch: Please quit and re-run the game to check your new options.
pvp.properties|m.coins_awarded_subject: Krogmo Coins earned in The Coliseum\!
monster.properties|m.overtime_4: Remember, tomorrow is Hawaiian Shirt Day and every other day is Unpaid Overtime Day.
mission.properties|m.creators_and_create: Right.  Spiral HQ has informed me you'll likely be facing hordes of gremlins and constructs on this next go around.  Keep in mind that in Tier 3, these monsters can inflict pure elemental damage.  Do be sure to gear up appropriately.
mission.properties|m.search_continues_1a: {0}, I cannot thank you enough.  We've already established our research base and are collecting a tremendous amount of data that we would have never had without your efforts.
item.properties|f.firebreak_helm: An Emberbreak Helm modified to provide further protection against fire.
uplink.properties|m.royal_start:
Intel Agent Kora here, we've detected another Recon Module of the Alpha Squad within this palace.  It is your mission to locate and retrieve the module. 

The Royal Jelly Palace is a strange place.  It appears to be some sort of castle that slimes have re-purposed as a residence for members of their oozing aristocracy.  Known as a 'Royal Jelly,' these noble slimes are said to rule over their countless loyal subjects with an iron fist-shaped appendage. 

Our intel suggests that the module is located somewhere near an enormous concentration of slimes, so it is reasonable to believe that it may be the 'throne room' of a Royal Jelly.  If so, be prepared for a fearsome fight- Royal Jellies are quick to anger and love to throw their enormous weight around.  Your best bet is to find a way to suppress their natural regenerative abilities. 

Good luck\!
conversation.properties|m.mission_crimso: Well met\! When I heard they were sending you {0}, I didn't believe it. THE Vanquisher of Vanaduke\! It's an honor to be reporting to you.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_undead: The ruins of Owlite castles are dark and cursed places that are swarming with legions of undead spookats.  The worst of these, the seemingly invincible grimalkins, constantly lurk in the shadows, awaiting the moment your life-saving light is finally snuffed out. \n\nSome knights succumb to the darkness and become paralyzed with fear in these shadowy realms. The only thing that can save them are brave knights who have long lost their childhood fears of the dark and all the terrible creatures that lurk within.
chat.properties|m.usage_fallback: Usage\: /{0}\nTell your comrades to fall back.
item.properties|f.spiral_cuirass: Light armor issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
conversation.properties|r.dark_harvest_e: Sounds like fun\!  I'm off to find the Punkin King\!
projectx.properties|d.achievement_7542da: Forge an item up to level 10.
conversation.properties|m.npc_spikeexplo: One of them lobbed a spike at me\!
item.properties|f.blackened_crest: A shield once carried by a knight of Almire, now a cursed relic that has been nearly burned beyond recognition within the Firestorm Citadel. Very powerful alchemy would be required to restore it to its former glory.
helptips.properties|m.loading16: Using a shield can help you completely avoid damage, so make sure to use it\! Press "[[DEFEND]]" to defend. As the shield takes damage it will turn red and eventually break. The shield must regenerate before it can be used again.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_4: At any given time a sprite has a 'favored item', a special material that it enjoys eating the most. Feeding one of these to your sprite is a great treat and grants the sprite a lot of heat.
mission.properties|r.another_trace_3a: You can count on me, Kora.
projectx.properties|m.pvp_gear: Gear restricted due to Coliseum signups. (Click Here)
conversation.properties|m.mission_resear: Don't know how long before our forcefield gives out...
mission.properties|r.heart_of_matter_2a: I've prepared for facing the Firestorm Citadel, you can count on me.
item.properties|f.firebreak_armor: Upgraded Emberbreak armor further hacked to resist fire.
conversation.properties|m.tut_intro2_2a: You just hit the surface of Cradle.  My escape pod crashed just north of your position.  We should meet up and find the nearest rally point. \n\nBe careful and ready your sword, there are hostile creatures everywhere\!
chat.properties|m.away_set: Auto-response message set. Use /back to turn it off.
item.properties|f.nameless_poncho: A nameless poncho worn by a nameless hero of legend.
monster.properties|m.overtime_2: I'm not saying to work this weekend, but everyone else is, so...
global.properties|e.must_complete_tutori: You must complete The Crash Site before joining friends.
item.properties|f.dark_briar_barrage: A mythical object that can explode with the fury of the Snarbolax itself. The unearthly howl it produces is said to be more crippling than its blast.
auction.properties|m.cancel_confirm: You will get your item back but will not be refunded your listing fee.
mission.properties|m.ghost_machine_mon_2: THEY WILL KILL US THEY WILL KILL YOU.
mission.properties|b.p_anniversary_r9: Head Chef of the Skylark, Biscotti, has been tasked with baking cakes to celebrate the anniversary of Spiral Knights.  Something has apparently gone awry in her kitchen and she is requesting reinforcements to provide 'baking assistance.'
item.properties|f.cold_snap: A Proto Bomb modified to generate small bursts of frost upon detonation.
mission.properties|o.laboratory_visit: Visit the Lab and meet with Biotech Morlin
conversation.properties|m.fc_court_4: Then you are brave as well traveler. You can find my kinsfolk throughout the whole of this court. Be very careful though, for Vanaduke's terrible minions are guarding them. Many patrol the main drag, so watch your back as you move about.\n\nOnce you find a sprite, carry them back to the sacred circle you see before you. They are no doubt weakened from Vanaduke's curse and will require rejuvenation. When six others are reunited we will form a focus link with the Spirit Mother and bring water to the wells.
helptips.properties|m.tg3_end: Seems like you have a good grasp on the basics. I think you're ready to join the rest of the recruits in the Sparrow Gate. There you will learn how to work as a party. There's a lot of recruits out there depending on you now. Great job\!
mission.properties|m.time_enough_at_last: I don't know about that... I'm fine here amongst all these ancient tomes.  I've got plenty to read, more than I ever could in a lifetime.  But I suppose that won't be a problem. \n\nPlease, just head on back to Haven.  Let my squad know that I'm ok and that I'm safe.
mission.properties|b.new_chapter: Having defeated the Snarbolax and recovered the Alpha Squad recon module, it's time to check in with Intel Agent Kora to get a report on the analysis of the module and information about certification in the Hall of Heroes.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Apologies for not appearing in person. I'm hidden away in a safe place. I knew I'd never make it there in time when I noticed your signal. Luckily I was able to pull some strings and find you an exit.
conversation.properties|m.rc_vet_3a: I won't be able to relax until we've linked up with Spiral HQ.
item.properties|m.gsc_vip: Golden Slime Casino C.U.B.E. Club Membership
item.properties|f.warmaster_bomb_3: The perfected version of the shadowy bomb that Warmaster Seerus engineered with the sole purpose of eliminating other gremlins that stood in his way.  It is thought to have been reserved for use against other members of the Crimson Order.
conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_1: I'll bet these Beast Bells really came in handy huh, {0}?
conversation.properties|m.atg_greeter_1a: Welcome to our advanced training hall. Here you will find useful survival tips to help you on your journey through the Clockworks. \n\nWould you like some directions?
conversation.properties|m.rc_nervous_1a: I want to buy something with the crowns I've earned in the training grounds, but that merchant is totally giving me the creeps. What do you think it's hiding under those robes?\!
monster.properties|m.overtime_1: Go ahead and come in on Sunday, too...
item.properties|f.barrier_cannon: A handgun alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. The elemental offense of a tortodrone on the Long Migration should aid you on your own expeditions.
mission.properties|m.ghost_machine_mon_2: they will kill us they will kill you
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_3d: Perks are unlocked at random. Some perks are much rarer than others and will require a sprite to level up very high to unlock them all. \n\nYou can even gain perks after reaching level 100\!
exchange.properties|m.offertosell_toolti: Submit your offer to the market. If a buyer is found while you are online, you will receive a chat notification.
item.properties|f.weapon_slot_upgrade_30: Once used, this upgrade opens an additional weapon slot for 30 days.
helptips.properties|m.bramble: Some areas are overgrown with bramble that will hurt you if you run through it\!
item.properties|f.icebreaker_helm: A Frostbreaker Helm modified to provide further protection against freeze.
item.properties|f.flame_soul: A powerful essence left behind when a creature perishes during a blind, fiery rage.
item.properties|f.dangerous_draped_armor: Loose-fitting armor worn by more experienced Recon Rangers. It's rumored that gear like this is crafted from the remains of armor from Rangers who fell in combat, acting as a reminder to the wearer that they are always within Death's embrace.
item.properties|f.elemental_cloak: A fine robe with numerous forms of elemental protection woven right into the fabric.
pvp.properties|m.start_soon: Your {0} game will be starting soon...
item.properties|f.spiral_hood: A light helmet issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
mission.properties|m.heart_of_matter_4a: Sorry, yes of course.  Good luck to you, {0}.  Assemble the best squad you can and lead them well.  We're all counting on you.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: Hail, Vanguard. It will be a rough road ahead of us but I am confident that we are up to the challenge.
helptips.properties|m.tg3_goldkey: Gold keys are another type of lift object. Pick them up and use them on gold doors. For every gold door you find in a level, there is always a gold key somewhere.
mission.properties|r.pierce_of_cake_4a: You talked pretty fast, can you go over it-
mission.properties|o.p_r6_mat_2: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
item.properties|f.nodeslime_helm: A menacing mask of malice made from obliterated ominous ooze.
item.properties|f.gh_env_default: The default environment that really captures the stale air of the Clockworks.
mission.properties|b.guardians_of_cradle: You have been invited to attend a meeting with several members of Spiral HQ to discuss what to do next about the Core and the threat of the Swarm. Join them in the Hall of Heroes to learn about Operations Missions.
item.properties|f.dark_thorn_blade: A savage sword whose strength has been fortified by an offering of souls to the beast within.
item.properties|f.perplexing_element: A rare metal recovered from a shattered mountain deep within the realm of the Apocrea. Under a microscope it reveals to have a kind of impossible geometry. Perhaps more dedicated study, free from the distractions of the world would reveal its secrets.
item.properties|f.spiraltail_mask: A simple simian mask made to celebrate the new year. Your sly shenanigans are sure to become a spectacle.
pvp.properties|e.late_playagain: You are too late to play again.
conversation.properties|m.energy_info_2a: Awesome\! I'll break it down for you in three easy lessons\: what it is, how it's used, and how you can get more.
mission.properties|o.hall_of_heroes_2: Visit the Hall of Heroes wearing at least 3 Star gear and receive certification
mission.properties|b.shocking_sentient_s:
Recon Knights have uncovered a secret weapons facility that according to the intel we have available, could belong to a high ranking gremlin of The Crimson Order.  It is heavily fortified by a small army of electrified constructs who have no doubt been programmed to defend the facility at all costs. 

While it is unclear if this weapons stash actually belongs to a gremlin of The Crimson Order, it is no less worth infiltrating and neutralizing the weapons stash. 

It is advised that you prepare yourself with elemental damage and shock resistant gear before deploying.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_5bfbda: Complete a Tier 2 expedition without having to revive.
helptips.properties|m.sprite_cooldown: After using any sprite skill, a cooldown is required on all skills before using them again.
item.properties|f.mighty_cannon: A handgun alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. While wielding it, you can feel the unstable energies within just waiting to be unleashed.
item.properties|f.hazardous_oni_helm: A helm worn by members of the Scarlet Scouts. Designed to frighten their enemies, this helm is in the visage of a fiend who lives in the mountains of a distant land. Said to guard the gate to heaven itself, it only allows those who are worthy to pass.
item.properties|f.celestial_orbitgun: This planetoid projecting pistol conjures images of the birth of stellar systems. Opponents caught within its blazing maelstrom are sure to see the light.
mission.properties|r.guardians_of_cradle: I know, Vaelyn. I feel the same way.
uplink.properties|d.battle_pack: A Battle Pack is the ultimate resource for facing the challenges of King Krogmo's Coliseum.  Gift it to a friend who is brave enough to enter the arena with you\!
mission.properties|r.welcome_to_haven_5a: I'd like to go over your energy tutorial one more time.
dungeon.properties|m.training_grounds_de: This derelict portion of the Clockworks has been modified to train new recruits in the fine art of not dying when they have the rest of the world to explore.
sprites.properties|d.caustic_quills: Fires a series of quills that stick to targets and inflict poison. For each hit a quilled target receives, they lose one quill and take additional damage.
item.properties|f.toy_box: Contains one unique toyland costume or accessory. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
logon.properties|m.non_public_server: The game is not currently open to the public.
conversation.properties|m.monsterboost_h: It's hard to tell, but it seems to correlate to Constructs. \n\nThese Mecha Knights went wild\! Faster, stronger -- I think one was trying to climb the elevator\!
item.properties|f.super_shock_barrier: Surrounds you with potent orbs of lightning that can give hostiles a jolt
item.properties|f.prize_box_running_wild: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a canine style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
conversation.properties|m.npc_captainkni: Take cover if you get overwhelmed\!
item.properties|f.confetti_slime: When thrown, it looks like little pink jelly cubes.
item.properties|f.prize_box: Contains unique {0} costumes and accessories. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.furni_beacon_floor_red: A Spiral-issued light source typically installed in dangerous areas.
item.properties|f.sacred_hex_armor: A phantasmal suit of armor for those who are aiming for the infernal.
projectx.properties|m.head_north_arcade: Head North to the Arcade and report to Feron.
item.properties|f.cosmic_star: A perfect crystalization of special food favored by battle sprites who hail from space deep beyond the furthest of stars.
item.properties|f.prize_box_plunge: Contains various unique costumes and items to celebrate the warm days of summer.  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
guild.properties|log.upkeep_default: Upkeep not paid\! Guild Hall is in default.
guild.properties|m.invitee_denied: {0} could not accept an invitation to join {1}\: guild is full.
support.properties|m.subheader_step202: If the player you're complaining about is annoying then that does not qualify as complaint worthy.\n\nAnnoying are issues like calling you names or teasing you.
conversation.properties|m.fc_bridge_2: Lord Vanaduke is the master of this broken realm. Once the king of Almire, Vanaduke now commands a terrible legion in the ashes of his former kingdom. You would do well to never cross his path.
helptips.properties|m.tut_lever_alt: Switches can open doors. Try throwing a pot or shooting this one with your handgun\!
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: The drakon is a battle sprite that embodies fiery destruction. Its skills focus on direct assault\: firebolt creates an explosive projectile, flame barrier surrounds its knight with protective fireballs, and firestorm creates a massive wave of flames. \n\nThe drakon is best suited for fearless knights who prefer frontline, destructive combat.
mission.properties|m.the_flickering_flam: We don't know for sure but it has to be related to the Artifact. The energy signatures are identical. If the Artifact is involved that means...
conversation.properties|m.fc_bridge_1: Few make it across the bridge traveler. Perhaps you stand a chance of surviving, or perhaps... no, even the good sprites below will be swallowed by Vanaduke's flames. It is hopeless.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_gate_undead: Save the lost Knight from joining the ranks of the dead in the haunted manor\!
mission.properties|b.axes_of_evil: A gremlin logging operation has been discovered in levels known as the 'Jigsaw Valley.'  These strangely carved islands are home to an even stranger species of twisting trees that gremlins seem to be determined to completely wipe out. \n\nSpiral HQ believes that gremlins are using the lumber from this operation as resources for the development of Project R and needs you to enter the Jigsaw Valley and shut it down.
item.properties|f.bombastic_demo_helm: A finely-made helmet for the more discerning explosives expert. It won't tell you what kind of wine goes best with Nitronome, but it'll certainly keep your head looking good. And in one piece.
sprites.properties|d.scorching_barrier: Increases the number of orbiting fireballs and their size.
mission.properties|m.delved_too_deep_2a: I bet. I guess you'll have to fill me in for once\!
mission.properties|m.pioneers_4a: We need you to discover what happened to them.  You'll start by seeking out known locations of their recon modules and collecting them for analysis.  I will be in charge of locating their general whereabouts and directing you toward them.  It's your job to go into the wild to retrieve them. \n\nAdditionally, I'll provide you with a quick background of each of the four members of the Alpha Squad\: Squad Leader Euclid, Squad Guardian Grantz, Squad Recon Parma, and Squad Technician Rulen.
item.properties|f.obsidian_carbine: A deadly gun made from the obsidian obelisks found within the realm of the Apocrea. With every shot fired, a faint whisper is heard, believed to be the true name of its target.
chat.properties|m.usage_set-ident: Usage\: /{0}\nSet this knight as your identity for posting in the forums.
chat.properties|m.ident_set: Your forum identity has been set to this knight.
chat.properties|m.usage_who: Usage\: /{0} player name\nRetrieves information about a knight.
item.properties|f.obsidian_mantle_of_rit: 'With great practice and tender care, with an eternal heart and mind so pure\: sharpen the stone, sturdy the chain, welcome the night, drink the Cup of Kings.'
item.properties|f.dread_skelly_mask: The ultimate in haunted headgear, certain to protect your cranium from even the most hellish of shadow attacks.
mission.properties|r.alchemy_beginners_9: I think I've got it, thanks\!
item.properties|f.sacred_guerrilla_helm: A helm for those who want to bring down some beasts.
mission.properties|m.reporting_duty_1a: Well met soldier, and good work on reaching our base camp here in Haven. I'm Lieutenant Feron. I have been assigned by Captain Ozlo to oversee our Clockworks mining operation. \n\nBefore you lies "the Arcade," a fascinating complex that serves as our link into the heart of the Clockworks. Since you're new here, I'll give you a quick run-down of what Spiral HQ has us doing here.
item.properties|m.forge_max_in_flight: Waiting for previous forges to finish...
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_6a: I'm curious... what do you think is behind their masks? Wait, no, I don't want to know.

conversation.properties|r.och_leader_3_3: Roger that, Lieutenant.  I'll make the Warmaster pay.

mission.properties|m.new_threat_10a: Come in, {0}\!  What happened in there?
mission.properties|r.time_enough_at_last: Safe?  This place is swarming with monsters\!

item.properties|f.furni_brazier_short_bl: A short torch filled with bizarre blue fire.
projectx.properties|m.shutdown_message_d: When the server is refreshed, you will be transfered to another instance. If you are currently in the Clockworks, please finish your Mission or Expedition before the refresh to prevent interruption.
chat.properties|m.epicfail_format: {0} is appalled at that profound display of Epic Fail.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_64d528: Deposit a single mineral into a gate.
mission.properties|b.p_halloween_r7: Every year the Strangers of Haven pay tribute to a peculiar spirit known as the 'Punkin King' in order to ensure a healthy fall harvest.  This mischievous phantom delights in playing tricks on his audience but is quick to reward them with delicious candies for their troubles. \n\nCelebrate the Dark Harvest Festival and help the Strangers by seeking out the Punkin King and paying tribute.  You're sure to collect some candy along the way, so visit the Haven Town Square and turn it in for prizes\!
item.properties|f.shadowsun_slicker: An evil duster that is said to harbor a great power that feeds off of the unforgiven sins of its owners.
conversation.properties|m.rc_recruit_e: I can feel the electricity in the air\!  Looks like we won't be making our final stand tonight after all\!
item.properties|f.magic_hood: An enchanting hood for knights who dabble in divination and contemplate conjuring.
mission.properties|m.new_chapter_3a:
Spiral HQ has authorized you to visit the Hall of Heroes and receive your 2 Star Certification. 

The Hall of Heroes is a place where Knights rising in the ranks like yourself will visit to both learn about and acquire new recipes for gear as well as receive certification to go deeper into the Clockworks. 

Your first visit requires only that you wear all 2 Star gear, which you already have so it should be a piece of cake\!
item.properties|f.fiery_diskgun: A handgun powered by an infernal engine that launches molten disks in rapid succession. Diskgun shots return once reaching their apogee.
conversation.properties|m.fc_court_2: I am a sprite, a force of nature summoned to this realm to extinguish the unnatural fire that is consuming it. But Vanaduke discovered and imprisoned us. I managed to escape, but the other sprites remain in his custody.\n\nNow none may proceed beyond the court as columns of shadow fire block all exits. Shadow fire can only be extinguished with the water that flows from these spirit wells. The water is the purest found in all of nature, flowing directly from the springs within the realm of the Spirit Mother herself.
item.properties|f.vial_fire: A glass vial containing a molten mixture. It can be used to inflict enemies with Fire.\n\nThrow it like a grenade and turn 'em into toast\!
social.properties|e.cannot_friend_gm: You can't be friends with a Game Master. They are like stone.
item.properties|f.trojan_helm: A helm of the stalwart Spiral Wardens that is said to give great comfort to other knights.  Nothing says 'here comes the cavalry' like the sight of these iron giants taking to the battlefield.
support.properties|m.option_4_0: If your complaint was for offensive chat, harassment by player etc. then this would be a good time to ignore {0}, so you're never bothered by them again. Playing a game is about having fun, don't let other players ruin this.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_mat_2: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
mission.properties|m.elig_ok_replay: You are eligible to replay this mission.
item.properties|f.furni_gaslamp_short_bl: A short, elegant street lamp that emits a blue glow with a gentle hiss.
conversation.properties|m.tier_done: Well met, {0}.  Having achieved the required rank, you are authorized to explore deeper depths of the Clockworks.  Good luck to you.
mission.properties|m.darkest_forces_2a: You have a strange definition of recreation if that's the case.  Tier 3 fiends and undead are nothing to sneeze at, in fact they're among the worst creatures you'll find so close to the Core. \n\nDevilite management seems to be the worst at these depths and that results in some very violent devilites.
dungeon.properties|m.leaveparty_return: Leave the party and return to {0}.
trade.properties|e.cart_removed.n: NOTE\: a stack (of {0}) of {1} was removed from the cart.

mission.properties|m.great_escape_4a: Hah\! You'll never reach me in my 'Room of Invincibility'\! You'll be trapped in that control room forever\! ...Erm, wait. I might have overlooked something...
conversation.properties|m.monsterboost_h:
You see that shimmery aurora? 

We have no idea what that is\! 

And while it's pretty from here, we're reading intense energy spikes in some regions down below\!
mission.properties|r.eye_of_needle_4a: I take it the only way to the Core is through the Firestorm Citadel?
conversation.properties|m.af_chat_constr: I need your clothes, your boots and your motorcycle.
item.properties|f.black_kat_hood: A crudely hewn hood made to resemble a shadowy sapper of the ill-fated Kat Tribe.
mission.properties|m.rc_buddyknight_2a: Well then you'll need one of these\!  It's a Proto Bomb and it's good for making things go boom\! \n\nI had an extra one in my pod so consider it an advance reward for saving all our hides here.
item.properties|f.owlite_shield: A wooden ward carved with the crude image of a long-lost Owlite.
conversation.properties|m.mission_collec: This place gives me the chills.
item.properties|f.battle_chef_coat: A coat worn by the knights who work in the Skylark's galley. Not to be trifled with, these chefs are blade masters on and off the battlefield.
mission.properties|m.elig_not: You are not eligible for this mission.

mission.properties|b.p_fiend_test_t1: Please refer to the posted instructions when testing this content.
item.properties|f.toxic_vaporizer: An alchemical bomb that produces a noxious cloud of toxins.

conversation.properties|m.biscotti_3: Thanks {0}, I appreciate it.  And do me a favour, please don't mention this little 'incident' to Spiral HQ...

mission.properties|o.mission_sprite_3: Secure a cache of battle sprites and return them to the Lab
sprites.properties|d.violent_heart_attac: Targets destroyed while enchanted create an explosion.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_nature_sprit: A spirit of Nature willing to wander rather than follow the guide of the Spirit Mother.

item.properties|f.iron_dragon_armor: Armor once worn by a member of the 'Iron Dragons,' a squad of fearless knights that specialized in the elimination of high-profile Morai targets. After disbanding, their surviving members were united with other squads by Desna to form the Recon Rangers.
item.properties|f.wild_stone: A concentrated lump of special food favored by battle sprites who are deeply connected to the natural order of the great wilderness.
item.properties|f.twisted_spine_cone: An enhanced Spine Cone that will thrash opponents with thorns and bury them in brambles.
conversation.properties|m.final_test_kni: I see.  This will be very interesting information for Spiral HQ.  Our base camp in Haven is just up ahead.  Head on up the elevator and meet the other Knights who survived the crash like yourself. The techs in the Lab will be eager to study that artifact.  They'll see to it once you get to Haven. \n\nDon't worry about the others in the Rescue Camp.  Thanks to you, we have a functioning elevator system to reach them.  You've saved them all\!
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_5a: I'll stay here and protect these sprites. Some of these sprite transport crates are empty. I think someone or something is after them. \n\nYou go on ahead and clear the area of hostiles so that a rescue squad can arrive safely.
mission.properties|r.elemental_my_dear_1: Yes, but this time you need to let me-
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_2a: Strangers like Quillion here sell you weapons and armor.  Each one specializes in a particular kind of item, so talk to them and find out what they carry. They're not very chatty, but they always have a fresh stock of items every day\! \n\nJust be sure that you've reached the appropriate rank to equip an item\!
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_3_3a: Congratulations {0}, you meet the necessary requirements and have received your 4 Star Certification.  Take the elevator behind me in order to complete your mission.
conversation.properties|m.rc_sleepy_1a: Training... so hard... just need to rest.... my eyes...
item.properties|f.iron_wolf_coat: Armor once worn by a member of the 'Iron Wolves,' a squad of fearless knights that specialized in the elimination of high-profile Morai targets. After disbanding, their surviving members were united with other squads by Desna to form the Recon Rangers.
conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_5a: We all sensed the moment you defeated Vanaduke. The entire citadel shook as he fell and for a moment we thought that this realm would be destroyed along with its ruler. You must be careful wandering these halls with the place coming apart like this\!
item.properties|f.shadowtech_alchemer_mk: An upgraded Alchemer that fires bolts of shadow at an increased rate.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_8a: Yes, it seems that these sprites have mastered the ability to focus their powers on skills that protect their knight. Given that and their appearance I've dubbed them 'seraphynx.'
mission.properties|b.operation_crimson_h:
Warmaster Seerus is the master of munitions of the gremlin's Crimson Order.  Thought to be the true mastermind behind the Roarmulus Twins and countless other gremlin weapons, he is the Crimson Order's creator and supplier for their diabolical engines of war. 

Recon Knights under the command of Lieutenant Feron recently discovered Seerus's 'Grand Arsenal,' his development center and storage facility for all his weaponry.  Now, Feron himself is leading several squads of knights directly into the Grand Arsenal, with the intention of weeding out Seerus and destroying his war machines. 

Met with heavy resistance, Feron's squads require reinforcements and Spiral HQ is sending you in to assist.
mission.properties|b.p_anniversary_r7: Head Chef of the Skylark, Biscotti, has been tasked with baking cakes to celebrate the anniversary of Spiral Knights.  Something has apparently gone awry in her kitchen and she is requesting reinforcements to provide 'baking assistance.'
item.properties|f.furni_library_lectern_: A podium displaying a magical tome filled with arcane symbols, esoteric formulae, and few particularly rude doodles.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_11: (He appears to be staring very intently at the corner.)

item.properties|f.quicksilver_helm: A fine helmet made out of what was once a Quicksilver.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_heav: Hello {0}, I'm Izola, a knight who utilizes gear fit for a squad guardian.  The recipes I have for you produce highly defensive armor and hard-hitting weapons. \n\nHeavy weapons require precise timing to use effectively and the gear tends to slow you down some.  But what you sacrifice in usability is returned in sheer power.  The gear I specialize in will make you a knight that your squad can depend upon to stay alive and face even the fiercest of monsters.
mission.properties|m.status_deployed: Deployed\nKnights joining a deployed party will not receive completion credit for the mission.
mission.properties|b.p_testmission_1: Start the mission and refer to the testing notes for the depth of each floor.
item.properties|f.furni_clutter_housepla: A breezy blue plant inside a cheerful pot.
item.properties|f.chapeau_rose: An aged, feathered hat that once belonged to a Knight of the Rose, a sacred order of brave and especially dashing heroes whose numerous adventures are the subject of many folk tales. The Knights of the Rose were said to be peerless fencers, believing that their blades were like the flowers of their name\: a delicate thing of beauty that hides a vicious sting.

logon.properties|m.too_many_attempts: You have made too many login attempts. Please wait a few minutes before trying again.

item.properties|f.armor_fallen: A cursed suit of armor once worn by a celestial being cast down from paradise.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_8a: Just one last shop to visit and then we're done. I've saved the best for last.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_kit_2: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
item.properties|f.gold_wolf_coat: Armor once worn by a member of the 'Gold Wolves,' a squad of fearless knights that specialized in the elimination of high-profile Morai targets. After disbanding, their surviving members were united with other squads by Desna to form the Recon Rangers.
mission.properties|o.shopping_again_b: Follow Bechamel on a tour of the Bazaar's more advanced offerings
item.properties|f.raging_dragon_helm: An enchanted helm crafted into the visage of a beast who some believe razed the world in its passing\: its rage became magma rain, its breath a typhoon.
item.properties|f.magic_cloak: A wondrous robe worn by apprentices in the art of spells and sorcery.

helptips.properties|m.scenario_fiendnoti: Due to continual under-performance, there will be no paid holidays or free coffee in the break room.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_1a: Hi there {0}\!  Wow, you've made Soldier already?  You're really moving up fast in the ranks. \n\nAnyway, I'm here to give you a tour of some of the Bazaar's more advanced services. To start, do you want to learn how to even further power up that gear of yours?
item.properties|f.schemer_scrap: A fragment of a blueprint used by gremlin schemers to construct their mechanical monstrosities. With enough of them and a little tape, you could construct a metal death machine yourself\!
item.properties|f.spiral_round_helm: A light helmet issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
conversation.properties|r.fc_greeter_1: I've come this far, I need to move forward.
mission.properties|r.true_champion_2a: I'm looking forward to lots more intel then, Kora.
mission.properties|b.sovereign_slime:
The source of the strange energy signature is believed to be located somewhere in the Royal Jelly Palace, the home to one of the members of the slime aristocracy, the Royal Jelly. 

The might of these sovereign slimes is not to be underestimated.  Should you find yourself facing this hot-tempered highborn, you would be wise to be equipped with the appropriate gear and backed by a full squad of experienced knights. 

It is highly recommended that you equip yourself with pierce resistant gear and shadow damage weapons before deploying for the Royal Jelly Palace\!

mission.properties|r.darkest_depths_5a: Thanks Kora.  I'll do my best.
item.properties|f.stoic_buster: A handgun alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. While wielding it, you sense the quiet passing of the wind and can call upon the rumbling storm that follows.
redeem.properties|e.already_redeemed: The code you entered has already been redeemed. Doh\!
helptips.properties|m.loading7: If you are on fire you will take damage regularly until the fire wears off. That can't stop you from spreading it to monsters though. Get close and share the love\!
mission.properties|m.time_enough_at_last: Oh hello there.  I suppose you're with Spiral HQ.
support.properties|m.header_step1: You are about to file a complaint against another player for the Game Masters to review.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_fiend: A fiendish city is a strange place that Spiral HQ still does not fully understand.  Devilites are everywhere, and if they see one of their Pit Bosses nearby, they will do anything to look like they're being productive.  Unfortunately, productivity is often defined by attacking or imprisoning intruders, like a squad of knights passing through. \n\nIt is unclear what purpose imprisoned knights would ultimately serve in a devilite agenda. Those that have survived captivity have reported that conditions were poor, but the worst of it was the copious amounts of paperwork they had to fill out daily.  This is a fate no knight deserves\!
chat.properties|m.jk_notfound: {0} does not exist on your friend or guild lists.

mission.properties|o.p_anniversary_shock: Check on Groat the Gremlin Chef.
item.properties|f.bucket_of_bloons: This bucket seems to have an endless supply of water bloons. They look ready to pop so throw them at your friends\!
conversation.properties|m.npc_recruit_f: Where is the safety on this thing?
helptips.properties|m.tg1_overgrown_1: I'll leave the next few areas to you. They are pretty overgrown, so keep your eyes peeled for monsters in the tall grass. Some of them are pretty adept at hiding in the shadows. Gives me the creeps just thinking about it really.

mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_5a: Energy can only be obtained by purchase with a real money transaction or for trade via the Exchange. To purchase or trade for energy, simply open the Supply Depot and click the 'Get Energy' button.
item.properties|f.arctic_rogue_mask: A mask said to be crafted by an arctic rogue. The shattered ice will conceal your identity during clandestine arctic expeditions.
item.properties|f.black_chaingun: A highly advanced machine gun designed to output hundreds of rounds of shadow bolts in a very short time. Controlling one of these requires skilled hands.

conversation.properties|m.hav_entryknigh: Did you come from the chasm?  How?

conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_2: Thank you for defeating the Snarbolax. Too many of our squires met an early end because of that beast. I can rest easier knowing that threat is now behind us. \n\nI look forward to hearing about your future exploits, Soldier\!

mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_slime: The best way to keep slimes at bay is with copious amounts of rock salt. Slimes just hate the stuff as touching it makes them dissolve.  It's not pretty. \n\nResearch teams stationed in lichenous lairs will often surround their entire camp with rock salt so that they don't end up some slime's dinner.  As you can imagine, they go through the stuff fast.  When they run low, a squad is called in to battle their way to the camp and deliver the life saving seasoning.

item.properties|f.omega_tortofist: A handgun empowered by the limitless fury of a tortodrone. While wielding it you are capable of unleashing the energy of a legion of tortodrones upon your foes.
item.properties|f.faust: A powerful, cursed sword forged in the Underworld. Its powerful charge attacks can sometimes curse the one that wields it.
item.properties|f.prize_box_gourmet: Contains various unique costumes and weapons used by battle chefs. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.

conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_3a: I'm glad you asked, they certainly do\!  Let's head over to Vatel.
mission.properties|m.ghost_machine_mon_1: SITUATION RESOLVED. PLEASE EXIT THE FACILITY.
uplink.properties|m.bonus_reward: As part of the Homecoming Celebration for the new Guild Hall Expansion, Spiral HQ has authorized you receive these exclusive rewards. \nTo use the Battle Stand, deposit it into your Guild's Treasury and place it in a room in Design Mode. Enjoy\!
helptips.properties|m.tg2_vials_2: The room ahead will give you a chance to try out using vials. Simply press the number key (1 through 5) to the corresponding pickup in your belt at the top of the screen. Doing so will load a vial. Press attack to throw it.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_gate_slime: Deliver a shipment of rock salt to the research team stationed in the lichenous lair\!
conversation.properties|m.hav_guardian_1: Welcome to Haven, {0}, we've been expecting you.
item.properties|f.heavenly_guardian_helm: A brilliant, white helm belonging to a heavenly warrior.
item.properties|e.not_use_snow_bucket: Can't use this item now. It can only be used in town or in a guild hall. There can only be 10 in use at once.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_mat_3: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
conversation.properties|r.tortodrone_hav: Thanks for the tip\! I'll track down those glyphs.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_7: Once you're ready to transmute the item, click 'Transmute' and hold your breath\!
support.properties|m.subheader_step207:
Scamming is when a player is trying to trick you into doing something you shouldn't do. Examples\:
- This could be trying to reveal your account name or password.
- Wanting to trade accounts with you.
- Claiming to be a Game Master or a friend of yours and trying take advantage of that.
There are many other ways to scam.
mission.properties|m.occurance_at_owlite:
...This world has seen few greater tragedies than the fall of the great Kingdom of Almire.  Once a vibrant, beautiful realm of lush forests and sweeping plains... 

...neighboring kingdoms declared war... 

...seeking the power needed to turn the tide, Lord Vanaduke of Almire fled into the mountains...
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: The Swarm keeps growing stronger while The Sleeper grows weaker. Without us, all of us, The Swarm will win. Once, the gremlins were in charge of maintaining Cradle's defenses. But they had their own plans. We need to be Cradle's champions now. \n\nIt's our sacrifice.
mission.properties|o.reporting_duty: Report to Lieutenant Feron in the Haven Arcade
item.properties|f.radiant_crystal: A rare, crystallized formation of heat used to forge higher levels of weapons and gear. The heat within is wild and mysterious, shining brighter than any natural fire.
item.properties|f.decon_rig: An exosuit of structural iron and comfortable conduit crafted from the very bones of Cradle.
item.properties|f.spiral_flak_jacket: Light armor issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
conversation.properties|m.casino_pitboss: The guy in Devil-IT wanted to upgrade our office to all glyph-usage, but I like wasting paper when I can.
item.properties|f.luminite_deposit_3: A large lump of minerals that will generate a great many units of luminite.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_roya: A scaled-down model of the Royal Jelly. He'd probably be flattered by it if he hadn't already been flattened.
item.properties|f.super_dark_matter_bomb: A shard bomb stuffed with even more Dark Matter. How much Dark Matter is too much? This much.
item.properties|f.gsc_vip: A non-transferrable membership in the Golden Slime Casino C.U.B.E. Club. Membership benefits are subject to change.
item.properties|f.vial_shock_super: An ornate glass vial containing hyper-charged electric fluids. It can be used to inflict enemies with Shock.\n\nThis particular vial looks much more dangerous than the standard. Throw it like a grenade and give your foes a real ZAP\!
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_9a: Handy, I'll keep it in mind.  What else you got?
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_cj_wasd_mo: Keyboard used for movement, advanced commands, quickslots and chat
item.properties|f.volcanic_plate_helm: A superior plate helmet imbued with the elemental essence of flame. It's difficult to breathe in, but it can resist high temperatures and any number of savage attacks.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_6a: There were sounds of shouting and explosions coming from the lab just now.  I think we may be under attack\!  Better gear up.  I've no idea what is going on in there but we'd better be prepared for anything\!
projectx.properties|e.name_vulgar: Sorry, that name contains an inappropriate word. Please try another.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: So, you have chosen the fiery drakon, battle sprite of those who prefer frontline, destructive combat? \n\nOnce you choose there is no going back\!
conversation.properties|r.hav_clock_1a: Tell me what you know about the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.gremlin_disguise: A very convincing costume that makes the wearer look like a gremlin.  It's so convincing, you just might receive an invitation to the Colony\!
projectx.properties|d.achievement_773357: Defeat the Roarmulus Twins in the dangerous depths of the Ironclaw Munitions Factory.
item.properties|f.prize_box_surprise: Contains a randomly chosen Prize Box in celebration of the Spiral Order's anniversary on Cradle.  No key required to open.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_stri: Greetings {0}, I'm Echo, a knight who utilizes gear fit for a squad striker.  The recipes I have for you produce weapons and gear that focus on rapid, close-quarters combat. \n\nThe arsenal of a striker focuses on speed.  You want to get in close with your enemy, hit them hard and get out.  The gear I specialize in will make you a knight that leaps into battle ahead of your squad, striking first before they can even fire off a shot.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Careful, those Gremlins have lined the place with barbed wire.
item.properties|f.power_mote: A small morsel of special food favored by battle sprites who align themselves with forces that grant them brute strength on the battlefield.
conversation.properties|m.npc_captainkni: Raise your shield to block attacks\!
guild.properties|log.env_changed: Changed the environment to {0} for {1} crowns, replacing {2}.
mission.properties|m.apocrea_1_2a: You, curious traveler, stand in the Obsidian Nexus, realm of the Apocrea. You will likely never see the sun again.
chat.properties|m.usage_smile: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nSmile at your fellow players.
item.properties|f.gh_theme_freeze: A frosty theme that turns Guild Halls into a popular retreat during the warm, summer months on Cradle.
item.properties|f.sacred_sentinel_helm: A radiant defending doubleweave for insulating against erratic elements.
mission.properties|b.pierce_of_cake: Now that you are undertaking missions in 'Tier 2' of the Clockworks, monsters will begin inflicting special damage types that you need to be aware of and prepare for or else you could face certain doom\! \n\nOne of our lead Biotechs, Hahn, has prepared a brief lesson on piercing monsters.  Speak with him via comlink before taking on any further missions.
guild.properties|i.officer_storage: Community item storage for officers and above.
item.properties|f.fiery_atomizer: A powerful alchemical bomb that creates a dense cloud of highly combustible, searing dust.
item.properties|f.winterfest_tree: A spectacularly spiraling tree decorated in the spirit of Winterfest. Folklore states that Impostoclaus leaves presents for those that have been nice throughout the year while those that have been naughty find their presents filled with jelly. Some believe this is the only reason that chromalisks are hostile.
conversation.properties|t.af_chat_slime_: I have a delicious fruity center\!
helptips.properties|m.tut_hearts_short: If you are hurt, use Hearts to heal yourself\!
mission.properties|m.apocrea_1_3a: The Apocrea are stuff of nightmares\: a terrible legion of otherworldly phantasms whose only ambition seems to be trapping and devouring the souls of all life. \n\nThough you may venture beyond this nexus, you will undoubtedly fall into one of their traps along the way.
conversation.properties|r.rc_end_2a: Once I make it to Haven I really can't come back?
sprites.properties|d.explosive_firestorm: Creates a series of explosions when unleashing the firestorm.
helptips.properties|m.tut_switches: Doors can often be opened by finding the right switch nearby. Have a look around. They are sometimes hidden under blocks.
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_b_4a: Bombs are special in that they have no standard attack.  A bomb can ONLY be used as a charge attack, so make sure to outmaneuver monsters while charging\!
chat.properties|m.usage_helpme: Usage\: /{0}\nTell your comrades that you need help\!
item.properties|f.token_grim: A small wisp of the essential spirit of darkness and decay. It is of extreme value to the Spiral Order. Take it to the Token Trader in the Haven Bazaar\!
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_1a: Hello there, {0}.  The name's Konway.  Spiral HQ says you're in need of some additional pointers to help you out on your upcoming missions.  Care to meet me in the Advanced Training Hall for the rundown?
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_10a: You can find accessory tickets inside lockboxes or at the Auction House if another Knight happens to be selling them.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_gate_gremlin: Steal the gremlin schematics from the gremlin construction site\!
item.properties|f.ticket_variants_3: Use this ticket at the Variant Forge to reset an item's variants to 3 random variants.
mission.properties|m.another_trace_4a: Good luck, {0}.  Be sure to thoroughly prepare before attempting this mission.
item.properties|f.harlequin_cowl: You can't clown the wearer of this colorful cowl or you'll find that you're the punchline.
uplink.properties|t.newsletter: Subscribe to the Spiral Knights Newsletter\!
item.properties|f.avenger: A holy sword created in another time to arm knights who fought against the legions of the Underworld.
item.properties|f.nodeslime_armor: A variegated veiling ward worn by vehemently venerated victors.
item.properties|f.leviathan_blade: A rare treasure of the Spiral Order, the blows from this mythical sword are said to rain down upon its victims like the water from a tidal wave.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: I'll sneak out after it's safe.  Thank you for rescuing me\!
item.properties|f.brute_core: An oozing blue lump from a particularly potent gelatinous opponent.
mission.properties|o.p_r3_mat_0: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
item.properties|f.barbarous_thorn_shield: A mythical shield imbued with the fury of the Snarbolax itself. It's said that the beast can use the glowing orbs on the shield's face to see and stalk weak-hearted wielders.
mission.properties|o.shopping_again: Follow Bechamel on a tour of the Bazaar's more advanced offerings
sprites.properties|d.five_alarm: Increases the duration and size of the firestorm.
item.properties|f.elemental_hood: A mystical mask for sorcerous scrappers that provides significant shielding from the elements.
item.properties|f.vial_fire_ultra: An ornate glass vial containing a molten mixture. It can be used to inflict enemies with Fire.\n\nThis particular vial is the most dangerous of them all. Throw it like a grenade and turn 'em into toast\!
mission.properties|b.operation_crimson_h:
Warmaster Seerus is the evil master of munitions within the gremlin's all-powerful Crimson Order  Thought to be the true mastermind behind the Roarmulus Twins and countless other gremlin weapons, he is the Crimson Order's creator and supplier for their diabolical engines of war. 

Recon Knights under the command of Lieutenant Feron recently discovered Seerus's 'Grand Arsenal,' his development center and storage facility for all his weaponry.  Now, Feron himself is leading several squads of knights directly into the Grand Arsenal, with the intention of weeding out Seerus and destroying his war machines. 

Met with heavy resistance, Feron's squads require reinforcements and Spiral HQ is sending you in to assist.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_shield_1: Let's get one essential survival tool out of the way right now- your shield. Hold [[DEFEND]] to defend with your shield. While defending you will completely withstand most damage from all sides. The gun puppies in the next hallway shouldn't be a problem to get past so long as you defend as you run through.
helptips.properties|m.atg_astation: Arsenal Stations allow you to swap your gear and access loadouts outside of safe havens like Terminals and Subtowns\!
item.properties|f.brimstone: A smelly, stygian, sulfuric shard commonly found in the Underworld.
item.properties|f.gram: An extraordinarily heavy sword whose weight will slow down even the swiftest of knights. That said, just imagine what it'll do to anything you hit with it...
item.properties|f.down_puffer: A puffy, downy jacket. Superior insulation is provided by snipe down feathers. (No snipes were harmed making this jacket, feathers were gathered non-intrusively from free-roaming snipes.)
board.properties|i.playprivate: Create a party that only friends and guildmates can join.
item.properties|f.prize_box_winterfest: Contains various unique Winterfest prizes. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|d.remove_accessory: WARNING\! Deleting an accessory from an item will destroy the accessory.
guild.properties|m.exp_removed: Success\! Expansion removed. Upkeep will be recalculated after your next publish.
mission.properties|m.arc_mintut_3: You will find ore deposits in all levels of the Clockworks, and you must attack them in order to break them down into a size you can carry. You can only pick up one at a time, but you can swap them by picking up another. Look for the biggest, shiniest one you can find. They are the most valuable.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_gate_construct: Gremlins are not very good about cleaning up their messes.  Our Recon Knights will often stumble across what they believe to be decommissioned gremlin weapons factories that are still actively bustling with hostile constructs, and in some cases are even stocked with operational, active war machines\! \n\nSpiral HQ has ordered that whenever possible, these factories and their war machines are to be shut down for good to avoid any future casualties.
chat.properties|m.usage_grant_reward: Usage\: /{0} <account name> <reward id> [reward param string]\nGrants a reward to the identified account.
mission.properties|m.first_contact_1a: Greetings {0}, this is Intel Agent Kora confirming your contact with Spiral HQ. I will serve as your main connection to Spiral HQ during your time here on Cradle and provide you with intel for the many dangerous missions you have ahead of you. \n\nMy data briefing on your training performances in the Skylark suggests that you will be well-suited for what's to come.  I look forward to our working together.
item.properties|f.snarbostuffing: A dense, fluffy stuffing made from a special polymer that doesn't break down when exposed to the cursed fur of the Snarbolax. It's perfect for creating trophies or adorable, cursed, stuffed toys.
mission.properties|b.time_to_crafty: Bosco would like you to alchemize a Hot Edge and Frost Gun for him to inspect. If it's good, he'll inform Spiral HQ that you've grasped the vital art of alchemy and even add a couple powerful Unique Variants to your new weapons.  What a generous guy\!
conversation.properties|r.fountain_1: Thanks for the information, I'm off to explore\!
conversation.properties|t.af_chat_beast_: Maybe they want to play catch?
item.properties|f.almirian_crusader_armo: Armor once worn by the elite royal guard of the kingdom of Almire. Its ivory color was a symbol of Almire's purity, both in the land and in the hearts of its people.
item.properties|f.style_kit: {0}  This item will be destroyed, but you will be able to re-apply this modifier to your knight using the style kit.
item.properties|f.furni_shelf_manor_book: An unassuming shelf filled unworldly tomes of unspeakable power.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_3a: {0}, it is my great honor, in the company of all those who support you and whom you serve, to award you the high rank of Vanguard of the Spiral Knights.
item.properties|f.prize_box_decoration: Contains various festive decorations for your Guild Hall to help ring in the winterfest season.  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
admin.properties|m.load_tester_disabled: Disabled\: to enable, enter a 'pseudoPlayerPassword' in the server configurator.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Can't...go on...
guild.properties|log.mist_removed: Withdrew {0} mist energy from the energy well (new total\: {1}).
item.properties|f.super_food: Feed this to your sprite to fill their heat to max\!
conversation.properties|m.almire_histori: Well, we now know there were massive citadels housing Almire's armed forces and great estates for its noble houses. It must have been quite a sight to see. We assume the rest of the kingdom is still a smoldering ruin somewhere. It is possible that some of it might have survived...though given the anecdotal evidence we think it is unlikely at best.
item.properties|f.flawed_orb: A rare, encapsulated element used in alchemical transmutation. Though flawed, this orb is still useful in crafting low-powered items.
mission.properties|m.toxic_plant_1a:
Alright Rangers, listen up - we've got orders to infiltrate a gremlin bioweapons facility lead by a member of their 'Crimson Order,' known as 'Herex.'  This is just a fancy way of saying that one of the craziest of the crazy gremlins likes to load his gun with unconventional bullets. 

We don't know what he has cooking down there so arm yourself and don't forget to wear a mask. If Herex is anything like Seerus you're liable to catch more than a cold down there. 

Let's ride, Rangers\!
conversation.properties|m.lab_harness_1a: I'm Riley, Morlin's assistant.  I'm in the process of inventing a way to enhance our battle sprites even further.  Check back later once you've acquired a permanently-bonded sprite.
conversation.properties|r.rfc_court_6b: I don't see or hear any of those things.
item.properties|f.quilted_hunting_coat: A flexible coat lined with luxurious stay-alert quilting. It smells musty.
conversation.properties|m.seerus_defeate: I would rather it all burn than give the Arsenal up to anyone else\!
item.properties|f.dread_captain_cutlass: A custom curving cutter kept keen on careless castaways.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_7a: Indeed.  Though their cellular identity is still wholly that of a battle sprite.  My hypothesis is that somehow they rapidly evolved to survive in their new environment, but how?  Our technology could never do something like that...
item.properties|f.vial_stun_super: An ornate glass vial containing shimmering flash pellets. It can be used to inflict enemies with Stun.\n\nThis particular vial looks much more dangerous than the standard. Throw it like a grenade and your foes will be too stupefied to give chase\!
conversation.properties|m.lab_knight3_1a: We managed to pull the secondary generator from the Skylark mostly intact. Unfortunately it's barely powerful enough to keep this lab running, let alone power our ship.  We'll need to find another power source if we ever hope to return home.
mission.properties|o.creators_and_create: Learn about the most powerful construct and gremlin monsters
projectx.properties|m.reboot_msg_timedow: The game will be unavailable for {0} during maintenance.
item.properties|f.sunset_stetson: A sturdy hat for gunslingers that shouldn't cost you much more than a fistful of crowns.
craft.properties|m.name: Name
item.properties|f.sentinel_helm: A helm imbued with the power to repel the various afflictions that knights might encounter in the line of duty.
helptips.properties|m.mineral_tut: Attack to break down minerals and pick them up\! Carry one at a time.
mission.properties|m.breaking_in_recruit: This is no longer routine training\! Get those Recruits to the elevator. We're extracting them back to Haven. You on the other hand need to head down and see who's at the bottom of this.
Gremlins\!? Am I reading this data right? An ambush\!? How were they able to trick our sensors?
item.properties|f.night_cap_round: A comfortable cap for knights to wear at night. Sure to give the wearer a few extra hours of rest.
mission.properties|b.p_ghost_machine_r4:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 


Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has received a distress call from a derelict facility deep within the Clockworks. The distress call came in the form of a digital message saying only 'save us.' Believing it to be a potential trap, Spiral HQ has deployed Desna's Recon Rangers to investigate the facility and assist anyone who may have sent the message.
item.properties|f.prize_box_hazardous: Contains various unique items used by Rhendon's elite Scarlet Scouts. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
projectx.properties|m.return_to_wegner: Return to Wegner for more info about minerals.
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_b_: You made it, {0}\!  I'm happy to see you arrive here in Haven safe and sound.  I'll confirm with Spiral HQ that you will now be undertaking missions in Haven. \n\nTo start, I've issued you a few missions that will help get you acclimated with all that Haven has to offer.  Be sure to say hello to the Strangers as you begin exploring.
item.properties|f.fencing_jacket: A loose-fitting frock favored by fledgling fencers.
mission.properties|m.prestigious_opportu: Greetings {0}, and congratulations on becoming a Squire\!  Your performance has caught the attention of Spiral HQ and they have given you authorization to now take on Prestige Missions. \n\nPrestige Missions are select missions offered to you daily that offer prestige as rewards for completion.  Sometimes these missions require supplying Spiral HQ or other Knights with items and other times they will have you exploring the Clockworks.
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: Tell me about the other battle sprites.
exchange.properties|m.paypal_tooltip: Checkout with PayPal in your browser.
item.properties|f.punkin_pie_slice: A hot steamy slice of pie.
item.properties|f.circuit_breaker_armor: Armor with a hacked elemental core aimed at resisting shock. However, this non-standard modification creates other elemental weaknesses.
helptips.properties|m.loading5: You can see what your friends are up to by clicking on the social button in the bottom left corner of your screen. You can even instantly join them if there is room in their party.
item.properties|f.frost_gel: A drop of chilly gunk collected from a cool Clockworks customer.
conversation.properties|m.monster_codex_: Zombies \nShambling Zombies will rise from the dead if killed near a Grim Totem. Draw them away so you can give them eternal rest.
mission.properties|b.explosive_plot: Recon Knights have discovered what they believe to be a gremlin-hatched plot to destroy Haven\!  As a Knight Elite, you have been selected by Spiral HQ to investigate this matter.  Contact Intel Agent Kora for details.
item.properties|f.gift_of_autumn: A rare charm cherished by travelers that fortifies the wearer during the winter season.
item.properties|f.polar_night_wolf_hood: A warm hood, favored by those knights stationed in the polar regions. The thick fur is needed during their never ending night patrols.
conversation.properties|m.af_chat_11: Never pay more than 20 bucks for a computer game.
item.properties|f.wyvern_scale_helm: Made from the scales of rare Clockworks beasts, this sturdy helmet is resistant to even the highest of temperatures.
item.properties|f.furni_clutter_skbedrol: A soft sleeping bag perfect for whenever you're "roughing it". For a Spiral Knight stranded on Cradle, this is most of the time.
item.properties|f.fire_raider_helm: A pristine raider helmet, save for a few dings and a thick coat of ash.
item.properties|f.valestone: A fabled mineral of a vibrant, green color said to contain the essence of all natural life.
item.properties|f.silvermail: Strong, yet light armor for knights who've sworn an oath to hunt down and destroy the undead, wherever it may lurk.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_weap_5: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
