Synchronizes the game display with the monitor's
output to help prevent screen tearing,
but may affect framerate with less 
powerful systems.
item.properties|f.jelly_shield: A strange looking shield created from jelly matter. Like many slime monsters themselves, it provides the user with exceptional defense against piercing damage.
mission.properties|m.reporting_duty_3a: That's exactly right\! The Core of the Clockworks could very well contain the energy source we need to create a new power source for the Skylark and restore it to operational condition. There's only one problem- the Clockworks themselves seem to be built like some kind of crazy death trap. \n\nReaching the Core is not going to be easy...
item.properties|f.silver_key: A special key that can open any lockbox.  Once used, the key is destroyed.
exchange.properties|m.trade4energy_toolt: The best current market price. A response of ??? indicates that there is no current market offer for the amount you've entered.
exchange.properties|m.credit_card_toolti: Purchases the selected amount of Energy right now with your credit card.
item.properties|f.crystalline_defender: A durable, high quality shield clad in protective glacial ice suitable for any adventure.
helptips.properties|m.unlock_gold: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to use the Gold Key.
item.properties|f.justifier_jacket: A finely-made suit for danger-seeking gunslingers who would much rather be quick than dead.
auction.properties|m.listing_tip: The listing fee is refunded upon sale; a fee of {0}% of the sale price will be taken.
sprites.properties|d.dazzling_light_ray: The ray of light deals extra damage to undead and fiend family monsters.

The Clockworks have been so consistent for so long\! Just ticking along like, well... you know. But now *something is happening* and I don't know what it is\!\!

social.properties|m.trade_request: {0} would like to trade with you.

projectx.properties|e.name_too_short: Sorry, valid names must be at least 4 letters long.
mission.properties|m.verify_exchange: Confirm these items to be exchanged for the Mission Rewards.
item.properties|f.prismatech_alchemer: An alchemical handgun that fires bullets of photon-charged liquid that split on impact.
item.properties|f.deadly_virulisk_mask: A Virulisk Mask upgraded with an advanced toxin filter. It always smells like artificial pine needles on the inside.
mission.properties|o.operation_crimson_h: Join Lieutenant Feron in a siege of the Grand Arsenal of Warmaster Seerus.
item.properties|f.shadowsun_stetson: A dashing hat for duelists who prefer to get their work done at midnight, rather than high noon.
uplink.properties|m.ironclaw_start:
Intel Agent Kora here, we have intercepted gremlin transmissions from this facility that indicate they are building some kind of weapon to destroy Haven\!  It is your mission to infiltrate the facility, destroy this weapon and save Haven from destruction\! 

Known only as 'Project Roarmulus,' it is said to be impenetrable from standard attacks.  You will have to find a way to break whatever armor it is using.  Intel suggests this weapon is located deep within the facility. 

But getting to it won't be easy.  You will find that gremlins have little care for a safe work environment as live rockets seem to be fired every which way at all times.  However you should be able to utilize the 'polarity walls' you will find in testing environments to block the oncoming rockets.  Look for a purple and gold switch to toggle them. 

We've also detected another Recon Module of the Alpha Squad somewhere in this factory.  Retrieve it if you can\! 

Good luck\!
sprites.properties|d.venom: Increases the potency of the poison inflicted.
sprites.properties|d.drakon: The drakon is a battle sprite that embodies fiery destruction. Its skills focus on raw, offensive power.
item.properties|f.spoiled_treat: A terrible tummy ache awaits those who partake in the fetid fare of Winterfest past.
projectx.properties|p.use_style_kit: Spend 1,000 crowns to modify your style?
item.properties|f.gilded_griffin: A beautiful pistol named after a great, noble beast. Its golden frame was believed to provide light within the impenetrable darkness of the Underworld.
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_tall_ora: A tall torch filled with otherworldly orange fire.
item.properties|f.virulisk_suit: A thick set of gear crafted from the carcass of a Virulisk. Wearers will inherit some of the Virulisk's poison resistance, as well as its taste for flan.
helptips.properties|m.loading9: If you become stunned you will move and attack slower than usual. This can leave you as a prime target for larger monsters that you can normally outrun, so watch out\!
item.properties|f.aegis: A sublime shield entrusted to only the most worthy members of the Spiral Order. Whether its crest is a relic from the Order of old or a creation from the Knights' time on Cradle is not immediately clear.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_kit: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
pvp.properties|m.love_unapprove_confirm: Are you sure? You will be able to make changes again, but the approval process will be started over.
item.properties|f.nether_shell: A shield alchemized from the shell of a corrupted tortodrone. A tormented howl of rage can be heard on the wind when this shield smashes through your foes.
item.properties|f.crown_fallen: A cursed crown once worn by a celestial being cast down from paradise.
helptips.properties|m.atg_eblocks: EXPLOSIVE BLOCKS will cause damage to anything around them if hit.
helptips.properties|m.tut_weapons_short: Use [[NEXT_WEAPON]] to cycle your equipped weapon.
item.properties|f.permafroster: Tech Knights are not yet sure if targets of this deep-freezing handgun ever actually defrost. So far, 'no.' Permafroster shots become more powerful the further they travel.
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_15: I'd like to see the services again. (Follow Tylen)
mission.properties|m.first_contact_b_3a: Wow, it sounds like you've already had quite the adventure, {0}\!  Spiral HQ will most certainly be interested in that artifact you recovered.  It's remarkable that you were able to face off against a gremlin in the Clockworks and survive.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_gate_undead: The ruins of Owlite castles are dark and cursed places that are swarming with legions of undead spookats.  The worst of these, the seemingly invincible grimalkins, constantly lurk in the shadows, awaiting the moment your life-saving light is finally snuffed out. \n\nSome knights succumb to the darkness and become paralyzed with fear in these shadowy realms. The only thing that can save them are brave knights who have long lost their childhood fears of the dark and all the terrible creatures that lurk within.
mission.properties|r.new_threat_10a: There was an attack.  The Artifact's been stolen\!
mission.properties|b.p_r6_weap_3: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
social.properties|m.watch_full: Oops\! That party is no longer accepting new watchers.
mission.properties|o.p_ghost_machine_r7: Join Desna's Recon Rangers in discovering the source of the distress call within the derelict facility.
mission.properties|m.true_champion_1a: {0}\! Oh, {0} you made it\! Haha\! \n\nI am so happy you came out of there alive\!  I was worried sick about you\!
social.properties|m.they_already_played: {0} has already completed this mission today.
help.properties|m.controls_attack: [[ACTION]]. Hold to do a charge attack. [[ACTION]] also lifts large items, speaks to NPCs, and activates stations.
item.properties|f.plated_shade_helm: A helm of fiendish fabric interlaced with dark matter to conceal its wearer while they creep in camoflauged corners.
projectx.properties|m.logoff_required: This change will cause you to log off and reconnect.
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_tall_pur: A tall torch filled with peculiar purple fire.
conversation.properties|m.hav_clock_2a: I will share with you what I know, little one.
conversation.properties|m.rc_technician_: Power has come surging back to the camp\!  You did it, {0}\!
mission.properties|m.eye_of_needle_4a: It's all a bit too convenient.  But do gremlins really have this kind of power?  I suspect something more than even what they are capable of engineering. \n\nIn any case, this Almire, it's not a kingdom any longer.  All that remains is a great citadel that seems to be engulfed in never-ending flames that Spiral HQ has been calling the 'Firestorm Citadel.'  From what we can tell, the whole place is swarming with undead and built like a fortress.
social.properties|m.join_guild_mission: Join your guildmate {0} at depth {1} on the Mission\: {2} ({3})
conversation.properties|m.monster_codex_: Royal Jelly \nThis massive gelatinous cube has a short fuse and loves to throw his weight around. When his royal tasters are absent a poisoned parfait would be a royal pain.
item.properties|f.soul_dust: The dust of the departed. Whether it still retains any shred of a soul remains to be seen.
pvp.properties|m.no_reward: You have dishonored my great Coliseum with your lack of fighting spirit\!  You shall receive no Krogmo Coins and no rank points\!
item.properties|f.heavy_deconstructor: An upgraded Deconstructor that will wreck robots and crush constructs in a wider area.
mission.properties|o.p_anniversary_shock: Check on Groat the Gremlin Chef.
item.properties|f.prize_box_frenzy: Contains various unique costumes and accessories crafted from thunder and lightning. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Whatever that was, we're here now. Wherever here is. It looks like our only option is to see where this leads.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogmas: Trespassers within my Arsenal?  I'll see to it you go... quietly.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_plump_rooste: An impressively-large Buhgok that is taking a nice, long rest after a hearty meal.
item.properties|f.obsidian_edge: A sinister sword made from the obsidian obelisks found within the realm of the Apocrea. Simply holding it makes you somehow feel guilty of an unknown crime.
chat.properties|m.inv_cannotinvite: You may not invite others (the party is locked or full).
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: I'm not ready to choose yet.
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_1_1: Well met, {0}\! Glad to see Spiral HQ sent us some reinforcements, and not a moment too soon\! Our backs are against the wall and we need your help\!
guild.properties|log.mist_added: Deposited {0} energy to the energy well (new total\: {1}).
arena.properties|m.revive_desc: Use a Spark of Life to revive early and gain an edge in battle.
item.properties|f.furni_spiralorder_sund: Supply canisters containing everything a Spiral Knight needs to get going in the morning.
item.properties|f.training_room: A simple room providing access to a private guild training hall, perfect for learning new skills or keeping old ones current.
item.properties|f.bottomless_stocking: An interdimensional tear in this fuzzy fabric sock swallows any item placed within it.  It even swallowed the stitches.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: The Alpha Squad's sacrifice will not be in vain. I will immediately order our forces to undertake special Operations Missions all over Cradle. If there are forces trying to free The Swarm, we'll have to stop them.
mission.properties|m.crossing_chasm_b_1a: Thought you could just walk away with the artifact did you?  Hand it over now or I'll light this fuse and turn you into a million, tiny, smoldering bits\!
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_snar: A small Snarbolax statuette, showing the savage shadow in a stunned state.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_5a: Euclid wasn't your typical knight.  By the time most in his division were getting their Squire crest, he had already achieved Vanguard.  As a Squad Leader, he lead a series of successful assaults against the Morai during the liberation of Isora.  A brilliant tactician, he was known for getting the job done with half the knights of other squads.
item.properties|f.lockbox_character: A special lockbox that contains one of many unique items that modify the appearance of your Knight\!  It can only be opened with a Silver Key.  Silver Keys can be purchased from the Supply Depot.
chat.properties|m.usage_loadout: Usage\: /{0} [loadout]\nList loadouts, or equip a named loadout.
conversation.properties|m.rc_end_3a: No, you won't be able to return. Once you reach Haven your training is complete and your new objective will be to aid the Spiral Knights who are now based in Haven.
auction.properties|e.please_wait: The auction house is busy, please wait a moment and try again.
item.properties|f.divine_star: A perfect crystalization of special food favored by battle sprites who forever bask in the light of the heavens.
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_wasd_move_: Keyboard used for movement, advanced commands, quickslots and chat
mission.properties|b.p_r3_gate_gremlin: Gremlin construction sites often contain valuable schematics of gremlin structures and even weaponry.  Once obtained by Spiral HQ, they provide rare insights into gremlin engineering. \n\nGremlin schematics are typically stored in terminals somewhere on site.  These terminals are locked down and heavily guarded.  Once you draw the attention of one gremlin, expect the entire crew to come after you\!
social.properties|m.autofriend_single_to: Your {0} friend {1} just started playing Spiral Knights as {2}\! You already have the maximum number of friends, so you were unable to be auto-friended.
board.properties|i.formparty: Create a party that anyone can join.
mission.properties|b.rescues_and_recycli: A 'Deconstruction Zone' is a gremlin work site where gremlins seem to tear apart existing levels and use the components to build new levels. Their ability to rapidly engineer levels and machines is incredible, surpassed only by their hostility to anyone who crosses their path. \n\nRecon Knights have discovered that a squad may have observed their engineering marvels a little too closely as they are now being held captive in one of the deconstruction sites near depth 10.  It is unclear what the gremlins have in store for these knights or if they simply plan on letting them perish along with the rest of the level they are dismantling.
conversation.properties|m.casino_monster: I don't think anyone will notice I'm missing.
projectx.properties|m.warning_info: You have received the following message from the Game Masters\:\n\n {0}
item.properties|f.amputator: The culmination of slime family research, the heated reciprocating blades cut through all slimes with surgical precision and prevent their gelatinous bodies from reforming.
mission.properties|o.p_halloween_r3: Seek an audience with the Punkin King.
projectx.properties|i.antialiasing: Smooths edges and improves graphical quality\nbut may reduce graphical performance at higher levels.
item.properties|f.armor_back: An accessory that can be attached to the back of select armors.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
item.properties|f.furni_crate_toughbox_s: It's a rough and tumble security container used for a variety of purposes.
item.properties|f.captain_coat: A seaworthy greatcoat outstanding for spaceage swordplay.
item.properties|f.shard_bomb: A shard bomb formed from a small explosive encased in depleted Crimsonite. Depleted or not, this sucker can sling some serious shrapnel.
item.properties|f.deadshot_chapeau: A mythical hat for those that never miss their mark. It's rumored to have been made from cloth that was previously interred.
uplink.properties|m.detached_accessory: Spiral Knights had a change and the attached accessory was removed from your {0}.\n\nApologies.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_7a: Hsst\! So, you're the ones who defeated Razwog and took what was mine.  You are not worthy of possessing this powerful Artifact and so I am here to relieve you of it.
item.properties|f.somnambulists_totem: An ordinary object with a unique texture and weight, the result of having been partially digested by a Sloombargo.
item.properties|f.padded_cap: A one size fits all light helm that is typically worn by gunslingers.
item.properties|f.plated_pathfinder_armo: A hardened set of armor made to protect against even the most voracious monsters while exploring the unknown.
item.properties|m.unlock_box_prompt: A Silver Key is required to open this Lockbox. Lockboxes contain random prizes inside.
mission.properties|m.breaking_in_recruit: Greetings, little. One. Don't step. On snipes.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_gate_slime: The best way to keep slimes at bay is with copious amounts of rock salt. Slimes just hate the stuff as touching it makes them dissolve.  It's not pretty. \n\nResearch teams stationed in lichenous lairs will often surround their entire camp with rock salt so that they don't end up some slime's dinner.  As you can imagine, they go through the stuff fast.  When they run low, a squad is called in to battle their way to the camp and deliver the life saving seasoning.
projectx.properties|x.rename_desc2: On success, you will be briefly disconnected.
item.properties|f.prize_box_chess: Contains one randomly-chosen Chess Mini liftable statue furniture.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|m.trinket_tip_locked: Trinket Slot (Buy Trinket Slot Upgrade to Unlock)
item.properties|f.firecracker: A Proto Bomb modified to generate small bursts of fire upon detonation.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: Very good, {0}. You will find a new set of missions for you under Operations. These new missions will be grouped according to their overall objective and can be tackled in parallel to each other. This should allow you maximum flexibility in order to respond to each new threat as they come up. Farewell, {0}, 'Guardian of Cradle'.
item.properties|f.punch_gun: Used to blast open damaged drop pods, this emergency rescue tool doubles nicely as a powerful, single shot handgun.
mission.properties|r.shadow_knows_1a: Well Hahn, that's an awfully warm-
conversation.properties|m.npc_veteran_d: I have to keep these new recruits out of trouble.
dungeon.properties|i.difficulty_medium: Advanced difficulty features an increased challenge for players who have a thorough grasp of combat. Monsters can deal and receive more damage and traps are more dangerous. Heat, crown, loot payouts and chances for rarities are increased.
item.properties|f.volcanic_salamander_ma: A Salamander Mask reinforced with volcanic iron. In the field it can be used as a makeshift coffee pot, so long as you don't mind coffee that tastes a little like lizard.
item.properties|f.enamorock: A strange stone that makes you have warm and fuzzy feelings inside just by holding it.
item.properties|f.plasma_cell: A high-tech plasma source that could positively blind someone with science.
help.properties|m.monster_1: Monsters in the Clockworks are divided into six distinct families, each with their own strengths and weaknesses. Be sure to equip yourself accordingly before venturing below ground\!
mission.properties|m.intro_prestige_lock: Complete Rank Missions to gain access to Prestige Missions\!
projectx.properties|d.achievement_cb03dd: Earn clearance to explore Tier 3 of the Clockworks.
exchange.properties|m.steam_success: Thank you for your purchase\! Your Energy will be delivered momentarily.
item.properties|f.flourish: A stylish saber well-appointed to foiling your enemies.
conversation.properties|m.arc_mintut_3: You will find ore deposits in all levels of the Clockworks, and you must attack them in order to break them down into a size you can carry. You can only pick up one at a time, but you can swap them by picking up another. Look for the biggest, shiniest one you can find. They are the most valuable.
exchange.properties|m.crowns_tooltip: Go to the exchange where you can trade Crowns for Energy or Energy for Crowns.
sprites.properties|d.virulent_quills: Each time a quilled target is hit there is a chance to trigger a poisonous explosion.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_overgrown_2: Looks like you know how to handle yourself. That's good, because the final area is just ahead.
social.properties|m.befriend_message_nam: Enter an optional message to {0} with your friend request\:
mission.properties|m.name: Name
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: We need you to get inside and take out those cannons\!
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_10: Your sarcasm has been noted. \n\nNow then, about those empty sprite transport crates; we have confirmed foul play.
item.properties|f.groundbreaker_helm: A sturdy helm worn by knights who were among the first to brave the depths of the Clockworks.
conversation.properties|m.sl_guard_2: Recon Knights who have ventured within these strange, new worlds claim to feel a dreadful darkness enveloping them at every turn.  There's something else happening here and we need our most elite knights to investigate.
conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_4: We've doubled the amount of patrols around Haven in case there is another attack, but I have a feeling that those gremlins already got what they came for...
item.properties|f.furious_fork: A good chef knows when to flip burgers. A great chef cooks burgers while they flip them.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_gate_fiend: Free the captured Knights from a fiendish corporate prison\!
conversation.properties|r.ritual_2c: No thanks, I'll hang on to this book for now.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_roar: A miniature model of one of the Roarmulus Twins. It is mercifully inactive.
item.properties|f.obsidian_shard: A jet-black shard of unnatural stone. Holding it fills your head with imagery of a distant shore where waves crash against rocks that seem to writhe in the chill of the water.
dungeon.properties|m.final_test_2_desc: The route to Haven is suspended high above a perilous clockwork chasm. Prepare yourself, danger is sure to lurk around every corner\!
conversation.properties|r.hunter_1a: I've seen my share of danger, and I like it.
item.properties|f.member_door: Installs a force barrier at the entrance of the room that can only be passed by guild members of Member rank and up.
conversation.properties|r.tut_intro_1a: Roger that, I'm on my way\!
item.properties|f.acheron: Striking with the savage power of the Underworld, this dark weapon has been known to drive weak-minded knights to the brink of madness.
item.properties|f.deadly_crystal_bomb: A large chunk of Moonstone and Valestone alloy primed with a potent explosive. Studies have shown that this bomb can be used to reduce a zombie's craving for brains by up to 100% by blowing them to pieces.
chat.properties|m.usage_grant: Usage\: /{0} number\nGives you a number of crowns.
support.properties|m.subheader_step208: Hacking is when someone is trying to get a hold of your account name or password, or already has done this.\n\nThe vast majority of hacking issues, aren't actually hacking, but careless sharing of accounts or passwords. You should never share your password with anyone for any reason. Game Masters will never ask for it either.
mission.properties|r.true_champion_1a: It's good to know you care, Kora.
conversation.properties|m.mission_crimso: The Nine see all, hear all.
conversation.properties|m.energy_info_3c: Energy can only be obtained by purchase with a real money transaction or for trade via the Exchange. To purchase or trade for energy, simply open the Supply Depot and click the 'Get Energy' button.
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: Thank you, Morlin. I will do my best to raise this sprite well.
mission.properties|r.pumping_up_9b: Thanks\! I'm off to train. [Complete mission]
item.properties|f.prize_box_spiralhorn: Contains various unique accessories and items to celebrate the Year of the Ram\!  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
item.properties|f.ancient_plate_shield: An antique shield whose origins have been lost to the passing of time.
item.properties|f.obsidian_mantle_of_inf: 'Speak with the one, true voice and they will listen. Quiet as a child's whisper, roaring like the death of this world.'
item.properties|f.freeze_barrier: Surrounds you with icy orbs that can freeze hostiles in their tracks
mission.properties|r.shopping_again_12b: Thanks Bechamel, I'll be seeing you\!
item.properties|f.raiment: A long, flowing battle garb best accessorized with a pair of angelic wings.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: Greetings, {0}\! Now that I've had sufficient time to research the battle sprites you rescued I can give you a proper evaluation of each. \n\nDespite their well, strange appearance, we have concluded that these 'new' battle sprites are not only suitable for combat but may have even further enhanced capabilities as a result of their transformation.
item.properties|f.cosmic_stone: A concentrated lump of special food favored by battle sprites who hail from space deep beyond the furthest of stars.
social.properties|m.autofriend_multiple_: Some of your {0} friends already have a full friend list\:\n{1}\n{2}
mission.properties|r.first_contact_b_4a: I'd like to help however I can.  Where is Spiral HQ now located?
guild.properties|log.upkeep_paid: Upkeep paid\! {0} crowns removed from the guild treasury.
mission.properties|o.the_flickering_flam: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
mission.properties|m.great_escape_2a: Behold\! The Sparkcaster 9000 Deluxe\! A triumph in gremlin engineering\!
item.properties|f.heavy_splinter_bomb: A solid chunk of synthetic mineral with an explosive surprise inside. Wolvers hate surprises.
helptips.properties|m.atg_pots: Some objects like pots can be thrown at switches AND enemies\!
social.properties|m.party_progress: {0} cannot join until the party reaches depth {1}.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_5a: {0}, something big is going down at the Lab.  You need to get here immediately\!
item.properties|f.cryotech_alchemer: An alchemical handgun that fires hyper low temperature bullets that split on impact.
item.properties|f.royal_jelly_crown: Ruggedly royal regalia recently reproduced from regally resinous remains.
sprites.properties|d.valkyrian_aura: Party members within the protective aura gain a charge speed bonus.
item.properties|f.shade_helm: A dark matter infused helm that allows its wearer to get the drop on foes by shooting straight from the shadows.
conversation.properties|m.hav_clock_3a: It is hard to know exactly as so much of what is within seems to hold their origin from different worlds. Some appear to be from realms of great antiquity, no doubt once home to innumerable old gods and creatures.\n\nThis world is an unnatural one. What you see within it was never meant to be here. The great histories of so many worlds endlessly churning through the cogs of this great machine... I find it quite sad.
item.properties|f.coin_bonus_upgrade_1: Once used, this upgrade will increase Coins earned in Coliseum games by 1 for 24 hours.  You may have up to 6 Krogmo Coin Boosters active at any time.
exchange.properties|m.confirm_low_sell:
Your sell offer has a lower price than the current best buy offer.
Probably you made a mistake.
Your sell price\: {0} crowns.
