item.properties|f.haze_bomb_mkii: A Haze Bomb modified to disperse noxious chemicals over a wider range.
item.properties|f.spiral_crescent_helm: A light helmet issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_3b: Each battle sprite will learn three skills that you can use in combat. Skills are learned automatically at certain levels as the sprite levels up. \n\nCombat skills become stronger with skill points.
item.properties|f.winterfest_coat: A supremely soft and seasonally stylish suit that radiates with wondrous Winterfest cheer. It tells everyone that when it comes to the holidays, you mean business.
guild.properties|i.member_storage: Community item storage for members and above.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: The seraphynx is a battle sprite that embodies protection and restoration. Its skills focus on supporting knights in combat\: ray of light creates a steady beam of holy light, heart attack increases the chance of hearts dropping from monsters, and angelic aura creates a light shield that protects its knight and party members within. \n\nThe seraphynx is best suited for knights who wish to protect their party and provide them aid.
mission.properties|b.p_anniversary_r4: Head Chef of the Skylark, Biscotti, has been tasked with baking cakes to celebrate the anniversary of Spiral Knights.  Something has apparently gone awry in her kitchen and she is requesting reinforcements to provide 'baking assistance.'
conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_4a: Even though you have defeated Vanaduke, it appears as though the curse he brought down upon this kingdom still lingers. It requires all of our power to keep these raging shadow fires in check.
item.properties|f.irontech_bomb: A heavy bomb wrapped in thick iron plates. Though it is slower than most bombs, it packs a powerful punch.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_8a: Parma was the youngest of the bunch, a very talented Recon, but with little combat experience.  She and I went to academy together and I can remember the day when the simulator technicians had thought their program was busted due to Parma's performance.  She actually apologized\! \n\nBut still, I'm worried about her.  From the reports that I've read, the Clockworks are unlike anything we've ever encountered.  I only hope that as she keeps them informed of what's ahead, that they will watch her back.
mission.properties|b.ancient_generator: The Rescue Camp has no power and with it, no means of defending itself from the onslaught of monsters that attack it in the night.  With the sun setting fast, it's up to you to enter the dark depths below the camp and locate an Ancient Generator. \n\nIf you can restore power to the camp, the Spiral Knights can power their turrets and create a defensive perimeter. Once secure, it may be possible to reconnect with Spiral HQ.
mission.properties|b.chilled_to_bone:
By now you have no doubt run into strange, undead monsters known as 'spookats.'  Recon Knights have finally discovered what seems to be the source of these ghostly cat-like creatures. 

Large concentrations of spookats have been sighted in what is believed to be the darkened remains of an owlite castle.  Dubbed the 'Candlestick Keep' this shadowy realm is only illuminated by a series of owlite candles.    

Proceed with caution while exploring outside the light of the candles.  Lurking in the dark are enormous spookats known as 'grimalkins.'  Grimalkins seem to withstand all weaponry and are to be avoided.  Your only defense is to stay in the light\! 

Spiral HQ has issued you this mission in order to collect more data on the origins of the spookats and the mystery behind the fall of the owlites.  Investigate the Candlestick Keep and report your findings\!
mission.properties|r.first_contact_b_5a: Thank you Kora, I'll try to find a way across the chasm to Haven.
social.properties|m.play_pvp: Sign up for a game of {0} {1} in the Coliseum\!
item.properties|f.feral_cannon: A handgun alchemized from a hardened tortodrone shell. While wielding it, you can feel the penetrating energies within just waiting to be unleashed.
item.properties|f.gh_env_snowing: A beautiful environment that fills your Guild Hall with perfect snow\: the kind that gently falls from the sky and never collects on the ground, melting into gray muck.
conversation.properties|m.mission_locked: We were securing the elevator when the door shut behind us.
mission.properties|b.hall_of_heroes_5: It is time you entered the Hall of Heroes once more.  Having been fully Star Certified and successfully completed so many missions that have ensured the survival of the Spiral Knights on Cradle, Spiral HQ is preparing you for the high rank of Vanguard.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_weap_2: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
item.properties|f.grate_plate: A protective plate with peephole perforations permitting ventilation of exhalations.
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft3_r9: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
mission.properties|b.becoming_champion: Having heard of your many accomplishments and successful missions completed for Spiral HQ, Lieutenant Feron would like to speak with you.
sprites.properties|d.iron_harness_eli: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal normal damage. \nReduces cooldown of all skills by 10% \nCan be used by\: All battle sprites
item.properties|f.master_blaster: This advanced sidearm is an excellent choice if your adventuring party happens to need another hero.
helptips.properties|m.lock_striker: Out-run anyone with the Striker Dash, hit'em hard and then leave them in the dust\! \n\nBe the ultimate damage-dealer with an increased overall attack damage and the fastest sword\!
mission.properties|b.p_r4_mat_012: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
mission.properties|m.rc_buddyknight_5a: It seemed like the world itself tried to trap you back there, what a close call\! \n\nKeep your wits about you when you go off exploring the Ancient Generator below.  If the surface of this world is crawling with monsters and rigged with traps, who knows what you'll find down there in the dark\!
item.properties|f.galactic_guardian_helm: A commemorative helm that pays tribute to the countless brave Isoran guardians that have protected spacefaring crews in their adventures across the stars.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_1a: Alright, {0}, let's get started. Looks like you and I get to go on a little sprite hunt, eh? \n\nI've aligned my tracker with the recon knight intel but something's not right. The energy signature I'm detecting is erratic, but still definitely a battle sprite. They may be in trouble, so let's hurry\!
conversation.properties|m.npc_recruit_g: Have you seen a danger room yet? I hear they are really tough.
mission.properties|r.ending_in_fire_2a: What have you got for me?
mission.properties|o.p_r7_weap_3: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_kit_2: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.
item.properties|f.cloak: An extraordinary cloak favored by the students of the arcane.
item.properties|f.buckled_coat: A verdant coat fastened with shiny golden buckles.
chat.properties|m.talk_self: Talking to yourself is a sign of insanity.
item.properties|f.nefarious_raiment: A raiment said to be crafted by a nefarious imp. The ethereal plates will defend against heinous harassment while they shroud you in darkness.
conversation.properties|m.monsterboost_s: Spikes go in. Flying razor disks of barely-understood primordial energy come hurtling out\!
item.properties|f.furni_pet_wandering_sn: A curious snipe that will explore its surroundings.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_c2f28b: Complete a Tier 1 expedition without having to revive.
guild.properties|m.name_in_use: Sorry, that name is already in use.
dungeon.properties|m.goahead_prompt: Invite party members to follow you\:
item.properties|f.fuel_canister: A small receptacle once used to hold fuel for a complex machine.
item.properties|f.frenzy_rider_mantle: A legendary suit of armor thought to be worn by a god who used frenzy to carve whole worlds from stone.
item.properties|f.fearless_rigadoon: The ultimate in paralyzing piercers, it's unclear whether its elegance or its wicked bite is what leaves opponents stupefied.
guildhelp.properties|m.record_info: The Guild Record logs important recent activity within the guild, such as donations to the Guild Treasury, deposits to and withdrawals from the various Guild Storages, and promotions, additions or departures of guild members. They allow higher-ranked guild members to track who is donating or taking a lot from the guild, and act accordingly.
help.properties|m.support_5: For additional help options, please head to our official Support Page.
conversation.properties|m.casino_pitboss: I promoted myself to Senior Manager of Ghastly Implements of Destruction.
item.properties|f.volcanic_salamander_su: A Salamander Suit reinforced with sturdy plates of volcanic iron. Extremely protective, and usable as a makeshift stove during long deployments.
mission.properties|o.p_apocrea_r7: Investigate the area of the Clockworks where several knights have gone missing.
item.properties|f.furni_chess: A statuesque figurine, ideal for use in a board game.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_3a: Wow, {0}, you seem to have a way with battle sprites\! Let's not waste any time. Clear the path ahead so a rescue team can get through safely\!
conversation.properties|r.sprite_tut_3a: And how does my sprite evolve?
item.properties|f.garden_snipes_room: A peaceful garden home to a number of Snipes. Perfect for both relaxing and spinning wildly in place.
global.properties|e.invalid_xfer_state: An error has been detected with your knight. Please log off and back on again. If the problem persists, please file a bug report.
conversation.properties|r.ritual_1b: I think I have something that might be of interest to you.
helptips.properties|m.new_sprite: You've got a battle sprite\! Press [[SPRITE_ACTION_1]] to use your sprite's battle skill\!
item.properties|f.savage_tortofist: A handgun alchemized from a hardened tortodrone shell. While wielding it you can feel the primal energy of a rampaging wolver pack within waiting to be unleashed.
item.properties|f.furni_counter_spiral: A modular piece of counter that can be combined in infinite ways. Always be careful when working with infinity.
exchange.properties|m.offertobuy_tooltip: Enter the price, in crowns, that you are willing to pay.
item.properties|f.prize_box_rage: Contains various unique costumes and accessories crafted from thunder and lightning. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.prize_box_equinox: Contains various unique costumes and accessories celebrating Cradle's equinox\!  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_gate_construct: Gremlins are not very good about cleaning up their messes.  Our Recon Knights will often stumble across what they believe to be decommissioned gremlin weapons factories that are still actively bustling with hostile constructs, and in some cases are even stocked with operational, active war machines\! \n\nSpiral HQ has ordered that whenever possible, these factories and their war machines are to be shut down for good to avoid any future casualties.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_1a: Welcome to the Bazaar, {0}\! Would you like a tour of the shops or services?
mission.properties|r.darkest_forces_2a: They weren't exactly easy going to begin with...
mission.properties|r.pumping_up_2b: No thanks, I'll wander around on my own.
invite.properties|m.description_invitati: Invite a friend to come join you in\nSpiral Knights\!\nFill in their e-mail address and we'll send them an invitation to join.
item.properties|f.power_mitt: A must have in every kitchen. The comfortable fit and heavyweight silverweave surface are great for handling high heat. Now you're cooking with power\!
helptips.properties|m.wolver_den: Wolvers are a highly adaptable pack beast whose predatory instincts are only matched by their quick reflexes.  They play with their prey by dancing about and finally striking from behind.  Keep a blade handy.
auction.properties|e.selected_updated: The selected auction has been updated.
mission.properties|m.darkest_depths_3a: It's just a feeling really.  I hear it from some of the other knights as well\: a feeling like we... belong here, like maybe the crash occurred for a reason. \n\nBut that just can't be, right?  In any case, I'm rambling now.  Back to the mission\!
uplink.properties|m.bid_complete: Thank you for using the Haven Auction House, your shinies are always appreciated.
support.properties|m.subheader_step2_ema: We have saved the offending email already waiting to be added to the complaint, so there is no need to hurry from here. Please carefully choose the correct option matching what the player did\:
mission.properties|o.the_gauntlet: Battle your way to the Firestorm Citadel through a bulwark of monstrous might
mission.properties|o.p_r4_mat_2: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
guild.properties|m.storage_warning: WARNING\: Items left here can be taken by any guild member of the appropriate rank.
item.properties|f.plated_pathfinder_helm: A hardened helm made to protect intrepid explorers while they explore the unknown.
mission.properties|o.scarlet_fortress: Chart an expedition through the haunted halls of the Scarlet Fortress
item.properties|f.prize_box_rose_regalia: Contains various unique Rose Regalia costumes and accessories. Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
mission.properties|r.alchemy_beginners_9: Let's go over it all one more time.
item.properties|f.prize_box_obsidian: Contains various unique and terrifying items found within the realm of the Apocrea. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: {0}, this is almost certainly a trap and I can't ask you to come with me, but I'm going in there. If there's even a chance that Rulen and the other Alpha Squad members are alive I need to try and find them.
item.properties|f.woven_shade_helm: A loose fitting helm that enables its wearer to slink through the shadows and assault unaware enemies.
design.properties|e.room_already_placed: That room has already been installed at another location.
admin.properties|d.load_tester: Spawns PseudoPlayer clients to test the server. Not recommended for use on production deployments\!
help.properties|m.support_3: If you're having problems with another player, click on them and choose the Complain option for assistance.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_bc04ed: Earn clearance to explore Tier 2 of the Clockworks.
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_6a: I'd like to see the shops again. (Follow Tylen)
sprites.properties|d.vengeful_quills: Each time a quilled target is hit, another quill is fired from the target to the next available target.
item.properties|f.exp_west_3f: An expansion that adds two rooms and a small overlook to the western side of the Guild Hall.
mission.properties|m.darkest_depths_2a: Yes, it has become something of a second home for us hasn't it?  Almost like we belong here, it's strange.
help.properties|m.monster_fiend: Deal SHADOW - Weak to PIERCING - Strong against SHADOW
mission.properties|b.p_halloween_r6: Every year the Strangers of Haven pay tribute to a peculiar spirit known as the 'Punkin King' in order to ensure a healthy fall harvest.  This mischievous phantom delights in playing tricks on his audience but is quick to reward them with delicious candies for their troubles. \n\nCelebrate the Dark Harvest Festival and help the Strangers by seeking out the Punkin King and paying tribute.  You're sure to collect some candy along the way, so visit the Haven Town Square and turn it in for prizes\!
guild.properties|m.hall_now_closed: {0}'s Guild Hall is no longer open to the public.
item.properties|f.black_kat_cowl: A cursed cowl that is brimming with dark energy. It is said to resemble the great Kat Tribe hero, Margrel, the one who opened The Book of Grey Feathers and brought about the Kataclysm. It brings great misfortune to anyone who dares to wear it.
support.properties|m.subheader_step201: Spamming is when someone repeats text or sends long lines of random characters with the sole purpose of annoying others because it fills up the chat screen so they can't chat normally.\n\nIt's important that you only file a spam complaint when the spamming was so bad that you couldn't chat with others. For example a couple of lines of a few characters, while not necessary perhaps, is not bad enough to file a complaint for. Also if the repeated lines are far between (like 10 seconds between) then it also won't prevent people from chatting, even if it may be annoying that they're just writing nonsense.
item.properties|f.ultra_fire_barrier: Surrounds you with deadly fiery orbs that can set hostiles ablaze
item.properties|f.electron_charge: A small electro-explosive charge with mysterious origins. It is capable of generating a crippling vortex of electricity.
item.properties|f.obsidian_obelisk: A jet-black stele of unnatural stone from the realm of the Apocrea. As you gaze upon it the stone seems to writhe and pulse with an eternal energy that is simultaneously alluring and sinister in a most grotesque manner.
dungeon.properties|m.golden_slime_prize_: C.U.B.E. Club Members may spin up to 50 times at once.\nRequires Golden Slime Coins.
mission.properties|m.first_contact_b_4a: Looks like I need to get you up to speed.  We've crashed on a planet known as 'Cradle.'  Cradle is a fascinating world in that the entire interior of the planet below its surface is an ever-changing mechanical complex known as the 'Clockworks.' \n\nThe Clockworks seems to have been built by 'gremlins,' a furry race of malevolent monsters that have not taken kindly to our presence.
helptips.properties|m.event_locked_modul:
Warning\! An unidentified place of interest lies beyond this gate. By entering you will not be able to turn back until you complete the challenges within.

However, should you manage to come out victorious you will be rewarded for your bravery. Enter at your own risk\! 

This room offers a bonus chance at the treasures within.
item.properties|f.justifier_hat: A finely-made hat for handgun experts who think nothing of spending a few crowns more on a high-quality piece of gear.
item.properties|f.wise_owlite_shield: It doesn't take a renowned Owlite scholar to figure out that defending oneself with a shield is an excellent idea.
mission.properties|m.honor_duty_3a:
Aye, as do we all. 

Now then, {0}, you need to prepare for what's to come.  Reaching the Core is only the beginning for us.  I suspect that Spiral HQ will be issuing you many more missions in the future that could only be taken on by someone of your ability. 

And finally, it is my pleasure to inform you that you will soon be awarded one of the greatest honors of the Spiral Knights, the rank of Vanguard.  I will see you in the Hall of Heroes.
item.properties|f.nightmare_mane: A coat of coarse fur taken from a Snarbolax.  Each fiber seems to curl and fray as if life is still flowing through it.
item.properties|f.spiral_scale_mail: Durable, light mail that provides protection from piercing attacks.
uplink.properties|m.newsletter: Subscribe now and get a free Proto Crest accessory\!
item.properties|f.grand_flourish: A fanciful blade for those who prefer to solve their problems with a hop, a skip and a stab.
item.properties|f.beast_basher: A powerful pick modified to add an extra helping of hurt to beast family monsters.
item.properties|f.empty_room_catwalk: An empty Guild Hall room with industrial flooring and plenty of space for furniture\!
projectx.properties|m.love_opt_in_notice:
By enabling this option, you will gain access to knight-created arenas.
You can browse, test, and play community-made content, as well as upload your own.

All arenas are subject to approval by coliseum crew before becoming part of the playable pool.
Please review the information and terms before continuing.
item.properties|m.use_change_color: Use your {0} to change your personal color?
help.properties|m.monster_beast: Deal PIERCING - Weak to PIERCING - Strong against ELEMENTAL
item.properties|f.rock_jelly_helm: A tough topper tailored from jagged jelly.
logon.properties|m.peer_shutdown: The peer to which we connected is shutting down. Please wait a moment before trying again.
conversation.properties|m.rc_recruit_a: We may not have power, but the least I can do is get a fire going to provide a little light tonight.
item.properties|f.electron_vortex: An Electron Bomb modified with a payload of unstable organic essence. Foes caught in its punishing blast radius are cruelly referred to as "thunderstuck".
mission.properties|b.p_r7_mat_3: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
mission.properties|o.operation_crimson_h: Join Lieutenant Feron in a siege of the Grand Arsenal of Warmaster Seerus.
item.properties|f.winged_helm: A helm whose design evokes an almost heavenly beauty.
conversation.properties|r.sl_guard_2: Got it.  What else do I need?
mission.properties|m.new_chapter_1a: Congratulations on becoming a Soldier, {0}\!  I hear you really gave that Snarbolax a clobbering, well done\! \n\nWe've had an opportunity to analyze Euclid's recon module you discovered in the Snarbolax's lair.  Based on the recording, it seems that Euclid suspected something our Geo Knights discovered sometime after the crash- that the levels within the Clockworks are comprised of terrain from multiple alien worlds\!
item.properties|f.tusk_helm: Modeled after noble beasts known for their strength and fearlessness, this helm strikes such terror and respect in its wearer's enemies that the deeds will be talked about for ages to come.
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: The maskeraith sounds like the battle sprite for me\!
item.properties|f.warmaster_helm_2: A remake of a mask once worn by Warmaster Seerus of the Crimson Order.  Though it very much resembles the original, it is still missing pieces.
mission.properties|m.first_contact_b_5a: We discovered a town known as 'Haven' and have set up a base of operations there. The locals have provided us with food, shelter and power.  It's not Isora, but it's home for now. \n\nI've pinpointed your location.  Unfortunately you'll need to cross a massive chasm in order to reach Haven.  Perhaps now that your camp has power there is an elevator somewhere leading into the Clockworks.  You may just be able to reach us that way.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_1_3c: Please take the elevator behind me in order to complete your mission.
guild.properties|log.door_placed: Placed a {0} for {1} crowns, replacing a {2}.
item.properties|f.ice_queen_mail: A regal suit of armor resembling the ever-frigid Ice Queen.  In addition to providing great defense, it is said to dramatically boost one's ego and create a cold detachment from those around them.
conversation.properties|m.rescued_strang: Hello little one.  You will find there are many dangers in this new world but also many opportunities for the adventurous and brave\!  A fellow of yours awaits you just up the path.  We will undoubtedly see each other again.  Farewell for now\!
item.properties|f.dark_matter_deposit_1: A small mineral deposit that will generate a single unit of dark matter.
dungeon.properties|m.core_desc: The ultimate objective of the Spiral Knights, the Core is like a titanic heart, ever beating life through the world surrounding it.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_4a: Uh, I think these sprites are studying these old books. I didn't even know they could read\! \n\nAnyway, I'll stay here and protect these sprites. I see more empty transport crates; not good. You go on ahead and clear the area of hostiles so that a rescue squad can arrive safely.
conversation.properties|m.tut_intro3_2a:
I've established a comlink with Knights that have formed a Rescue Camp up ahead.  If you head north, you should eventually reach it. 

I'm going to stay here for now and locate any other Knights that have crashed in the area.  I'll meet you at the Rescue Camp before sunset. 

And should you encounter anything really dangerous, press [[?DEFEND]] to use your shield\!
helptips.properties|m.tg2_welcome: Welcome back to the Training Grounds. This one is designed to teach you about special items that are found within the Clockworks called "pickups."
mission.properties|b.p_r9_gate_beast: Our Geo Knights risk their lives working in the wilds of the Clockworks.  While their findings are invaluable, they are often stationed in the very heart of wolver territory.  These wild beasts relentlessly stalk our Geo Knights, snatching them in the night when unguarded.  Sometimes, wolvers will form a pack and assault an entire research team.  It is during these times that a talented squad must be called in to save them.
item.properties|f.wild_hunting_blade: A legendary cutter feared by even the mightiest of Wolvers and Chromalisks.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_3c: See Riley here in the Lab to purchase new harnesses. Once purchased, a harness is automatically added to your harness list in the battle sprite interface. \n\nAdditionally, any time you purchase a direct upgrade to a harness you own, it will be replaced by the superior harness.
projectx.properties|m.confirm_delete: To confirm deletion of this character, type "{0}" below.
item.properties|f.dark_matter_bomb: A shard bomb formed from a small explosive encased in Dark Matter. Since its original discovery, Dark Matter has been put to a variety of uses, from powering Spiral technology, to rearranging Gremlins on a subatomic level.
mission.properties|o.rescues_and_recycli: Shut down the gremlin deconstruction site and rescue the captive knights
item.properties|f.firetail_mask: A simmering simian mask made to celebrate the new year. The searing silhouette will display your dominant demeanor.
mission.properties|m.cwt_mintut_3: Attack a mineral column in order to break it down into a size you can carry. You can only pick up one at a time, but you can swap them by picking up another. Look for the biggest, shiniest one you can find. They are the most valuable.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_2a: Who doesn't right?  Let's head over to Punch and Vise's workshop.
projectx.properties|m.save_continue: In order to access this feature, you must create an account to use when logging into the game.
helptips.properties|t.tg1_overgrown_1: See you on the other side
conversation.properties|m.rc_injured_d: With the power restored, I was able to mend my armor. Let's hope I don't run into too many of those monstrous rust buckets again\!
item.properties|f.trinket_slot_upgrade: Once used, this upgrade opens a trinket slot for {0} days.
conversation.properties|n.rfc_dungeon_2a: I was imprisoned here over a thousand years ago for speaking out against my liege lord, sentenced to be here for a lifetime as my punishment.  When the fires overtook the citadel even in my passing I did not find freedom.  My soul is bound to these cursed stones.
mission.properties|r.new_threat_5a: Roger that, I'm on my way\!
mission.properties|o.p_r4_mat_012: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
item.properties|f.volcanic_plated_shade_: A helm of fire retardant fabric interlaced with dark matter to conceal its wearer while they hide in heated hallways.
conversation.properties|r.och_leader_1_2: I won't let you down, Lieutenant.
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_1a: Welcome to the Haven Bazaar\!  It's a pleasure to meet you {0}, my name is Bechamel. Since I work here in the Bazaar, Spiral HQ has asked me to show new arrivals around this fabulous epicenter of commerce and let them know everything it has to offer. \n\nSo let's go on a quick tour shall we?  Try and keep up, I walk fast.
mission.properties|o.guardians_of_cradle: Join Spiral HQ and discuss what to do next
item.properties|f.grintovec: Your enemies will surely enjoy the cool, refreshing sensation of being hit by a glacier.
item.properties|f.mercurial_demo_helm: A demo helm made from gremlin technology. It is for the bomber that wants a boost of speed, more power and a greatly reduced chance of dying by electrocution... which is probably every bomber out there.
item.properties|f.airbraker_shield: A lightweight, compact, and pneumatically-activated shield that expands its surface area against enemy attacks.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_roya: A jolly piece of jewelry formerly borne by the Royal Jelly himself. It is jauntily perched on a gelatinous pillow.
mission.properties|r.mission_sprite_1_8a: Perhaps gremlins are trying to steal our technology?
design.properties|m.room_install_warning: You are paying to install this room. If for any reason it is removed you will have to pay to install it again.
helptips.properties|m.battle_arena_3: Truly you are among the greatest of all warriors who have ever lived\! The bounties of the Arena King are yours for the taking\!
item.properties|f.bombastic_demo_suit: A fine set of armor specially forged for those select few individuals who can handle explosives with panache and flair... while managing to avoid blowing themselves up.
guild.properties|i.guild_shop: Purchase guild furnishings and upgrades using funds from the Guild Treasury.
item.properties|f.vial_shock_ultra: An ornate glass vial containing hyper-charged electric fluids. It can be used to inflict enemies with Shock.\n\nThis particular vial is the most dangerous of them all. Throw it like a grenade and give your foes a real ZAP\!
exchange.properties|i.mini_buy: Instantly buy energy with crowns at the energy exchange.
dungeon.properties|m.goahead_title: Go on ahead of your party?
mission.properties|b.first_contact_b: With the power restored to the Rescue Camp, you can now use your comlink to contact Spiral HQ and find out where they have located after the crash of the Skylark.  Once you have made contact with Spiral HQ you will hopefully find out what caused the crash and the nature of this alien world you now inhabit.
mission.properties|o.p_ghost_machine_r6: Join Desna's Recon Rangers in discovering the source of the distress call within the derelict facility.
item.properties|f.magister_robe: A ceremonial robe worn by learned masters of the arcane arts, who often leave their keys in one of the many inner pockets.
mission.properties|b.darkest_depths: Having defeated the Roarmulus Twins and recovered the Alpha Squad recon module, it's time to check in with Intel Agent Kora to get a report on the analysis of the module and information about your new access to some of the deepest depths of the Clockworks.
mission.properties|m.ancient_generator_1: What do we have here, more little creatures that came from the sky?  Here to take my power and disturb my research? \n\nNo one disrupts the work of the great Schemer Razwog\!  I'll see to it you never leave this room alive\!
shop.properties|m.cart_recipe_learned: You have already learned this recipe\!
mission.properties|m.pioneers_9a: Rulen was recruited as the technical genius that Captain Ozlo believed would be required for navigating the vast, mechanized world of the Clockworks.  His primary responsibilities included everything from disabling locks to repairing armor to wrecking sentient constructs.  He was additionally the lead on analyzing the Core once the squad reached it.
mission.properties|m.arc_mintut_6: Our geological research is ongoing, so there may yet be other fascinating uses for these strange and powerful minerals.
conversation.properties|r.energy_info_1a: Clearly I really should know all about this, tell me more\!
mission.properties|o.skies_under_cradle: Chart an expedition through the Aurora Isles
item.properties|f.hazardous_draped_armor: Loose-fitting armor worn by more experienced Scarlet Scouts. It's rumored that gear like this is crafted from the remains of armor from Scouts who fell in combat, acting as a reminder that unless necessary Scouts never leave a man behind.
item.properties|f.elemental_blaster: An enhanced blaster modified to fire elemental rounds.
helptips.properties|m.atg_togtraps: Some traps are always active.  Find a switch to turn them off\!
item.properties|f.icebreaker_shield: A Frostbreaker Shield modified for increased protection against freeze.
mission.properties|o.p_r6_gate_undead: Save the lost Knight from joining the ranks of the dead in the haunted manor\!
uplink.properties|m.returned: Your attachment was never accepted\n\nOriginal mail\: {0}
item.properties|f.confetti_dark_harvest_: Celebrate the Dark Harvest Festival by launching a sizeable gourd into the air. What comes next is up to the Punkin King...
item.properties|f.alpha_claw_gauntlet: A protective Wolver-hide gauntlet affixed with razor sharp claws.
social.properties|m.invite_persona: Select the player you wish to invite\:
conversation.properties|m.npc_spikedata_: What might the gremlins be doing with all of these spikes?
item.properties|f.advanced_cautery_sword: A Cautery Sword with an additional saw function adapted to cutting through the bony spines of larger Lichen Colonies.
helptips.properties|m.danger_module: Warning\! The path beyond this point is far more dangerous than what you would expect on this level. By entering you will not be able to turn back until you complete the challenges within.\n\nHowever, should you manage to come out victorious you will be rewarded for your bravery. Enter at your own risk\!
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research_: Having smashed the most terrifying zombies to dust, escaped the cold maws of grimalkins and stood victorious in battle against an army of trojans, you have no doubt collected samples from these encounters that would be of great use to Spiral HQ's research teams.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Hang in there\!
mission.properties|r.mission_sprite_3_8a: I assume you've named them as well?
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_tall_gre: A tall torch filled with ghastly green fire.
helptips.properties|m.final_test: You've made it this far knight - but your final exam will require quick thinking and even faster feet.
mission.properties|m.ancient_generator_2: You nasty, little things\! Don't you dare touch the artifact\! \n\nArgh\! I'll be back for you\!
item.properties|f.gigawatt_pulsar: A powerfully enhanced handgun that hits foes with the force of a lightning bolt. Pulsar shots become more powerful the further they travel.
item.properties|f.fireburst_brandish: An upgraded Brandish infused with the elemental essence of fire.
uplink.properties|i.crystal: The amount of energy to attach.
helptips.properties|m.shop: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to browse vendor goods.
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft3_r6: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
exchange.properties|m.coinex_offer_cance: You have been refunded {0} energy for your cancelled energy offer.
pvp.properties|m.autotarget_off: Krogmo has turned off autotarget for this match only.
mission.properties|m.becoming_champion_3: Then use them with honor and let them protect you from the fury of the countless foes you will soon face.  The Core that we seek, there's something truly dreadful about it.  I know that it may very well be what gets us home, but I can't shake this feeling that we've been thinking about it all wrong.
uplink.properties|m.autoprune: Note\: Mail is automatically deleted 30 days after sent date.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_14: You can find accessory tickets inside lockboxes or at the Auction House if another Knight happens to be selling them.
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft3_r7: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
conversation.properties|m.fc_court_remin: Once you find a sprite, carry them back to the sacred circle you see before you. They are no doubt weakened from Vanaduke's curse and will require rejuvenation. Once we are all reunited we will form a focus link with the Spirit Mother and bring water to the wells.\n\nPlease hurry\!
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_3_3: Aye, it appears I'm no longer fit for this fight.  It's up to you now, {0}. You alone possess the strength to face Seerus and bring him to justice.  Many knights have lost their lives here today.  Honor their spirits by finishing the job\!
item.properties|f.no_door: Removes any door presently installed and leaves the room open for anyone to enter.
item.properties|f.sacred_shade_helm: A helm built to outlast whatever might slink from the shadows.
item.properties|f.furni_gaslamp_tall_ora: A tall, elegant street lamp that emits an orange glow with a gentle hiss.
item.properties|f.rocky_core: A delicious gummy treat with an impenetrable rocky shell. More than a few teeth have been lost by knights attempting to get at the gooey interior.
conversation.properties|m.guard_laborato: I'm sorry, {0}, you are not authorized to enter the lab yet.
chat.properties|m.usage_cry: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nCause your knight to cry.
mission.properties|o.crossing_chasm_b: Cross the chasm with Rhendon and reach Haven
conversation.properties|r.monsterboost_s: And... Anomalie is signing off on this?
guild.properties|m.rename_too_soon: You have renamed your guild too recently.
item.properties|f.spark_life: A powerful charge of pure energy that instantly revives you or a fellow party member.
conversation.properties|m.monster_codex_: Battlepod \nThese immobile automatons hide a small arsenal beneath their double plated armor. Each Battlepod has a unique combination of attacks and defenses sure to keep you guessing.
item.properties|f.flare_popper: While never intended to be used in a party, Recon Rangers like to shoot signal flares into the air to celebrate missions where everyone comes back alive. Sadly, any Ranger will tell you that far too few of them are ever sent burning into the sky.
mission.properties|o.terminal_meltdown: Destroy the fiery monsters in the fuel depot and prevent an explosive disaster
conversation.properties|m.hav_clock_3b: There are different theories. Some say the gremlins that you see working on it now are responsible. But that seems too great even for their seemingly infinite work force. Even with the means to do so, how did they "start?" Where did they find the power?
mission.properties|b.best_of_beast: After a recent promotion, Biotech Hahn has earned the title of 'Chief Biotech.' He was informed of your recent accomplishments and would like to give you a quick briefing on what you can expect from the beast and slime family of monsters as you approach the Core.
item.properties|f.blizzbreaker_armor: A reliable set of armor adept at shrugging off the coldest of shoulders. It's not bad at resisting freeze attacks, either.
item.properties|f.arc_razor: A finely-crafted mechanical sword that flings sharp bolts of energy outward when swung.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_1a: Greetings, {0}\!  We have two missions of vital importance.  First, we've located an energy signature similar to the one emanating from that Artifact you found in the Clockworks.  We're homing in on that energy signature now.  Finding the source might help us understand what that gremlin schemer Razwog planned on doing with the Artifact or what the device is actually capable of.
redeem.properties|e.invalid_code: The code you entered was not found. Please double-check it and try again.
conversation.properties|m.hav_snipes_1a: Please be careful not to step on any of the snipes, little one.
help.properties|m.tier_3_monster: Monsters can utilize attacks that deal pure special damage (PIERCING, ELEMENTAL or SHADOW). Equip yourself appropriately\!
item.properties|f.storm_dragon_helm: An enchanted helm crafted into the visage of a beast who some believe created the world in its passing\: its fire the sun, its bones the mountains.
support.properties|m.option_201_1: If you're convinced this qualified as spamming then click OK to file the complaint.
item.properties|f.rigadoon: A stunning saber that will leave your opponent quite off their guard.
item.properties|f.volcanic_plated_pathfi: A hardened set of armor, reinforced with volcanic alloys, made to protect against the toastiest of monsters while exploring the unknown.
helptips.properties|m.elevator: The elevator will activate when all living party members are standing on it.
support.properties|m.transfer_item: Transfered item "{0}" from knightId\:{1} to knightId\:{2}. (count \= {3})
item.properties|f.sacred_keeper_helm: A cerulean hued helm for those who want to wreck some robos.
exchange.properties|m.fee: For every trade, the energy seller pays the {0}% trading fee from the crowns.
item.properties|f.pollinator_plate: Styled after the unsung heroes of the hive. Fashionable, functional, and a little fuzzy.
shop.properties|m.name: Name
item.properties|f.capsule_remedy: A small capsule that refreshes its user. It can be used to remove all status conditions you're afflicted with.\n\nDon't panic\! Remedy capsules can be a life saver, if you remember to use them\!
conversation.properties|m.arc_leader_4: That's the kind of spirit I like to see. It works like this\: you use the gates up ahead to explore the Clockworks and retrieve special minerals. Then you deposit those minerals back in to gates to change the Clockworks below, creating new, unexplored levels.\n\nWe believe the minerals are the key to opening a path to the Core, we just need to discover how to use them\!
item.properties|f.ironwood: A pristine log of one of the hardest substances known to the Spiral Knights.
item.properties|f.tundrus: A modified magnus that ensures that if somehow your target survived the first shot, they will still be frozen in their tracks. A charged shot can even plow through multiple enemies.
mission.properties|b.alchemy_beginners: Alchemy is a craft mastered by the Spiral Knights that allows for the inherent powers of various materials to awaken and fuse with each other in order to form powerful, new items\!  The Spiral Order has relied on alchemy as their primary means of creating the very arsenals that Knights have relied upon for centuries. \n\nDiscover how it will become an important part of your survival on this alien world.
conversation.properties|m.af_chat_04: They're coming out of the walls\!
mission.properties|o.faith_armor: Navigate the trap-filled chamber and rescue the apprentice, Wilks
uplink.properties|m.tf2_end:
To Whom It May Concern\: 

I have confirmed your arrival at the Clockworks Terminal, and have obtained the relevant data regarding our competitor's catalog. Mann Co. appreciates your cooperation in this task. 

In return for your assistance, we have remitted to you one (1) Mann Co. Brand "Spiral Sallet" replica headwear. No refunds or exchanges will be offered for this reward, and Mann Co. is not liable for any injury sustained while attempting to use said reward. 

Regards, 

Mister Reddy 
Mann Co. 
"We sell products and get in fights." 

The information in this mail is confidential and is intended solely for the addressee. Access to this mail by anyone else is unauthorized. If you are not an intended recipient, you must not read, use, think about, eat or seduce the information contained in this mail. Failure to comply with this request will result in the recipient being mauled by bears to within the fullest extent of the law.
item.properties|f.frenzy_caller: A party favor of the gods, used to summon a flash of frenzy from the heavens.
mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_4b:
Lastly please instruct your division to cease using our mail system to inform other Undercorp divisions that 'The freezing corruption of lord Maulos is inescapable.'  Improper use of the mail system hurts productivity. 

As your division's disciplinary action will undoubtedly result in relocation to the Eternal Torment Division, this will likely be our final correspondence.  I wish you luck in your continued career here at Undercorp. 

Cheers, 
Morgral'm 
Assistant Supervisor of Resource Allocations, Undercorp 

Attached\: Amu-Sol.pip
item.properties|f.buccaneer_broadsider: A fearsome firearm fitted with a flintlock. The vintage mechanism's reliability has been enhanced with a bit of gremlin know-how.
item.properties|f.eye_pack_amazing: Contains three amazing eye shapes for your style kit\: Clover, Skull, and Circuitry.
exchange.properties|m.billing_bad_securi: Please check that the CVC or CVV security code is correct and try again. Your card has not been charged.
mission.properties|b.whipping_mishandlin: After Recon Knights discovered a fiendish city known as Sol' Fork, Spiral HQ deployed a research team to station itself in the heart of the city and study the devilites within.  Their findings have become the basis for our understanding of devilite culture and their motives for working with gremlins. \n\nThis research team is in desperate need of supplies in order to maintain working on-site.  It would be of great help to Spiral HQ's continued research to have a squad enter the city and deliver the necessary supplies.
chat.properties|m.usage_haven: Go to your last Haven place.
item.properties|f.draped_armor: A stylish suit of armor that adds a touch of class to battle.
chat.properties|m.usage_broadcast: Usage\: /{0} message\nBroadcasts message to everyone online.
mission.properties|m.search_continues_4a: I don't know, but it is certainly a terrifying picture she has painted. Something stirs within the heart of this world, {0}, something terrible.  I've felt it since we first set foot on this world; invisible eyes watching our every move, shapes that form just out of view... something greater than gremlins calls this world home.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: Hail, Vanguard {0}. Kora said you had news of the Alpha Squad. Please, give us your report.
chat.properties|m.usage_game: Usage\: /{0} message\nSends a message to everyone in the game.
projectx.properties|m.reboot_desired: Server will reboot due to code update when all players log off.
mission.properties|o.monstrous_research_: Turn in the requested materials to Biotech Hahn for research.
item.properties|f.prize_box_slumber: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Slumber style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
projectx.properties|i.render_effects: Enables more detailed graphical effects, but\nmay reduce graphics performance with less powerful systems.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_gate_gremlin: Gremlin construction sites often contain valuable schematics of gremlin structures and even weaponry.  Once obtained by Spiral HQ, they provide rare insights into gremlin engineering. \n\nGremlin schematics are typically stored in terminals somewhere on site.  These terminals are locked down and heavily guarded.  Once you draw the attention of one gremlin, expect the entire crew to come after you\!
chat.properties|m.usage_admin: Usage\: /{0} message\nSends a message to all admins.
item.properties|f.prize_box_companion: Contains various items for your sprite and a chance for rarities. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_gate_beast: Rescue the Geo Knights from the clutches of wild beasts\!
item.properties|f.heavy_hatchet: A big blade intended to fell trees. Unsurprisingly, you can also use it to fell enemies, blocks, mineral deposits and most anything else you'd care to hit with it.
item.properties|f.serene_helm: An ancient, resilient helmet covered in a soft layer of moss.  Within the cool, stony interior of this helmet you can hear a faint and soothing song formed by the rustle of winds traveling from distant lands.
conversation.properties|m.rescue_knight_: Whew\! It was cramped in there.
item.properties|f.gremlin_suit: A special suit tailored by a gremlin's touch to fit the frame of a knight. It protects the wearer while providing a full range of motion for thwacking, knocking, or mending.
sprites.properties|d.golden_harness: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal piercing damage. \nCan be used by\: Seraphynx, Maskeraith
item.properties|f.arcana: An exceptional handgun that fires powerful, elemental shots that many Spiral Knights refer to as 'magic missiles.'
item.properties|f.heavenly_iron_armor: A powerful suit of armor said to be crafted from angelic shields.  It retains many divine properties celestial beings possess but lacks their weakness to fire.
mission.properties|b.p_anniversary_r3: Head Chef of the Skylark, Biscotti, has been tasked with baking cakes to celebrate the anniversary of Spiral Knights.  Something has apparently gone awry in her kitchen and she is requesting reinforcements to provide 'baking assistance.'
chat.properties|m.usage_pgo: Usage\: /{0} player name\nMoves to the location of the named player.
conversation.properties|m.gh_bechamel_1: Greetings {0}, what can I help you with?
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_2a: Welcome to the Advanced Training Hall, {0}.  Here you will find useful survival tips to help you on your journey through the Clockworks. \n\nWould you like a tour of the facilities?
mission.properties|m.true_champion_2a: Well, as far as I'm concerned this is only the beginning for you, {0}.  You are a true Champion of the Spiral Knights.  And since I haven't been reassigned, I suppose it's just the beginning for 'us' as well\!
conversation.properties|m.rc_injured_a: Last night terrible monsters attacked us in the darkness.  It was utter chaos. With no power for the turrets we couldn't defend ourselves. \n\nSo many brave Knights lost...
item.properties|f.furni_library_lectern_: A podium displaying an ominous tome filled with unreadable scribbles and smudged ink prints of Kat paws.
item.properties|f.polar_night_warden_hoo: An insulated hood that will keep a knight warm when facing bitter polar winds. The full coverage mask makes it ideal for hours of nighttime watch duty.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_3a: Feeding your sprite materials is the fastest way to level it up. Talk to Biscotti here in the Lab for more information on sprite feeding.
item.properties|f.blast_powder: A dangerous by-product produced by fire-based organic creatures. Gremlins like to use it to blow stuff up.
mission.properties|b.hall_of_heroes_3: In order to venture even deeper within the Clockworks you must visit the Hall of Heroes and speak to Lieutenant Barrus to receive your 4 Star Certification.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_4a: (Kora pauses) \n\nSpeak of the devil, Rhendon is calling now; says it's urgent. Patching him through...
mission.properties|m.explosive_plot_3a: Our recent intel from Recon Knights suggest that gremlins are planning something big.  We believe they are developing some kind of weapon they're calling 'Project R' that will be targeting Haven itself.  Spiral HQ and the Strangers themselves are requesting that you investigate the matter given your performance in the Royal Jelly Palace.
mission.properties|m.darkest_depths_5a: Then let's get started.  Now that you've stopped the immediate threat to Haven, Spiral HQ is hoping to pick up the trail of the Artifact. It won't be easy. Fortunately I've got some missions lined up for you that will be invaluable for your survival in the dark depths you are about to face. Good luck to you, {0}.
monster.properties|m.promotion_2: We could use a guy like you in management.
item.properties|f.prisma_driver: A high-tech alchemical sidearm that fires powerful prisma bullets that split multiple times on impact.
item.properties|f.furni_chest_spiralfoot: A sealed locker filled with important Spiral Order equipment, like socks.
item.properties|f.wooly_onesie: An itchy yet warm set of pajamas for knights to wear at night. {0}
mission.properties|m.target_acquired_4a: There's one last thing- it seems you won't be the first knight to have entered the Ironclaw Munitions Factory.  We've detected another Alpha Squad recon module somewhere within the factory.  Please attempt to recover it.  I hope that analysis proves that Euclid's squad made it out of there alive...
mission.properties|m.ghost_machine_2a: What happened here? These remains look to be hundreds of years old...
projectx.properties|m.infobox_loadout: Loadouts are configurations of equipment that you design\! Here you can save your current configuration for later use or equip an existing loadout.
helptips.properties|m.token_trader_info: Spiral HQ offers special items to select knights through the exchange of special tokens found within the Clockworks. These tokens are often earned from defeating fierce boss monsters and are proof of the owner's bravery.
mission.properties|r.shadow_knows_3a: I sometimes find dark matter mineral deposits in the Clockworks, perhaps-
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: Quite the scarab nest we've stirred up this time eh, {0}? Reminds me of the time we engaged the Morai siege fleets over Isora. That was quite an all or nothing gamble. Doesn't surprise me in the least that we're the only thing standing between us and utter annihilation again.
conversation.properties|m.hav_grem_2a: My knowledge is yours, little one.
item.properties|f.ash_tail_cap: A warm hat made from hide tanned with blaze pepper. It smells faintly of curry.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_6b: Once you've applied all your skill points and achieved a very high level with your sprite, you will begin to select your 'ultimate skills.' Ultimate skills are improved versions of your sprite skills. Each sprite skill has two options for an ultimate skill.
helptips.properties|m.loading12: If you experience a problem of any kind, press F2 to send a bug report.
item.properties|f.tabard_rose: An aged, embroidered tabard that once belonged to a Knight of the Rose, a sacred order of brave and especially dashing heroes whose numerous adventures are the subject of many folk tales. The Knights of the Rose were said to be peerless fencers, believing that their blades were like the flowers of their name\: a delicate thing of beauty that hides a vicious sting.
projectx.properties|m.love_opt_in: Join the Coliseum Crucible to test community PvP levels\:
conversation.properties|m.af_chat_07: Uh-oh\! The truck have started to move\!
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_2a: The inhabitants native of Haven are called 'Strangers.' You can't miss them- they're the towering, cloaked figures with masks. Despite their intimidating appearance, they have been extremely helpful to us and mostly keep to themselves. The odd, little birds in town certainly seem to like them anyway\!
item.properties|f.industrial_catalyzer: A Catalyzer modified to fire dangerously supercharged projectiles. Catalyzer bullets envelop the enemy in an energy field that explodes after taking damage.
help.properties|m.monster_undead: Deal SHADOW - Weak to ELEMENTAL - Strong against SHADOW
item.properties|f.philoso_feather: A large, grey feather plucked from the greatest of the Owlite magicians.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_weap_2: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
prologue.properties|m.preface3: What we discovered was beyond imagination. We discovered Cradle.
item.properties|f.prize_box_frosty: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Frosty style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.seraphynx_pod: A sprite pod containing a level 1 Seraphynx Battle Sprite. \n\nThe Seraphynx is a battle sprite that embodies divine light. Its skills focus on supporting knights in combat with protection and restoration.
mission.properties|r.shadow_knows_6a: Thanks Hahn.  Tell those other Biotechs I appreciate it.
mission.properties|r.welcome_to_haven_b_: I'll be sure to say hello when I see a Stranger.
conversation.properties|m.hav_snipes_2a: The snipes are the graceful, adorable, fetchingly-corpulent birds you see roaming about Haven. Some say they are the most beautiful creatures in the galaxy, but you would never hear that from the snipes themselves as they are incredibly modest.
conversation.properties|m.core_lead_2: We're attempting to find a means to activate the Core through the power of the minerals found within the Clockworks.  Those minerals are capable of transforming the Clockworks- we have seen this in the Haven Arcade.  It is our belief that we can use that power to activate the Core and... open it somehow.
conversation.properties|r.almire_histori: What happened to the rest of the kingdom?
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_short_gr: A short torch filled with ghastly green fire.
mission.properties|o.pumping_up: Visit the Advanced Training Hall and learn some helpful new techniques
conversation.properties|m.impostoclaus_1:
Glorp\! Glorp\! Glorp\! Merry Winterfest\!

That special time of year is finally here, when a delicate blanket of wondrous white snow covers Haven and every Stranger, every snipe and every Knight fills their hearts with holiday cheer.

But to you I must tell, all is sadly not well. Lacking motive or reason, a group of shriveled-heart grinchlins have threatened this Winterfest season\!
helptips.properties|m.tut_lever: Doors can often be opened by finding the right switch. Try hitting this switch with your handgun\!
conversation.properties|r.arc_leader_1: Sure sounds important, tell me how it all works.
item.properties|f.almire_bench: A balanced bench built for Almirian officials.
item.properties|f.jelly_mail: A squishy set of armor made from slippery slimes that simply oozes with style.
item.properties|f.shako: A ceremonial cap worn by knights during highly prestigious occasions.
social.properties|m.unfriended: You are no longer friends with {0}.
item.properties|f.umbral_blaster: An enhanced shadow blaster designed to neutralize alien bioforms.
uplink.properties|i.crowns: The number of crowns to attach.
item.properties|f.furni_floormonitors: These durable monitors will activate when being stood on. It's not really clear who thought this was a good idea.
chat.properties|m.usage_accessory: Usage\: /{0} (armor helmet) [clear | accessory name]\nAdds an accessory to the equipment or clears all accessories.
item.properties|f.sudaruska: A rugged weapon for the knight who is more than willing to trade style and panache for ridiculous amounts of blunt force trauma.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_2a: First dragons and now... little winged feline creatures? I can't believe we're seeing this phenomenon again\!
craft.properties|m.moved_treasury: Item moved to your Guild Treasury
mission.properties|r.becoming_champion_1: I'll fight to the very end, Lieutenant.  I know what's at stake.
sprites.properties|d.extra_hearty: Increases the chance of hearts dropping and duration of the enchantment.
item.properties|f.toxic_vaporizer_mkii: A Toxic Vaporizer modified to disperse noxious agents over a wider range.
helptips.properties|m.loading8: If you become frozen you will not be able to move or turn, but you can still attack. If adventuring with others, ask them to chip away at the ice with their best attacks.
mission.properties|o.monstrous_research_: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research
craft.properties|m.transmute_max_in_flig: Waiting for previous transmutations to finish...
mission.properties|r.pioneers_4a: Tell me about Squad Leader Euclid.
mission.properties|r.anniversary_start_3: Though my training never included confectionery combat, I'm in\!
item.properties|f.crescent_helm: A sturdy helm that resembles a crescent moon when the visor is lifted.
item.properties|f.raiders_sword: A runed sword that will reduce your foe to cold cuts.
chat.properties|m.usage_mute: Usage\: /{0} player name\nBlocks messages from the specified player.
exchange.properties|m.billing_bad_cardho: Please enter your entire name as it appears on your credit card.
mission.properties|b.alien_ooze: One of our field research teams is under siege from a large colony of lichens. Lichens are an alien species of the slime family thought to have come to the Clockworks via a meteor that crashed on to the surface of Cradle.  This particular species of slime is formed from innumerable smaller slimes that form mobile, sentient 'colonies.' \n\nLichen colonies can further combine to form larger and larger versions of themselves, rapidly evolving a range of deadly claws and barbs.  Prevent them from combining at all costs and save the research team\!
conversation.properties|r.mission_crimso: Thanks for the intel. I'll check it out.
item.properties|f.brute_jelly_helm: A hardy helm crafted from overly oppressive ooze.
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_tall_blu: A tall torch filled with bizarre blue fire.
conversation.properties|r.tut_intro4_1a: I'll scout ahead then\! Be careful, Rhendon.
item.properties|f.steamvalve_mask: Though now outdated by more sophisticated devices, these special pressurized masks were once used by soldiers in environments with extreme atmospheres. The pressure valve on the back would have to be turned just so or the soldier's head would, well, implode.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_welcome: Welcome to the Training Grounds, recruit. In this derelict section of the Clockworks you'll find areas we have built in order to train you in the fine art of not dying a horrible death. So pay attention to these helpful tips, ready your weapon, and get moving\!
mission.properties|o.strength_unity: Defend the Geo Knights from a monstrous assault
mission.properties|m.apocrea_1_4a: The Apocrea bend reality, twisting the environment they invade into a trap. In these traps they stalk any life, harvesting their souls for some unimaginable purpose.
logon.properties|m.trying_next_port: Failed to connect to the server. Trying an alternative port. Please wait...
mission.properties|b.p_ghost_machine_r7:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 


Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has received a distress call from a derelict facility deep within the Clockworks. The distress call came in the form of a digital message saying only 'save us.' Believing it to be a potential trap, Spiral HQ has deployed Desna's Recon Rangers to investigate the facility and assist anyone who may have sent the message.
projectx.properties|m.revisit_help: You can click on completed stages to revisit them.
mission.properties|b.darkest_forces: Hearing that your next missions will have you facing the likes of fiendish and undead monsters in the depths of Tier 3, Chief Biotech Hahn has requested you contact him before deploying for your latest missions.
mission.properties|m.apocrea_2_4a: Lost souls trapped by the Apocrea are bound to the realities they have created. Find the lost souls and free them from the bonds of the Apocrea.
uplink.properties|m.ignite_reward: Hail, {0}\! As part of a special promotion with Ignite, you're entitled to receive a bonus pack of items designed to give you a head start on the great adventure before you\! Attached is a special suit of armor and an array of fiery weapons. \n\nSee you in the Clockworks\!
item.properties|m.use_recipe:
Use this item to add the {0} to your Known Recipes list? 

Items can be created at Alchemy Stations.
(You may view your learned recipes at any time by pressing <{1}>.)
chat.properties|m.usage_item_pack: Usage\: /{0} pack [player name]\nGives an item pack to the player
shop.properties|m.cart_costume_own: Warning\! You already own this exact costume.
item.properties|f.super_freeze_barrier: Surrounds you with potent icy orbs that can freeze hostiles in their tracks
sprites.properties|d.firebolt: Launches a searing ball of fire that explodes on impact.
helptips.properties|m.tg3_ghost: Ghost blocks will destroy any blocks connected to them, even unbreakable blocks\!
pvp.properties|m.love_delete_confirm: Are you sure? The level will be deleted.
help.properties|m.support_2: If you're lost or having trouble, our Game Masters can help\! They can be contacted by filing a support request.
item.properties|f.almire_table: A table transplanted from the hallowed halls of Almire to adorn your abode.
mission.properties|o.p_fiend_test_t3: Help us test this new content.
item.properties|f.guild_members_300: Allows your guild to recruit up to 300 members\!
helptips.properties|m.tut_jelly_cubes: Look out\! Up ahead is a pack of wild jellycubes. When you are close enough, you will automatically target the nearest monster. They will be illuminated with a light column.
item.properties|f.proto_sword: A small sword issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
mission.properties|o.monstrous_research_: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research
item.properties|f.gunslinger_sash: Clothing worn by pistol-packing warriors from a forgotten time. They smell of rawhide, gun smoke and action.
mission.properties|m.another_trace_1a: Hello {0}, I'm happy to report that my equipment is back up and running\! Now I have some good news and bad news for you.  The good news is\: I've been able to track down the source of that energy signature. Here is the bad news\: the energy source has been pinpointed to a highly dangerous area of the Clockworks that Recon Knights have dubbed the 'Royal Jelly Palace.'
item.properties|f.lump_coal: A Grinchlin gift for those who have been naughty or nice.  Grinchlins are equal opportunity party poopers.
item.properties|f.night_cap_tailed: A comfortable cap for knights to wear at night. Sure to give the wearer peaceful dreams all night.
item.properties|f.serene_armor: An ancient suit of armor weathered by the elements. While standing in this armor you can sense the far-off tremors caused by the migration of countless tortodrones journeying to lands unknown.
dungeon.properties|m.treasure_vault_desc: Treasure Troves contain vast quantities of treasure blocks, yours for the taking should you have the proper means to get past the numerous locked doors. Some of them are heavily guarded, so always be on the look out for hidden traps and monsters.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_weap_4: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
item.properties|f.solid_cobalt_helm: A sturdy Cobalt Helm with upgraded internal systems and external reinforcement.

mission.properties|b.faith_armor:
An apprentice named Wilks who had just arrived from a Rescue Camp has found himself in what Spiral HQ calls a 'Trap Chamber.'  These levels of most likely gremlin design seem to be specifically built to trap and ultimately eliminate those attempting to explore the Clockworks. 

Wilks probably didn't know what he had got himself into until it was too late.  Now he's stuck somewhere in the chamber and needs your help. 

Some traps can be avoided and sometimes you may find that you just have to take the hit. In saving Wilks, you will no doubt learn the true value of strong armor.

mission.properties|b.p_heart_of_ice_r6:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has detected a sudden climate shift emanating from deep within the Clockworks. Freak snowstorms and blizzards have begun surging through the depths seeming to originate from an inhospitable, fiendish city known as 'Amu-Sol.'  The Recon Rangers have been dispatched to infiltrate Amu-Sol and discover the source of these freezing storms.

conversation.properties|m.energy_info_3b: Energy is used for all sorts of things\! It's the primary currency for buying goods from the Supply Depot, it allows you to purchase upgrades for yourself, revive yourself in the Clockworks when you run out of Sparks of Life, and it's required to form a guild. \n\nYou'll also find all sorts of devices in the world that are powered up by using energy. Just look for the blue energy symbol on the device.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_mastery_2a: A good sword is, well, good and all, but how about a great sword? If you want weapons that will shake the heavens, then mastery level alchemy is what you need. \n\nOnce you craft an item into its 4 and 5 star incarnation, you unlock that item's true hidden potential.

helptips.properties|m.test_lobby: Welcome testers\! Before you head off into the Clockworks, feel free to help yourself to some wonderful stuff from the merchant to the left. \nThe embers to the far right will level up weapons once your collect enough of them and proceed to the next floor. \nGood luck, brave knights\!

conversation.properties|m.monsterboost_s:
We got enough that Anomalie let me mess around with a few. 

See, I had this handgun chassis from an old import.  Cool little launcher, but impossible to get parts for, especially the ammo. 

Well, with a little wrenching and a little creative misapplication of thermodynamics, I converted it into a pretty peppy little Spike Slicer\!
mission.properties|b.blades_fallen:
Not every knight who enters the Clockworks returns to feel the sun on their face once more.  Within the perilous depths of the Clockworks, those that brave its dangers always face the reality that every expedition may be their last.  Sometimes their bodies can be recovered and other times all that is left is remnants of their gear. 

Just outside of Haven, Spiral HQ has built a soldier's graveyard where fallen knights can lay to rest.  As a Spiral Knight, you must face the reality of death in order to understand its gravity. 

Deliver the remains of an unknown knight, a sword, to a memorial within the graveyard.  But stay alert- dark energies resonate from the graveyard, attracted to the countless souls it houses.
item.properties|f.polar_night_warden_coa: An insulated coat that will keep a knight warm when facing bitter polar winds. The fur-lined armor plating makes it ideal for hours of nighttime watch duty.
item.properties|f.jelly_animal: A magnificent animalistic mask exemplifying ectoplasmic expropriation.
mission.properties|m.delved_too_deep_3a: Amazing that after all this time we didn't know the truth. I mean, we've suspected for a while now that this planet was some kind of prison but who could have guessed that this 'Swarm' was just waiting for someone to stumble across the Core and free it?
helptips.properties|m.tg3_final: Just one more room lies between you and the elevator out of here. Remember what you have learned so far and you'll do just fine... at least that's the theory. Try not to die, ok?
item.properties|f.the_bitter_end: A shield carried by all members of the Recon Rangers. Its name is a reminder to all Rangers as to precisely when they are permitted to drop it in battle.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_mastery_3a: At 4 and 5 star level, gear offers the best protection you can find and weapons pack the biggest punch.  If you want to stay alive where you're heading, you need to start building an arsenal of 4 and 5 star gear. \n\nAnd remember- as items reach 5 star they typically can branch even more than before.  Your combat options are about to really open up.  Plan your arsenal with care.
